r1.mnemo: A stalk of **grain** bent by the weight of its seeds: the top sprig droops as if taking a bow.
r1.forma: A drooping stroke on top, then a stem with two open leaves.

r2.mnemo: A private **nook**: two strokes form a closed corner, and inside it you hide your stuff where nobody looks.
r2.forma: A bent, pointed stroke plus a short tick that closes the triangle.

r38.mnemo: A **dog** is a giant (大) with one ear perked up: the dot at the top right. On the left it becomes 犭, thin and upright.
r38.forma: A 大 with a dot at the top right; on the left, 犭.

r100.mnemo: Two blades of **grass** sprouting and crossing a line, which is the ground. It always grows at the top of the kanji.
r100.forma: A line crossed by two short sticks, like two joined crosses.

r60.mnemo: A rice **field** seen from above: four square plots split by paths that cross.
r60.forma: A square divided into four by a cross.

r26.mnemo: A **person** walking, seen from the side: two legs leaning on each other. On the left they stand up (亻); on top they open their arms (𠆢).
r26.forma: Two strokes leaning together like a roof; on the left, a stick with a slant.

r23.mnemo: The teacher nails (丁) your test to the wall and your mouth (口) smiles below: a **gold star**! Yes, you can.
r23.forma: A big nail (丁) with a mouth (口) tucked under it, on the left.

r9.mnemo: A real **tree**: a straight trunk, branches spread along the line, and roots opening downward in two diagonals.
r9.forma: A cross with two diagonals spreading out below, like roots.

r10.mnemo: A single finger lying flat: the horizontal line is **one**, the easiest number to write in Japanese.

r27.mnemo: The **sun** seen through a square window: the middle line is the horizon it rises over every day.
r27.forma: A tall rectangle with a line across the middle.

r36.mnemo: In the **evening** a crescent moon peeks out: the curve is the moon, and the stroke inside is the night's first glow.
r36.forma: Like katakana タ: a half moon with a stroke inside.

r14.mnemo: A square **mouth** wide open, as if yelling “oh!”: four sides and nothing inside.

r43.mnemo: Two insect **antennae** sticking up over a line: they wiggle side to side, looking for a signal.
r43.forma: Two short strokes slanting inward over a horizontal line.

r44.mnemo: A crescent **moon** standing upright, with two clouds inside. Each moon is a month; on the left of other kanji it means flesh.
r44.forma: A tall rectangle with a curved left leg and two lines inside.

r42.mnemo: A kitchen **knife**: the curved blade goes down and the handle sticks out diagonally. On the right of other kanji it shrinks to two vertical lines (刂).
r42.forma: Like 力, but not poking out on top; on the right, 刂.

r77.mnemo: A **cow** seen from above: the horn sticks out on the left, the lines are its back and the stick is its long body.
r77.forma: A slanted horn, two lines and a stick crossing them.

r16.mnemo: Two long **legs** out for a walk: the left one curves outward and the right one ends in a foot giving a little kick upward.
r16.forma: Two separate strokes going down: one curving left, the other hooked.

r170.mnemo: A life begins in the **cradle**: a sprout (屮) grows out of the soil (土) with one extra leaf. Everything is born here.
r170.forma: A slanted stroke over three lines joined by a stick.

r4.mnemo: You throw the **boomerang**: it flies straight, turns at an angle and comes back across its own path. Then you throw it again, and again.
r4.forma: A horizontal line that drops diagonally, crossed by another diagonal.

r71.mnemo: A winding **road**: the dot is a car and the long bottom stroke is the asphalt stretching to the horizon.
r71.forma: A dot, a zigzag and a long base that waves to the right.

r30.mnemo: A plant sprouts from the **soil**: the long bottom line is the ground and the cross on top is the stem poking out.
r30.forma: A cross on a longer line. Careful: 士 has the longer line on top.

r72.mnemo: A **sheep** from the front: two horns on top, layers of wool in the lines and its body running down the stick.
r72.forma: Two strokes in a V over three lines crossed by a stick.

r13.mnemo: A mouth at the bottom with several lines rising out of it: those are the **words** floating in the air, one above another, like in a comic.
r13.forma: A dot, three horizontal lines and a mouth (口) underneath.

r97.mnemo: A fat old **turkey**: the person (亻) is its stretched neck and the stacked lines are its feathers in neat rows.
r97.forma: A 亻 on the left and four lines crossed by a stick.

r34.mnemo: An **eye** stood on end: turn the rectangle sideways and you'll see the upper lid, the pupil in the middle and the lower lid.
r34.forma: A tall rectangle with two lines inside.

r126.mnemo: Under a little two-slope roof there's a bowl full of white **food** with a spoon beside it: dinner's ready!
r126.forma: An open roof over a 良: roof, bowl and legs.

r64.mnemo: A huge **yawn**: the person (人) opens wide, and above them a sigh shaped like a fishhook (⺈) escapes. They're short on sleep.
r64.forma: A fishhook (⺈) over a person (人) spread open.

r82.mnemo: A **scholar** spreads his arms (the long top line) over a small pedestal: he knows so much the ground below is too short for him.
r82.forma: A cross with the top line longer than the bottom one.

r53.mnemo: A **blanket** spread over something sleeping underneath: it covers everything and drapes down both sides.
r53.forma: A flat lid with both ends bent down, no dot.

r84.mnemo: A hand holds a **brush**: the lines are the fingers gripping it and the stick going down is the handle with a wet tip.
r84.forma: Several horizontal lines crossed by a long vertical stick.

r92.mnemo: A stream of **water** splashing out to the sides: the middle hook is the current. On the left it turns into three drops (氵).
r92.forma: A hooked stick with splashes on both sides; on the left, three drops.

r3.mnemo: Two people walking in single file: the **walker** who never stops taking steps. The slanted strokes on top are their heads moving forward.
r3.forma: Two slanted strokes stacked on a vertical stick, like a double 亻.

r22.mnemo: A strong **nail** seen from the side: the flat head on top and the point that goes down and bends as it enters the wood.
r22.forma: A horizontal line with a hooked stick underneath, like a T.

r50.mnemo: The **roof** of a Japanese house with its chimney: the dot on top and the two slopes falling to the sides.
r50.forma: A dot over a lid with both ends bent down.

r51.mnemo: A **pig** lying belly up: the line is its back, and the dangling strokes are its little legs and curly tail.
r51.forma: A line on top and several diagonals hanging down like legs.

r7.mnemo: A **woman** kneeling with crossed legs and open arms, dancing: look at the waist crossing in the middle.
r7.forma: A zigzag crossed by a horizontal line, like crossed legs.

r8.mnemo: A **child** wrapped in a diaper: little head on top, tiny arms spread along the line, and just one leg poking out below.
r8.forma: A hook on top, a horizontal line and a stick ending in a hook.

r37.mnemo: A **giant** with arms and legs spread wide, taking up all the space: look how big he is!
r37.forma: A person (人) with arms stretched out along a horizontal line.

r57.mnemo: Something really **small**: a little stick with a crumb on each side. On top of other kanji it's just three tiny strokes (⺌).
r57.forma: A hooked stick with a dot on each side; on top, three strokes.

r58.mnemo: A pot **lid** with its knob: the dot on top is the handle and the line is the flat lid.
r58.forma: A dot over a horizontal line.

r59.mnemo: The **father** crosses his arms (the X below) and frowns (the two strokes on top): who broke the vase?
r59.forma: Two short strokes in an upside-down V over an X.

r74.mnemo: A soccer **goal**: two posts and the crossbar on top. Anything that ends up inside counts as a score.
r74.forma: A frame with a top and two legs, open at the bottom.

r87.mnemo: A champion standing on the **podium**: the lid (亠) is his head, his legs spread and the bottom line is the step.
r87.forma: A lid (亠), two strokes in a V and a long line below.

r95.mnemo: A lumberjack's **axe**: the slanted stroke on top is the head, the crossing line is the blade and the long stick is the handle.
r95.forma: Two slanted strokes, a line and a vertical stick on the right.

r52.mnemo: A pig's **snout** from the side: three lines like the folds of its nose, sniffing toward the left.
r52.forma: Like a backward E: three lines joined on the right.

r17.mnemo: A rabbit with a **doctor's note** gets out of class: the fishhook (⺈) on top is its ears, and the legs (儿) run off.
r17.forma: A fishhook on top, an open box in the middle and legs below.

r18.mnemo: An arm flexing its **muscle**: the bent stroke is the bulging bicep and the diagonal is the forearm pushing hard.
r18.forma: Like katakana カ without the dot: a hook crossed by a diagonal.

r19.mnemo: An archery **bow** seen from the side: the zigzag wood pulls tight, ready to shoot the arrow.
r19.forma: A three-step zigzag ending in a hook, like a square S.

r20.mnemo: A fat **bug**: a square head on top, a body running through it and one little leg on the side, crawling along the ground.
r20.forma: A square pierced by a stick, over a line with a dot.

r12.mnemo: You clench your hand into an X between floor and ceiling: all **five** fingers crossed. Inside other kanji, sometimes only the X (㐅) is left.
r12.forma: Line, X-shaped cross, line; or just an X.

r122.mnemo: A giant (大) with an extra line on his head: the **husband** has put in a hairpin for his wedding topknot.
r122.forma: A giant (大) with a second line on top.

r61.mnemo: A beating **heart**: the bottom curve is the muscle and the three dots are drops of emotion. On the left it stands up (忄).
r61.forma: A hooked curve and three dots; on the left, a stick with two dots.

r11.mnemo: Two lines, **two** things: the top one is shorter, like a little brother sitting on top of his big brother.
r11.forma: Two horizontal lines, the top one shorter.

r150.mnemo: People in Japan point at their **nose** to say “me”: an eye (目) with a stroke on top, the tip of the nose.
r150.forma: An eye (目) with a short stroke on top.

r69.mnemo: Two strokes spreading apart like a mustache: **eight** in Japanese. It sounds like “hachi” and looks like ハ.
r69.forma: Two strokes opening downward, like ハ.

r6.mnemo: A hunter pulls the **skin** off an animal: the hook on top is the hanging hide, and the hand below rips it off in one tug.
r6.forma: A hook with a small tick on the left, over a 又 shape.

r5.mnemo: A **stick** planted in the ground, stiff and alone: the simplest vertical line there is.
r5.forma: One single vertical line, top to bottom.

r31.mnemo: A Buddhist **temple**: the building rises over the soil (土), and the monk measures every offering in inches (寸).
r31.forma: Soil (土) on top and an inch (寸) below.

r32.mnemo: A double **gate**, like a Japanese castle's: one door on each side, both flung wide open.
r32.forma: Two matching doors, each with two little windows, framing a gap.

r56.mnemo: An **arrow** with feathers on top and a tip that splits below like the giant's (大) legs: off it flies.
r56.forma: A slanted stroke and a line over a 大.

r81.mnemo: A **mountain** with three peaks: the middle one is the tallest, with two shorter ones on the sides.
r81.forma: Three vertical sticks joined at the base; the middle one is tallest.

r80.mnemo: A **bowl** open at the top, waiting to be filled with rice: flat bottom and two straight walls.
r80.forma: A container open on top: two sticks and a bottom.

r49.mnemo: You count to **ten** on your fingers and cross your hands: one line and one stick, complete, like a cross.
r49.forma: A cross: one horizontal line and one vertical line.

r65.mnemo: A big **ear** in profile: the frame is the outer ear and the lines inside are the folds that let sound in.
r65.forma: A tall frame with lines inside and a base sticking out right.

r113.mnemo: Two tens (十) stuck together at the base: ten plus ten, **twenty**.
r113.forma: Two sticks crossed by a line and joined at the bottom.

r21.mnemo: A butcher's **hook**: a stick that drops straight down and bends left at the end to hang anything.
r21.forma: A vertical stick ending in a little hook to the left.

r48.mnemo: A fishing **net** spread out: a rectangle lying on its side, with vertical cords that make the mesh.
r48.forma: A wide rectangle split by two short sticks, like an eye lying down.

r136.mnemo: A ball of **yarn**, half wound up: two zigzag loops and a loose end that closes in a point.
r136.forma: Two stacked zigzags like ㄑ, ending in a short stroke.

r111.mnemo: A **sled** gliding along in winter: the curved stroke is the runner and the crossing diagonal is the rope, pulling slowly.
r111.forma: Like 夕 with a long diagonal cutting across to the right.

r73.mnemo: A **handsaw** that suddenly twists: the teeth stick out on the right and the slanted handle stays on the left.
r73.forma: A slanted stroke on top, a stick and two short lines on the right.

r114.mnemo: A **bus stop**: the tall pole, the little sign on the right and the sidewalk. Everybody stops here.
r114.forma: A tall stick, a short line to its right, a short stick and a base.

r68.mnemo: A reader buries their head in the **page**: the line is their bangs, the eye reads without blinking and their legs poke out below.
r68.forma: A line on top of a stretched shell (貝).

r247.mnemo: Inside the goal (冂) a **clone** is waiting for you: a line and a mouth (口) exactly like yours.
r247.forma: A goal (冂) with a line and a mouth (口) inside.

r55.mnemo: A super long **tongue**: it comes out of the mouth (口) below and shoots up like a stick, tip curled at the top.
r55.forma: A 千 on top of a mouth (口).

r46.mnemo: An **old man** hunched over the soil (土), his cane crossing diagonally. Below, he sometimes sits with his soup spoon (匕).
r46.forma: Soil (土) with a long diagonal sweeping down to the left.

r70.mnemo: You think hard and a **light bulb** turns on: the line is the ceiling and the cord twists down to the bulb of your idea.
r70.forma: A horizontal line with a stroke below that bends in a zigzag.

r234.mnemo: A **teepee** with its door open: two poles leaning together and the entrance in the middle. Come on in.
r234.forma: Two strokes leaning like 人, but the left one is shorter.

r35.mnemo: The **king** links heaven, people and earth: three lines joined by one stick. With an extra dot (玉), it's his favorite jewel.
r35.forma: Three horizontal lines crossed by a stick; sometimes with a dot.

r28.mnemo: A **drop** of ink falling from the brush: the tiniest stroke, plump at the top and sharp at the bottom.

r67.mnemo: A clam **shell**: the eye (目) is the open shell and the two little legs below are what peeks out. Shells were once used as money.
r67.forma: An eye (目) with two short strokes below, like little legs.

r24.mnemo: A **rifle** resting on your shoulder: the short slanted stroke is the stock and the long line is the barrel, aiming right.
r24.forma: A short slanted stroke over a horizontal line.

r85.mnemo: **Steam** rising from a boiling pot: several lines waving their way upward and a long hook sneaking off to the right.
r85.forma: A slanted stroke, two lines and a long hook to the right.

r45.mnemo: A playground **slide**: you hop on at the top right and glide down, curving to the bottom left.
r45.forma: One stroke curving down from right to left.

r86.mnemo: A **hand** with fingers spread: three lines as fingers and a stick running down the wrist. On the left it shrinks to 扌.
r86.forma: Three lines crossed by a hooked stick; on the left, 扌.

r138.mnemo: The **fortune teller** reads the cracks in a shell over the fire: one crack down, another off to the side. That's how he sees the future.
r138.forma: A vertical stick with a short stroke on the right.

r179.mnemo: A **car** seen from above: the field (田) is the body, the lines are the axles and the stick runs from hood to trunk.
r179.forma: A field (田) pierced by a stick, with lines above and below.

r125.mnemo: A **hedgehog** with its spines up: sticks on top, little legs on the sides and the line of the ground.
r125.forma: Two vertical sticks with a stroke on each side, over a line.

r101.mnemo: Three tens (十) joined at the bottom: thirty years, one generation. That's how the **world** turns, era after era.
r101.forma: A line crossed by three sticks, closed at the bottom.

r109.mnemo: A **wrapping** that hugs what it carries: the stroke drops and curls around to protect the gift.
r109.forma: A slanted stroke and another that bends into a hook, open at bottom left.

r135.mnemo: A **cowboy** from the Wild West in the saloon doorway: his legs peek out under the frame and the top line is his hat.
r135.forma: A line over a frame with two sticks inside; on top, 覀.

r200.mnemo: **Rain** outside the window: the line is the sky, the frame is the window and the four dots are falling drops.
r200.forma: A line over a frame with a stick and four dots inside.

r187.mnemo: **Lightning** strikes through the field (田) from top to bottom: the sky is shouting something important.
r187.forma: A field (田) pierced by a stick poking out top and bottom.

r62.mnemo: A **cloud** of words: two lines of sky, and below them a nook (厶) where the steam curls up. Whatever you say keeps floating there.
r62.forma: Two horizontal lines over a nook (厶).

r204.mnemo: A **compass**: the top dot marks north, the line is the horizon and the needle spins to show the way.
r204.forma: A dot, a line and a hooked stroke crossed by a diagonal.

r47.mnemo: A hand raises the **whip**: the top stroke is the handle and the X below is the crack as it strikes.
r47.forma: A short slanted stroke over a long X, on the right of the kanji.

r54.mnemo: A **scarf** hanging from a pole: the cloth drapes down the sides and the pole runs through the middle.
r54.forma: A frame open at the bottom, pierced by a vertical stick.

r63.mnemo: The three drops of water (氵) freeze into **ice**: only two are left, stiff with cold, because the third got stuck.
r63.forma: Two little slanted dots on the left of the kanji.

r105.mnemo: A stone **altar**: two lines form the table, the stick is the leg and the drops on the sides are offerings. Sideways it becomes 礻.
r105.forma: Two lines over a 小; on the left, 礻 with a dot.

r130.mnemo: A tanned leather **belt**: the square buckle (口) in the middle and the straps coming out at the top and bottom.
r130.forma: A mouth (口) between two crossed pieces, above and below, on a stick.

r108.mnemo: **Thread** twisted on a spool: two loops on top and the loose ends hanging below, like a small (小).
r108.forma: Two zigzags like 幺 over a 小; on the left, 糹.

r76.mnemo: You pour rice (米) into a **sieve** and shake it: the stroke on top is the hand separating the good from the bad.
r76.forma: Rice (米) with a slanted stroke on top.

r118.mnemo: Super **long hair**: the top lines are the neatly combed hair, and it falls all the way to the feet. Only the tribe's leader wears it like that.
r118.forma: Three lines over a stick and, below, a base with two open strokes.

r66.mnemo: A **cliff**: the top line is the edge you walk along and the diagonal is the wall dropping into the void.
r66.forma: A horizontal line and a stroke curving down to the left.

r127.mnemo: The **three hairs** on a pirate's chin: three slanted strokes, all combed in the same direction.
r127.forma: Three parallel strokes slanting down to the left.

r157.mnemo: A **valley** from the front: the slopes open up at the top, twice, and below is the mouth (口) where the river flows out.
r157.forma: Two pairs of V strokes over a mouth (口).

r123.mnemo: A log split from top to bottom: the **plank** on the left, with its knots sticking out.
r123.forma: A vertical stick with two short strokes on the left.

r134.mnemo: A **spoon** lying down: the short stroke is the handle and the long curve is the bowl, ending in a hook upward.
r134.forma: A short slanted stroke and another that drops and curves right.

r98.mnemo: Someone standing on the podium (立) sings under the sun (日): their voice fills everything with **sound**.
r98.forma: A podium (立) on top of a sun (日).

r99.mnemo: A tree (木) with an extra short branch on top: that's where the **unripe fruit** hangs, not ready yet. Don't pick it.
r99.forma: A tree (木) with two lines: the top one is shorter.

r25.mnemo: A **mother** seen from the front: her body is a crossed box, and the two dots are the breasts that feed her baby. Without the dots, she says “no!”
r25.forma: A slanted box crossed by a line, with two dots or one stroke inside.

r88.mnemo: Someone standing on the podium (立) lets a **spit** fly out of their mouth (口): gross, what bad manners!
r88.forma: A podium (立) on top of a mouth (口).

r89.mnemo: A **town** clinging to a hill: the zigzag is the road up and the stick is the slope. On the left, a small town; on the right, a city.
r89.forma: A small 3 stuck to a vertical stick, on one side of the kanji.

r83.mnemo: A **corpse** lying in bed: the box on top is the head and the long stroke is the body stretched out downward.
r83.forma: A small box with a long leg curving down to the left.

r90.mnemo: An arrow plunges down and sticks into the soil (土): it has reached the **finish line**. The top line is the tape it breaks.
r90.forma: A line, a nook (厶) and soil (土) underneath.

r40.mnemo: The sun (日) with a little ray of light poking out on top: it shines so hard everything turns **white**.
r40.forma: A sun (日) with a short stroke on top.

r196.mnemo: An arm with a bent elbow: **nine** is the last number before ten, and it stretches to reach it.
r196.forma: A slanted stroke and another that bends and ends in a hook upward.

r139.mnemo: Something small (小) with one extra stroke that takes a piece away: only a **pinch** is left.
r139.forma: A small (小) with a slanted stroke dropping to the left.

r116.mnemo: A bowl of **bean** stew on its stand: the top line is the lid, the mouth (口) is the full bowl and below is the base.
r116.forma: A line, a mouth (口), two strokes in a V and a bottom line.

r206.mnemo: An upside-down **seven**: a line crossed by a stroke that drops and curves right, like a 7 flipped over.
r206.forma: A line crossed by a stroke that bends down to the right.

r119.mnemo: A big **fence** around everything inside it: nobody gets out. It's a giant mouth hugging the rest of the kanji.
r119.forma: A big square that encloses other pieces.

r107.mnemo: A **coffin** with a lid (亠) on top: inside, in the corner, rests someone who's already gone.
r107.forma: A lid (亠) over an L-shaped stroke; or a box open to the right.

r96.mnemo: A huge gym **barbell**: an iron field (田) loaded over the soil, with bars above and below. So heavy!
r96.forma: A 田 pierced by a stick, with lines above and below.

r106.mnemo: A little **duckling** paddling behind its mom: one stroke with a neck, a back and a tail that flicks up. Always second in line.
r106.forma: One zigzag stroke with a tail flicking up, like a 2.

r112.mnemo: A **shed** built against the cliff (厂): the dot is the chimney, telling you someone lives inside.

r151.mnemo: A **kimono** on a hanger: the lid (亠) is the collar, and below, the sleeves and hem open up. Sideways it becomes 衤.
r151.forma: A lid (亠) and an open hem; on the left, 衤 with two dots.

r168.mnemo: An eagle's **claw** swooping down to grab: sharp fingers hanging down. On top of other kanji it looks like 爫.
r168.forma: A slanted roof with three claws hanging down; on top, 爫.

r78.mnemo: A **flag** with ribbons in the wind: the pole bends and the strips hang down. It waves, saying “you shall not pass!”
r78.forma: A hook like 勹 with two slanted strokes inside.

r110.mnemo: A **swing**: the lid (亠) is the bar, the two sticks are the ropes and the side strokes are the back-and-forth. It goes and comes back again.
r110.forma: A lid (亠) with two sticks below and one stroke on each side.

r165.mnemo: A galloping **horse**: the mane flying in the lines, its back, and four dots below, its legs at full speed.
r165.forma: Lines on a stick, a hook and four dots below.

r93.mnemo: A foot-long **ruler**, the length of one shaku: the box on top and the legs spread wide, measuring each step.
r93.forma: Like 尸 with a diagonal kicking out down to the right.

r221.mnemo: A clan's **family crest**: the banner hangs from a curved pole and the last stroke waves with the family name.
r221.forma: A curved stroke, a hooked stick, a line and a long diagonal.

r173.mnemo: A **runner** at the starting line: the soil (土) on top is his lowered head, and below, his legs bursting off at full speed.
r173.forma: Soil (土) over a foot (龰) stretching out to the right.

r128.mnemo: A **calendar** with a sun (日) in the middle and a ten (十) above and below: ten days plus ten days.
r128.forma: A sun (日) with a cross (十) above and another below.

r33.mnemo: A **fire** with two sparks jumping out to the sides. Under other kanji it flattens into four dots: the embers (⺣).
r33.forma: A person (人) with a spark on each side; at the bottom, four dots.

r160.mnemo: The **Grim Reaper** arrives in the evening (夕) under a line of earth: death has come to take whatever rots.
r160.forma: A line on top of an evening (夕).

r158.mnemo: **Two hands** raised, holding something up: the two sticks are the arms and the line is what they're lifting.
r158.forma: A line with two sticks hanging down, the right one longer.

r131.mnemo: A **halberd**: the long curved pole, the line of the blade crossing it and a little tassel dot hanging at the top.
r131.forma: A line crossed by a long hooked stroke, with a dot top right.

r124.mnemo: Two **bamboo** canes side by side, with their slanted leaves. On top of other kanji they become ⺮.
r124.forma: Two hooked sticks with slanted leaves; on top, ⺮.

r103.mnemo: A **snake** coiled around itself: it bites its own tail because it only thinks about itself.
r103.forma: A zigzag stroke ending in an open hook, like a square S.

r227.mnemo: A **dart** stuck in the middle of a ceremony: the line is its body, the hook the tip and the dot the feather.
r227.forma: A line crossed by a hooked stroke and a dot: 戈 without the diagonal.

r156.mnemo: A **watcher**: a giant eye (目) on a pair of legs (儿), strolling around and staring at everything.

r193.mnemo: A stalk pokes out of the field (田): pull hard and out comes the **root**, the origin of it all.
r193.forma: A field (田) with its middle stick poking out on top.

r143.mnemo: A curled-up **rainbow**: the fishhook (⺈) on top catches it, and below, the snake (巴) turns every color.

r225.mnemo: Two wings full of **feathers**: each wing has its hook and two strokes inside, the loose feathers.
r225.forma: Two identical hooked shapes with two strokes inside, side by side.

r133.mnemo: A **gang** walking arm in arm crosses the street in a zigzag: us, always together, always in line.
r133.forma: A square zigzag pierced by a stick, like the bottom of 舞.

r232.mnemo: A **clothesline** in the yard: two cords and a pole in the middle. That's where clothes dry in the sun.
r232.forma: Two horizontal lines crossed by a vertical stick.

r39.mnemo: A Noh theater **mask**: the frame is the face, and inside an eye (目) watches you through the holes.
r39.forma: A line on top, a big frame and a long eye inside.

r115.mnemo: A **bundle** of branches: a tree (木) tied at the waist with a rope shaped like a mouth (口).
r115.forma: A tree (木) with a mouth (口) on its trunk.

r159.mnemo: A shrine **torii**: two lines on top and two pillars. Walk through it and the path to the gods opens up.
r159.forma: Two horizontal lines crossed by two vertical sticks.

r94.mnemo: The **door** of a house: the top line is the frame, the box is the door itself and the long stroke is the hinge going down.
r94.forma: A line on top of a 尸: a box with a curved leg.

r182.mnemo: A **hospital**: the shed (广) is the ward and the two dots on the left are sweat drops from the patient in bed.
r182.forma: A shed (广) with two little dots on the left.

r117.mnemo: Two jets of water spurt over a pair of legs (儿): the **fountain** where everything begins. The origin, the very first drop.

r169.mnemo: The **flirt**: a big brother (兄) whose antennae (䒑) stand straight up whenever someone cute walks by.
r169.forma: Antennae (䒑) on top of a big brother (兄).

r129.mnemo: In the **mirror** everything comes out backward: the cliff (厂) is the frame and inside, the boomerang (又) flies the other way.
r129.forma: A cliff (厂) with a boomerang (又) inside.

r198.mnemo: Three currents of a **river** running side by side: the water flows down without stopping.
r198.forma: Three sticks running down in parallel, sometimes wavy.

r233.mnemo: A super long **stride**: the zigzag is the leg lunging forward and the base stretches out to the right.
r233.forma: A short zigzag and a long base to the right, no dot.

r75.mnemo: A **rice** plant with grains popping off: four grains in the corners around the crossed stalk.
r75.forma: A cross with four short strokes in the corners, like an asterisk.

r199.mnemo: A **ladle** for measuring sake: two drops inside, the stick is the long handle and the line crosses it.
r199.forma: Two dots on the left and a line crossing a stick.

r120.mnemo: A **farm**: the crop field (田) over the soil (土), and a stick running through it all like the village road.
r120.forma: A field (田) over soil (土), joined by a stick.

r41.mnemo: The math symbol **pi**: a line on top and two legs coming down, one curved and one hooked.
r41.forma: A line with two legs underneath, like π.

r147.mnemo: A **kangaroo** is a mom with a pouch: the マ shape is the pouch where she carries her baby everywhere.
r147.forma: Like katakana マ: a hook and a short stroke.

r148.mnemo: An open **toolbox**: the lines are the shelves and the middle stick is the handle you use to carry it.
r148.forma: A moon (月) with a stick through the middle.

r190.mnemo: A **well** seen from above: two lines and two sticks, the wooden frame around the hole. Like a #.
r190.forma: Two lines crossed by two sticks, like #.

r91.mnemo: An eye looking back and legs digging into the ground: it slams on the **brake** and stops dead in the middle of the road.
r91.forma: Like 良 without the dot: a cut-off eye with two legs spread below.

r171.mnemo: An ancient **tombstone**: the cross (十) on top and the mouth (口) below, an inscription nobody has read in centuries.
r171.forma: A cross (十) on top of a mouth (口).

r102.mnemo: A bottle of **sake**: the line is the cork, the box is the jar and the little lines inside show the liquor level.
r102.forma: A line, a frame with two sticks inside and a closing line.

r146.mnemo: A **scorpion** with its tail raised: the body is the hook going up and the stinger is the curve falling to the right.
r146.forma: A hooked stroke, a stick and a long curve that turns upward.

r189.mnemo: A **hole** under the roof (宀): two strokes open up the mouth of a dark cave.
r189.forma: A roof (宀) with two open strokes (八) below.

r161.mnemo: Two halberds (戈) stacked up: a pile of **coins** heaped together, each with its own stamp, clinking away.
r161.forma: Two halberds (戈), one above the other.

r132.mnemo: A gangly **teen**, a giant (大) tilting his head to one side and goofing around: the stroke on top is his bangs.
r132.forma: A giant (大) with a slanted stroke on top.

r180.mnemo: A Japanese ink **stamp**: the bent handle on top and the base that presses down onto the paper.
r180.forma: A square hook and a stick going down on the right.

r174.mnemo: The **courier** arrives by sled (夂) and drops a package into each waiting mouth (口): one for everyone.
r174.forma: A sled (夂) over a mouth (口).

r141.mnemo: A low Japanese **table**: the top board and two legs, the right one curving outward.
r141.forma: Two legs joined at the top: the left straight, the right hooked.

r184.mnemo: A hanging **chili pepper**: the podium (立) is the stem and the cross below is the red pepper. Hot!
r184.forma: A podium (立) over a cross (十).

r152.mnemo: A construction **I-beam** seen from the side: shaped like an I, with a top flange, a web and a base. Hard work.
r152.forma: A line on top, a stick and another line below: like an I.

r104.mnemo: A **racetrack**: the goal (冂) is the outer fence, and inside everything goes around: the soil (土) of the track and the mouth (口) of the crowd.
r104.forma: A goal (冂) with soil (土) and a mouth (口) inside.

r29.mnemo: An open hand measures one **inch**: the dot marks the pulse, just a finger's width from the wrist. That's how old Japan measured.
r29.forma: A line, a hooked stick and a dot to its left.

r239.mnemo: A **box** lying on its side, open on the right: you can put whatever you want inside.
r239.forma: A frame open on the right.

r15.mnemo: A bent **fishhook** hanging from the line: two short strokes folding into a point. That's why it sits on the head of 魚, the fish.
r15.forma: Two short strokes: one slanted, one bending at an angle, like ク.

r164.mnemo: A **stone** rolls off the cliff (厂): the mouth (口) is the square rock left lying at the bottom.
r164.forma: A cliff (厂) with a mouth (口) underneath.

r231.mnemo: An animal's leg ending in a **hoof**: the knee on top and the hoof planted below. That's why it counts animals.
r231.forma: A line with a short stick and a foot (龰) below.

r191.mnemo: A **scaffold**: it goes up, comes down and goes up again. Lines and sticks crossing inside a goal (冂).
r191.forma: A line on top of a goal (冂) with soil (土) inside.

r181.mnemo: Your hand grabs the **hoe** and digs into the soil (土): that's how you work the garden.
r181.forma: A boomerang (又) on top of soil (土).

r155.mnemo: A crown (龶) over the moon (月): they shine a cold **blue**, like a young, fresh night.
r155.forma: A crown (龶) on top of a moon (月).

r224.mnemo: The sun (日) comes up in the east behind a tree (木): **sunrise** seen from a Japanese forest.
r224.forma: A tree (木) with a sun (日) on its trunk.

r149.mnemo: A **power line** tower: three cables crossed by the legs of the tower, which spread out below like a giant's.
r149.forma: Three lines crossed by an open 人.

r194.mnemo: An **assembly** under a two-slope roof: two mouths (口) talk and two people (人) listen. Everyone has an opinion on everything.
r194.forma: A two-slope roof, a line, two mouths and two people.

r259.mnemo: A stone **mortar** from the front: two halves with notches for crushing grain.
r259.forma: Two matching halves with lines inside, joined at the bottom.

r214.mnemo: Grandma's old **pot**, the one from way back: the sun (日) is the fire, the field (田) the pot and the antennae (䒑) the steam.
r214.forma: Antennae (䒑) over a field (田) and a sun (日).

r185.mnemo: A dung **beetle**: antennae (䒑) on top, stripes on its shell and two legs spread wide, pushing its ball.
r185.forma: Antennae (䒑), two lines and a headless giant (大).

r209.mnemo: Under the pantry's little roof you keep the **leftovers** from the feast, piled on a stick with two little legs.
r209.forma: A little roof over a line and a simplified tree (木).

r217.mnemo: Two **twins** sitting side by side: everyone compares them, but they're just two spoons (匕), almost the same.

r240.mnemo: A **bird** perched on a branch: head with its eye, curved body, folded wings and four dots for its feet.
r240.forma: A stroke on top, an eye (目) over a hook and four dots.

r186.mnemo: A **plate** seen from the side on the table: its walls with their dividers and a flat base.
r186.forma: A frame with two sticks inside, over a long line.

r230.mnemo: A **yo-yo** that goes up and down like the sun (日) every day: the rifle (𠂉) shoots it out and the sled (夂) brings it back.
r230.forma: A rifle (𠂉) on top, a sun (日) in the middle, a sled (夂) below.

r144.mnemo: A person with a **tattoo** on their chest: the lid (亠) is the head and the X is the letters inked on the skin.

r235.mnemo: A **long arm** stretching to reach something: the falling stroke is the arm and the zigzag is the hand grabbing like a boomerang.
r235.forma: A curved stroke and a zigzag, like a stretched 又.

r237.mnemo: A fishing **harpoon**: the bent tip on top, like a マ, and below, the long hooked shaft.
r237.forma: A マ over a long hook, with a slanted stroke on the left.

r203.mnemo: A wolf's **fang**: the top line is the gum, the hook comes down sharp and the diagonal bites.
r203.forma: A line, a bent stroke, a hooked stick and a diagonal.

r236.mnemo: A pair of hiking **boots** pointing out to the sides, climbing to the top one step at a time.
r236.forma: Two feet splayed on top: zigzag strokes to the left and right.

r176.mnemo: Under the shed (广) hang two bundles of **hemp**, drying like two leafless trees (木).
r176.forma: A shed (广) with a grove (林) inside.

r254.mnemo: A piece of **leather** stretched out to dry: grass (艹) on top, the body in the middle and the legs pulled tight.
r254.forma: Grass (艹) over a squashed mouth and a long cross (十).

r238.mnemo: A **genie** pops out of the lamp: the line is his arm, the hooked stick his body and the diagonal the smoke.
r238.forma: A line, a hooked stick and a diagonal on the left.

r212.mnemo: A **tiger**'s head peeking over the kanji: the cross is its ears, the line its forehead and the curved strokes its stripes.
r212.forma: A fortune teller (卜) over a cliff (厂) with a seven (七) inside.

r250.mnemo: A **candy** in your mouth: the box is the mouth and the line inside is the sweet melting on your tongue.
r250.forma: Two sticks crossed by a line, another line inside and a base.

r121.mnemo: A bull's **horn** seen from the front: the fishhook (⺈) is the curved tip and the lined frame is the ridged base.
r121.forma: A fishhook (⺈) over a frame with a cross inside, open at the bottom.

r248.mnemo: A hand holds a freshly snapped **branch**: the cross (十) on top is the leaves and the boomerang (又) below is the hand.
r248.forma: A cross (十) over a boomerang (又).

r213.mnemo: A **minister** bowing before the emperor: his eye looks at the floor, turned and square, never daring to look up.
r213.forma: A turned eye (目), with an open piece on the left.

r188.mnemo: A **warrior** with a hand (手) and a halberd (戈): “Me, and all of us!” he shouts at the front of his army.
r188.forma: A twisted hand (手) stuck to a halberd (戈).

r183.mnemo: A **friend** reaches out a hand: the diagonal is the outstretched arm and the boomerang (又) sits below, because a friend always comes back.
r183.forma: A line and a diagonal over a boomerang (又).

r154.mnemo: A **crown** with a spike on top: the king (王) puts it on and the point sticks out above.
r154.forma: A king (王) with the stick poking out on top.

r241.mnemo: A fishing **boat** from the side: the long hull, the line is the bench and the dots are the rowers.
r241.forma: A long frame with dots and a line inside.

r195.mnemo: A **dirt clod**: soil (土) on top, soil below, and in the middle two strokes crumbling it between your fingers.
r195.forma: Soil (土) on top, two strokes in the middle and soil (土) below.

r197.mnemo: A nine (九) throwing a **ball**: the little dot is the ball in the air, round as a circle.
r197.forma: A nine (九) with a dot inside.

r178.mnemo: The **prison bars** of a cell: two posts and six rails. This is where wrongdoers end up.
r178.forma: Two vertical sticks with three lines on each side.

r229.mnemo: A **greenhouse**: tools from the toolbox (用) turn the soil, and on top, for the first time, a tiny sprout peeks out with its dot.
r229.forma: A toolbox (用) with a line and a dot on top.

r145.mnemo: A **black cat** crosses your path: whiskers on the sides and legs in the middle. A bad omen.
r145.forma: Two middle sticks with two strokes on each side, like whiskers.

r142.mnemo: A hand grips the **lance** at the bottom: the stroke on top is the curved tip, ready to strike.
r142.forma: A small 几 on top of a boomerang (又).

r162.mnemo: A **ladder**: two poles with rungs. You climb one, and another, and one more.
r162.forma: A tall rectangle with two lines inside, on a base.

r192.mnemo: The **executioner** stands by the corpse (尸) and the sharp chili pepper (辛): avoid crime if you don't want to end up here.
r192.forma: A corpse (尸) over a mouth (口), with a chili pepper (辛) on the right.

r163.mnemo: The **big brother**: a huge mouth (口) on a pair of legs (儿). He's always bossing you around.

r140.mnemo: An empty **skull**: a square head and an open jaw. Someone has scooped out the brains.
r140.forma: A frame with a small rectangle inside, open at the bottom.

r201.mnemo: At daybreak the **rooster** crows from the cliff (厂): the two lines are its comb, and below, its tail fans out.
r201.forma: A cliff (厂) with two lines and a tail fanning out below.

r202.mnemo: See that over there? It's a wicker **basket**: the lines are the weave and its two little legs peek out below.
r202.forma: Two sticks with lines inside, a long line and two strokes below.

r153.mnemo: A **trap**: a buried bowl (凵) with a danger X inside. Fall in and it's a disaster.
r153.forma: A bowl (凵) with an X inside.

r166.mnemo: An animal's **footprint** in the mud: the goal (冂) is the outline of the paw and the nook (厶) inside is the pad.
r166.forma: A goal (冂) with a nook (厶) inside.

r175.mnemo: Two trees (木) together: a small **grove** where you can sit in the shade.

r219.mnemo: A **foot** with the knee (口) on top and the ankle below, planted firmly on the ground and ready to walk.
r219.forma: A mouth (口) over a narrow bus stop (止); on the left, ⻊.

r226.mnemo: The sun (日) hides between the grass (艹) above and a giant (大) below: never go into the **thicket** at night.
r226.forma: Grass (艹) over a sun (日) and a giant (大).

r207.mnemo: A **sprout** coming out of the ground: the stem in the middle and two tiny leaves opening to the sides.
r207.forma: A central stick with a U-shaped stroke around it.

r177.mnemo: A **ghost** with a square head and one horn: it floats on legs (儿) and leaves behind a nook (厶) of fog.
r177.forma: A 田 with a stroke on top, legs (儿) and a 厶 on the right.

r222.mnemo: A mattress **coil**: it bends once, bends again and springs up. One thing leads to the next.
r222.forma: A double zigzag stroke and another slanting to the left.

r215.mnemo: Three **packages** stacked in the warehouse: two on the bottom and one on top, ready to sell.
r215.forma: Three mouths (口): one on top and two below.

r210.mnemo: A pregnant **body** seen from the side: the long eye is the belly and the diagonal is the arching back.
r210.forma: A long eye with a slanted stroke on top and a diagonal crossing it.

r220.mnemo: An arrow goes straight through the **bullseye**, right in the center: a stick stuck through the middle of the box.
r220.forma: A box pierced through the center by a stick.

r172.mnemo: A building's **foundation**: the podium (立) on top rests on a goal (冂) filled with tombstones (古).
r172.forma: A podium (立) over a goal (冂) with a 古 inside.

r223.mnemo: A long **beard** hanging from the chin: the line is the jaw and the sticks are the hairs falling down.
r223.forma: A line on top of a frame with four hanging sticks.

r252.mnemo: Half a log cut into a **slice**: the right half, with its stick, two lines and a stroke going down.
r252.forma: A slanted stick with two lines to the right and a leg.

r255.mnemo: A skull (冎) over flesh (月): what's left when the flesh is gone is the **bone**.
r255.forma: A skull (冎) on top of a moon (月).

r228.mnemo: A **padlock** locks the heart (心): the diagonal is the bar through it. Surely nobody will open it.
r228.forma: A heart (心) crossed by a diagonal.

r167.mnemo: Two **dancers** back to back, legs going opposite ways: one to the left and one to the right, on the beat.
r167.forma: A 夕 on the left and a 㐄 on the right.

r208.mnemo: Two hooks tangled like a handwritten **four**: they twist around each other and never let go.
r208.forma: Two vertical strokes with interlocking hooks.

r257.mnemo: A **tin can**: on top, the rifle (𠂉) that shoots it open, and below, the full bowl (凵).
r257.forma: A rifle (𠂉) on top, a stick and a bowl (凵) below.

r216.mnemo: Two **sacks** of rice stacked one on the other, and a stroke holding them so they don't fall.
r216.forma: A short slanted stroke with two little boxes stacked on its right.

r260.mnemo: Someone with a limp leans on a **crutch**: one leg straight and the other bent, with the foot hooked upward.
r260.forma: A line with two legs: the right one bent with a hook upward.

r261.mnemo: A baked clay **tile**: the line is the edge and the curved shape inside is the design fired into it.
r261.forma: A line, a bent stroke and a hook with a dot inside.

r249.mnemo: The **wind** blows under a table (几): inside, a bug (虫) holds on tight so it won't get blown away.
r249.forma: A big table (几) with a bug (虫) inside.

r243.mnemo: A **drifter** with a blanket (冖) on his back and his legs (儿) on the move: he just keeps going.

r251.mnemo: A **fish** dangling from the fishhook (⺈): the field (田) is its scaly body and the four dots are its tail.
r251.forma: A fishhook (⺈), a field (田) and four dots below.

r245.mnemo: You set the **alarm clock** in advance: the マ is the bell and the hook (亅) is the little leg it stands on.
r245.forma: A マ over a hook (亅).

r79.mnemo: The **chief** grabs the baton: his square hand holds the stick, which pierces it and falls diagonally. He's in charge here.
r79.forma: A snout (彐) pierced by a stroke curving down to the left.

r265.mnemo: A mouth (口) shouts with joy over a giant (大): he's just been given a huge **gift**.
r265.forma: A mouth (口) over a zigzag stroke and a giant (大).

r244.mnemo: The sun (日) between sky and ground: the **horizon** stretches from end to end.
r244.forma: A sun (日) between two horizontal lines.

r258.mnemo: A lid (亠) over the yarn (幺): the thread unwinds and drops into a dark, deep **abyss**.

r242.mnemo: An **owl** wide awake at midnight: the line is the branch, the sun (日) its big round face and the diagonal its wings. It's getting late.
r242.forma: A line, a sun (日) and a stroke crossing it diagonally below.

r253.mnemo: A **melon** hanging from the vine: two stems on the sides and the fat fruit dropping in the middle.
r253.forma: A claw (爪) with a hook and a dot in the middle.

k私.mnemo: I hide a stalk of **grain** in my private **nook**. Who knows where it is? Only **I** do.
k私.mnemo_lectura: You spot a fluffy sheep and gasp: “**What a she**ep! It looks just like **me**!”: わたし.

k猫.mnemo: A **dog** chases something hiding in the **grass** of a **field**. Out it shoots, hissing, tail puffed up: it was a **cat**.
k猫.mnemo_lectura: Your **cat** drapes itself around your **neck**. “**O**h, a warm scarf!”: ねこ.

k何.mnemo: A **person** sees a huge **gold star** on their Japanese test and can't believe it: “**What**?”
k何.mnemo_lectura: “**What**? Speak up!” shouts deaf old **Nan**: なん (on its own, なに).

k人.mnemo: Two strokes leaning together like a pair of striding legs: no head, no arms, but it's already a **person**.
k人.mnemo_lectura: A **person** from every country orders a **gin**: 日本人, アメリカ人… nationalities end in: じん.
k人.nota: Don't confuse it with 入 (enter): in 人 the long stroke is on the left.

k本.mnemo: A line, **one**, marks the root of the **tree**: from that genuine trunk comes the paper of your **book**.
k本.mnemo_lectura: You're reading a **book** about **Hon**da motorcycles: ほん.
k本.nota: Without the line it's 木 (tree); with two lines on top, it's 未 (not yet).

k日.mnemo: A **sun** stuck in a window: it rises on one side, crosses the sky and sets. That takes one **day**.
k日.mnemo_lectura: Every **day** the sun warms your **knee**: 日本 starts with に (in 毎日 it's にち).
k日.nota: Don't confuse it with 目 (eye), which has two lines inside, or with 白 (white), which has a stroke on top.

k名.mnemo: In the **evening** no one can see you, so you open your **mouth** and shout, so they'll know you by your **name**.
k名.mnemo_lectura: They ask your **name** and you just shrug: “**Nah**…”: な (名前). In 有名, めい.
k名.nota: Don't confuse it with 各 (each): 名 has evening (夕), 各 has a sled (夂).

k前.mnemo: A bug with **antennae** slices the **moon** with a **knife** in the middle of the street: everyone pushes to the **front** to watch.
k前.mnemo_lectura: “**Mae**stro, step to the **front**!”: まえ (名前).

k先.mnemo: A **cow** with an athlete's **legs** bolts off at the start and leaves the herd behind: she's always **ahead**.
k先.mnemo_lectura: The **sen**sei always walks **ahead**: せん (先生).

k生.mnemo: In the **cradle**, a newborn wails: a **life** begins right there.
k生.mnemo_lectura: “**Say** hi!” you tell the newborn. Its whole **life** starts now: せい (先生, 人生).

k友.mnemo: A hand (ナ) throws you a **boomerang** and you throw it back: no words needed, you've made a **friend**.
k友.mnemo_lectura: Your **friend** **Tom** is always there for you: とも (友達).
k友.nota: Don't confuse it with 反 (against), which has a cliff (厂) instead of the hand.

k達.mnemo: A flock moves down the **road**: each **sheep** treads the **soil** behind another. It's not just one anymore: it's **plural**.
k達.mnemo_lectura: You and your pals (友達) always go **Dutch** at dinner: だち.

k誰.mnemo: A **turkey** texts you **words** from a blocked number. Annoyed, you reply: “**Who**?”
k誰.mnemo_lectura: “**Who** ate my cake?” “**Darre**n did!”: だれ (誰).

k見.mnemo: A giant **eye** on **legs** wanders down the street, snooping around: it wants to **see** everything.
k見.mnemo_lectura: To **see** yourself, first find a **mi**rror: み (見る).
k見.nota: Don't confuse it with 貝 (shell): 見 ends in legs (儿), 貝 in two little feet.

k食.mnemo: A little roof over a full bowl: it's **food**, and it smells so good you just have to **eat**.
k食.mnemo_lectura: You **eat** everything dipped in **ta**hini: た (食べる).

k飲.mnemo: Next to your **food**, a huge **yawn**: your mouth opens so wide you could swallow the glass. Time to **drink**.
k飲.mnemo_lectura: A good **drink**? **No** rush, sip it slowly: の (飲む).

k読.mnemo: A **scholar** sits under a **blanket** with crossed **legs**, murmuring **words** softly: all night long, all he does is **read**.
k読.mnemo_lectura: You **read** so long you let out a huge **yaw**n: よ (読む).
k読.nota: Don't confuse it with 続 (continue): same 売, but with thread (糸) instead of words.

k書.mnemo: You dip your **brush** and write under the **sun** until the ink dries: all day long, all you do is **write**.
k書.mnemo_lectura: You **write** your own **ka**raoke lyrics: か (書く).
k書.nota: Don't confuse it with 昼 (noon), which is shorter and has no brush.

k水.mnemo: A stream falls down the middle and splashes out to both sides: it's **water**.
k水.mnemo_lectura: The elephant sprays you. “Why **me**? The **zoo** has plenty of **water**!”: みず (水). In 水曜日, すい.
k水.nota: Don't confuse it with 氷 (ice), which has one extra dot.

k行.mnemo: A **walker** hammers **one** **nail** after another into the ground to mark the route: that's the way he'll **go**.
k行.mnemo_lectura: “**Ee**k, a mouse! Let's **go**!”: い (行く). In 行動, こう.

k来.mnemo: A **tree** sprouts **antennae** on its crown and starts walking toward you: it's about to **come**.
k来.mnemo_lectura: Next year (来年) the **rye** harvest will finally **come**: らい.

k家.mnemo: A **pig** sleeping under a **roof**: in ancient China, that was already a **house**.
k家.mnemo_lectura: Back at your **house**, you flop on the couch: “**Yeah**…”: いえ. In 家族, か.

k好.mnemo: A **woman** hugs her **child** and melts: of everything in the world, that's what she'll always **like** most.
k好.mnemo_lectura: What do you **like**? **Sushi**! Keep just its first syllable: す (好き).

k眠.mnemo: An **eye** watches over the people (民) all night, until its lids feel like lead and it finally starts to **fall asleep**.
k眠.mnemo_lectura: The drowsy cow mumbles “**neh**… **moo**…” and begins to **fall asleep**: ねむ(る).
k眠.nota: 寝る means going to bed; 眠る means actually falling asleep.

k大.mnemo: A **giant** spreads his arms as wide as he can to show you how **big** he is.
k大.mnemo_lectura: You order a **big** **dai**quiri: だい (大好き, 大事).
k大.nota: Don't confuse it with 犬 (dog, dot on top) or 太 (fat, dot below).

k学.mnemo: A **child** curls up under a **blanket** while **small** sparks of ideas crackle above: even asleep, he never stops trying to **learn**.
k学.mnemo_lectura: You **learn** so much that you just stand there and **gawk**: がく (in 学校 it shrinks: がっ).
k学.nota: Don't confuse it with 字 (character): 学 has the three sparks on top.

k校.mnemo: Next to a **tree**, under a tin **lid**, your **father** plays teacher: that's your very first **school**.
k校.mnemo_lectura: Every kid hangs a **coat** on a hook at **school**: こう (学校).

palabras.furigana: 小学校[しょうがっこう]

k高.mnemo: A **lid**, a **mouth**, a **goal** with another **mouth** inside: floor after floor stacked up to the sky. A **tall** building.
k高.mnemo_lectura: A **taco** stand on a **tall** tower, and pricey too: たか (高い).

k新.mnemo: You climb the **podium**, chop down a **tree** with your **axe** and carve a freshly varnished trophy from it: it smells brand **new**.
k新.mnemo_lectura: **At a ra**ve, everyone shows up in something **new**: あたら(しい).

k当.mnemo: You toss three **small** darts at the pig's **snout** at the fair: jackpot, another **hit**.
k当.mnemo_lectura: Another **hit**! You jump for joy and stub your **toe**: とう (本当). If something hits you, あ (当たる).

k勉.mnemo: No **doctor's note** to skip class, so you flex your **muscle** and hit the books with all your **effort**.
k勉.mnemo_lectura: **Ben** never skips class. His secret? Pure **effort**: べん (勉強).

k強.mnemo: A tiny **bug** hiding in a **nook** draws a giant **bow** without breaking a sweat: what a **strong** little bug.
k強.mnemo_lectura: A **strong** karate kid from **Kyo**to smashes a board with one kick: きょう (勉強).

k語.mnemo: **Five** guys shout **words** nobody understands out of a single **mouth**: each one in his own **language**.
k語.mnemo_lectura: To learn a **language**, your teacher cheers you on: “**Go**, go, go!”: ご. In 語る it turns into かた.

k字.mnemo: Under the school **roof**, a **child** copies the same thing a hundred times in his notebook: one **character**.
k字.mnemo_lectura: Every new **character** you learn earns a “**Gee**, I got it!”: じ, as in 文字.
k字.nota: 学 (learn) also has a child below, but with a different top.

k今.mnemo: Under the roof of a **person** with open arms, a line (**one**) and a crooked seven (フ): 1:07 on the dot. Not later: **now**.
k今.mnemo_lectura: Don't wait until tomorrow: **ima**gine it right **now**: いま.
k今.nota: Looks like 会 (meeting), but 今 ends in a crooked seven and 会 in a cloud (云).

k明.mnemo: The **sun** and the **moon** light up the sky at the same time: not one dark corner left, everything is **bright**.
k明.mnemo_lectura: Everything looks **bright** and clear in **May**: めい (説明).

k言.mnemo: A lid, three stacked lines of **words**, and a mouth underneath: whatever comes out of there is something to **say**.
k言.mnemo_lectura: “What do you **say**?” “**Ee**…” and your mind goes blank: い (言う). In 言葉, こと.

k思.mnemo: Sitting in your **field** with a hand on your **heart**, you spend the whole afternoon doing nothing but **think**.
k思.mnemo_lectura: “**Oh, Mo**m, I **think** I'm in love!”: おも (思う).

k二.mnemo: A short line above a long one: count them and you get **two**.
k二.mnemo_lectura: You have **two** **knee**s: に (二, 二度と).

k自.mnemo: To say “me” in Japan, you point at your **nose**: that's how you mean your own **self**.
k自.mnemo_lectura: Your**self** behind the wheel of your very own **Jee**p: じ (自分).
k自.nota: Don't confuse it with 目 (eye): 自 has a short stroke on top.

k分.mnemo: A **knife** cuts the pizza into **eight** equal slices: the fair way to **divide** it.
k分.mnemo_lectura: When you **divide** the snacks, your brother grabs the biggest **bun**: ぶん (自分, 気分).

k彼.mnemo: A **walker** wrapped in a bear **skin** strolls off down the street. Everyone whispers about that mystery guy: “Who is **he**?”
k彼.mnemo_lectura: **He** always smells like **curry** (カレー). Chop off its tail and you're left with: かれ.

k中.mnemo: A **stick** pierces a **mouth** right through the middle and stays stuck there, **inside**.
k中.mnemo_lectura: A **knock**, **a**nother knock, from **inside** the box. Who's in there?: なか (中).

k三.mnemo: **One** on top of **two**: add them up and you get **three**.
k三.mnemo_lectura: Three suns blaze over the desert: **sun**, **sun**, **sun**. That makes **three**: さん (三).

k時.mnemo: When the **sun** peeks over the **temple**, the monk rings the bell: that's how he tells the **time**.
k時.mnemo_lectura: Instead of “cuckoo,” the clock pops out and yells “**Gee**, look at the **time**!”: じ.
k時.nota: Same 寺 as 持 (hold) and 待 (wait): look at the left side.

k間.mnemo: The **sun** slips through the gap between the two doors of a **gate**: that sliver of light is an **interval**.
k間.mnemo_lectura: Between the two doors sits a **can** of soda: a short **interval** for a sip: かん (時間).
k間.nota: With an ear (耳) inside it's 聞 (hear); with a mouth (口), 問 (question); with a torii (开), 開 (open).

k知.mnemo: You ask a question, and the answer flies out of his **mouth** like an **arrow**, no hesitation: that guy must **know**.
k知.mnemo_lectura: Who **knows** the answer? “**She** does!”: し (知る).

k出.mnemo: A **mountain** grows and grows inside a **bowl** until it doesn't fit anymore and has to **exit**.
k出.mnemo_lectura: You **exit** through the back **de**ck: で (出る). Taking something out? “**Da**d, hand it over!”: だ (出す).

k使.mnemo: A **person** sticks **one** of his **five** fingers into the robot's **mouth** to switch it on: at last he knows how to **use** it.
k使.mnemo_lectura: Moving day? You **use** **two car**s to haul it all: つか (使う).
k使.nota: Don't confuse it with 便 (convenient): 使 has the mouth (口) up top, fully closed.

k十.mnemo: A perfect cross: a plus sign, or a Roman X standing up straight. It's worth **ten**.
k十.mnemo_lectura: You chug **ten** cartons of **ju**ice: じゅう (十, 十分).
k十.nota: Don't confuse it with 千 (thousand), which has a slanted stroke on top, or with 土 (soil).

k聞.mnemo: You press your **ear** to the crack in the **gate**: whatever happens inside, you're going to **hear** it.
k聞.mnemo_lectura: You put your ear to the **key**hole to **hear** the secret: き (聞く).
k聞.nota: Inside the gate: ear (耳) in 聞, sun (日) in 間, mouth (口) in 問, torii (开) in 開.

k子.mnemo: A baby swaddled in cloth, head up and little arms spread: it's a **child**.
k子.mnemo_lectura: The **child** begs for hot **co**coa: こ (子供).
k子.nota: Don't confuse it with 字 (character) or 学 (learn): both have a 子 inside.

k供.mnemo: A **person** hands out **twenty** gifts among **eight** neighbors: what they love most is to **offer**.
k供.mnemo_lectura: The kids (子供) play **dominoes** all afternoon: ども. On its own, とも.

k取.mnemo: You throw a **boomerang** and it comes back with an **ear** hooked on it: the trophy warriors once had to **take**.
k取.mnemo_lectura: You **take** a ripe **to**mato from the garden: と (取る).
k取.nota: Don't confuse it with 最 (most), which is 取 with a sun (日) on top.

k仕.mnemo: A **person** stands beside the **scholar** and carries his books: he's there to **serve**.
k仕.mnemo_lectura: The butler **serve**s you breakfast in bed on a fresh **shee**t: し (仕事).
k仕.nota: Don't confuse it with 住 (reside): 仕 has a scholar (士); 住, a king with a drop (主).

k事.mnemo: A line, **one**, a **mouth** and a **snout** strung on a butcher's **hook**: now this is a serious **matter**.
k事.mnemo_lectura: To settle the **matter**, a round of **ji**u-jitsu: じ (大事, 事実). On its own, こと.

k置.mnemo: You scoop up **ten** bulging **eyes** with a **net**, and now you have no idea where to **put** them.
k置.mnemo_lectura: You **put** the vase on the table and everyone goes “**Oh**!”: お (置く).

k後.mnemo: A **walker** drags some **yarn** tied to a **sled**: he always shows up last, **after** everyone else.
k後.mnemo_lectura: **After** school, **go**-karts!: ご (最後, 今後). “Later” is あと.

k五.mnemo: A crooked X wedged between the lines of **two**: that's how you draw **five**.

k作.mnemo: A **person** grabs a **handsaw**: cutting, sanding, nailing… what they truly love is to **make** things.
k作.mnemo_lectura: “It **took** me all week to **make** this birdhouse!”: つく (作る). In 作戦, さく.
k作.nota: Same handsaw (乍) as 昨 (yesterday): with a person it's make; with the sun, yesterday.

k問.mnemo: A **mouth** peeks out between the doors of the **gate** and won't let you through until you answer its **question**.
k問.mnemo_lectura: A **Mon**day morning pop quiz with one tough **question**: もん (問題, 質問).
k問.nota: Inside the gate: mouth (口) in 問, ear (耳) in 聞, sun (日) in 間.

k題.mnemo: Under the **sun**, **one** reader makes a **bus stop** at every **page** of the book: he's hunting for the **topic**.
k題.mnemo_lectura: Today's **topic**: how to roll a **die**: だい (問題, 話題).

k女.mnemo: A figure sitting cross-legged with open arms, all the grace in the world: it's a **woman**.
k女.mnemo_lectura: On its own it's おんな, but that **woman** goes by **Jo**: じょ (彼女, 女性).

k同.mnemo: A **clone** steps out of the machine and stands next to you: same face, same clothes, every detail the **same**.
k同.mnemo_lectura: Two lumps of **dough**, exactly the **same**: どう (同様, 同士). “The same”: おな(じ).

k話.mnemo: **Words** shoot off a **tongue** that won't sit still: nobody can shut it up, it just wants to **talk**.
k話.mnemo_lectura: You **talk** on the phone with your mouth full of **wa**ffle: わ (電話, 会話).

k考.mnemo: An **old man** with a **light bulb** glowing over his head sits on the porch to **ponder**.
k考.mnemo_lectura: A **kanga**roo curls up in its own pouch to **ponder** life: かんが (考える).
k考.nota: Don't confuse it with 老 (old) or 者 (person): all three have the old man (耂) on top.

k入.mnemo: You lift the flap of a **teepee** and duck your head to **enter**.
k入.mnemo_lectura: You **enter** the room with a “**Hi**!”: はい (入る). To put something in, “**Ee**k, it's full!”: い (入れる, 入り口).
k入.nota: Don't confuse it with 人 (person): in 入 the long stroke is on the right.

k金.mnemo: Under the little roof of a **person**, a **king** counts two **drops** of molten gold, one on each side: all he loves is **money**.
k金.mnemo_lectura: The millionaire's walking **cane** is stuffed with **money**: かね.

k買.mnemo: You carry a **net** full of money in the form of **shells**: you head straight to the market to **buy**.
k買.mnemo_lectura: At the register, you **buy** it all: “**Ka**-ching!”: か (買う, 買い物).
k買.nota: Don't confuse it with 貝 (shell) on its own: 買 has the net (罒) on top.

k目.mnemo: Turn an **eye** ninety degrees: a tall rectangle with two lines for lashes. Still an **eye**.
k目.mnemo_lectura: The **eye** rolls and sighs: “**Meh**.”: め (目).
k目.nota: Don't confuse it with 日 (day, one line inside) or 自 (self, with a stroke on top).

k気.mnemo: **Steam** puffs out of the **rifle** barrel and draws the X of **five** in the air: with that much energy, your **spirit** shoots up.
k気.mnemo_lectura: In high **spirit**s, you bite into a **ki**wi: き (元気, 気持ち).

k一.mnemo: A single line lying on the ground, no frills: count it and you get **one**.
k一.mnemo_lectura: Number **one** can't stop scratching: “So **itchy**!”: いち (一番).

k多.mnemo: One **evening** stacked on another **evening**: so many days you've lost count of how **many**.
k多.nota: Don't confuse it with a single 夕 (evening), or with 名 (name), which has a mouth.

k少.mnemo: Something already **small** loses a crumb that zooms off down a **slide**: now there are only a **few** left.
k少.mnemo_lectura: Just a **few** drops of **Sco**tch, it's strong: すこ (少し).
k少.nota: Don't confuse it with 小 (small): 少 has one extra stroke sweeping down.

k手.mnemo: Five open fingers and a wrist that ends in a hook: a **hand** is waving at you.
k手.nota: Don't confuse it with 毛 (hair): in 手 the bottom stroke is a hook.

k上.mnemo: The **fortune teller** jumps on top of the line, **one**, and points his finger **up**.
k上.mnemo_lectura: You reach the top and look **up**: “**Ah**!”: あ (上げる, 上がる). The spot above you, うえ.
k上.nota: Its opposite is 下 (down): the same drawing, flipped.

k車.mnemo: Seen from above: a cart with two wheels joined by an axle. The **car** element stands alone and means **car**.
k車.nota: 東 (east, ひがし) looks similar, but has a sun (日) and tree legs.

k僕.mnemo: A **person** hauls a **hedgehog**, some **antennae**, and even the boss's **husband**: the do-it-all helper, a humble **servant**.
k僕.mnemo_lectura: A **servant** brings you a steaming plate of **bok** choy: ぼく (僕).
k僕.nota: 僕 (ぼく) is a soft “I” for boys; 俺 (おれ) sounds tougher.

k悪.mnemo: A **heart** locked under a two-door cabinet (亜): after so long in the dark, it's turned **bad**.
k悪.mnemo_lectura: The movie's **bad** guy coughs like a cat with a hairball: “**Ack**!”: あく (最悪, 悪魔).

k葉.mnemo: **Grass** from all over the **world** climbs up a **tree**: from every branch sprouts a **leaf**.
k葉.mnemo_lectura: A **leaf** lands on a sheep's nose: “**Baa**!”: ば (言葉). On its own, は.

k万.mnemo: Under a giant **one** hangs a **wrapping**, and inside there are bills: **ten thousand**, not one less.
k万.mnemo_lectura: With **ten thousand** coins, the **man** buys a mansion (well, a tiny piece of one): まん.
k万.nota: 方 (direction) has a dot on top: don't mix them up!

k男.mnemo: The one putting his **muscle** into the rice **field**, according to the ancient drawing, is the **man**.
k男.mnemo_lectura: **Otto**'s **co**at: that **man** never takes it off: おとこ (男). In 男性, だん.

k必.mnemo: A **heart** pierced side to side by a **slide**: you're going to fall in love, **without fail**.
k必.mnemo_lectura: Your song will be a **hit**, **without fail**: ひつ (必要; in 必死 it shrinks to ひっ).
k必.nota: Don't confuse it with 心 (heart): 必 has a diagonal slashing through it.

k要.mnemo: A **woman** dressed as a **cowboy** crosses the desert with water, a hat, and a horse: the bare minimum she'll **need**.
k要.mnemo_lectura: All you **need** for breakfast: a **yo**gurt: よう (必要, 重要).

k六.mnemo: A **lid** on top of an open **eight**: take two away from eight and you're left with **six**.
k六.mnemo_lectura: **Six** guitar strings and lots of **rock**: ろく (六).

k電.mnemo: In the middle of the **rain**, a bolt of **lightning** with a twisted tail strikes and turns on every bulb in the neighborhood: pure **electricity**.
k電.mnemo_lectura: The storm cuts the **electricity**, so you hide in your **den** with a flashlight: でん, as in 電話.
k電.nota: 雷 (thunder, かみなり) has a field with no tail under the rain.

palabras.furigana: 携帯電話[けいたいでんわ]

k会.mnemo: One **person** after another squeezes under the same **cloud** to stay dry and, packed in tight, the **meeting** begins.
k会.mnemo_lectura: At the **meeting** you spot your friend: “**Ah**, hi!”: あ (会う). In 会話, かい.
k会.nota: Looks like 今 (now), but 会 ends in a cloud (云).

k方.mnemo: The **compass** needle spins like crazy and finally stops: it's pointing you in a **direction**.
k方.mnemo_lectura: A wolf faces one **direction** and howls: “**Ho**ooo!”: ほう (方法). For a polite “person,” かた.

k教.mnemo: A grumpy **old man** watches a **child** with a **whip** in hand: that's his old-school way to **teach**.
k教.mnemo_lectura: Look at that teacher go. “**Oh, she** loves to **teach**!”: おし (教える). In 教室, きょう.

k帰.mnemo: You put away the **knife**, cover the pig's **snout** with a **blanket**, take off your **scarf**: the work's done, time to **return**.
k帰.mnemo_lectura: Time to **return** home. “Taking the **car, eh**?”: かえ (帰る).
k帰.nota: 帰る (go home) and 返す (give back) both start with かえ, but they never mix: one is you coming back, the other is an object.

k次.mnemo: Shivering on the **ice**, you let out a huge **yawn** in line at the doctor's: “Who's **next**?”
k次.mnemo_lectura: Two geese waddle into the waiting room. The nurse calls: “**Two geese**? You're **next**!”: つぎ.

k八.mnemo: Two strokes spread out like a tent; count the tent stakes and there are **eight**.
k八.mnemo_lectura: You sneeze **eight** times in a row: “**Ha-choo**!”: はち (八).
k八.nota: Don't confuse it with 人 (person) or 入 (enter): in 八 the strokes don't touch.

k違.mnemo: On the **road** you find a **belt**, you put it on and… no, it's not yours: it's **different**.
k違.mnemo_lectura: “This isn't **Chica**go, it's totally **different**!”: ちが (違う).

k持.mnemo: A giant **hand** grabs the whole **temple** like a toy model and won't let go: now it's his to **hold**.
k持.mnemo_lectura: You **hold** a hot **mo**cha in both hands: も (持つ).
k持.nota: Same 寺 as 時 (time) and 待 (wait): with a hand (扌), it means hold.

k緒.mnemo: An **old man** soaks up the **sun**, tied with a **thread** to his grandson: they go everywhere together, joined by a **cord**.
k緒.mnemo_lectura: You and your buddy always go **sho**pping together, tied by an invisible **cord**: (いっ)しょ.

k番.mnemo: You pass the dirt of the **field** through a **sieve**, handful by handful; when you finish, the next person gets their **turn**.
k番.mnemo_lectura: You wait your **turn** in line at the **ban**k: ばん (一番).

k長.mnemo: **Long hair** that reaches the floor and keeps dragging behind you: it's so **long**.
k長.mnemo_lectura: A super **long** bar of **cho**colate: ちょう (成長, 長). Long: なが(い).

k顔.mnemo: On a **podium** at the edge of a **cliff**, a guy with **three hairs** on his chin peeks out from behind a **page**: what a **face**!
k顔.mnemo_lectura: One punch and he's **K.O.**, flat on his **face**: かお (顔).

k欲.mnemo: You eat a whole **valley** and still open your mouth in a **yawn**: always more, there's always something you **crave**.
k欲.mnemo_lectura: Whatever you **crave**, Santa brings it: “**Ho**, ho, ho!”: ほ (欲しい).

k待.mnemo: A worn-out **walker** reaches the **temple**, and the monks point him to a bench: he'll have to **wait**.
k待.mnemo_lectura: You always have to **wait** for **Ma**; she's never on time: ま (待つ).
k待.nota: Same 寺 as 時 (time) and 持 (hold): the walker (彳) on the left is the one who waits.

k乗.mnemo: A giant stalk of **grain**, with a **plank** tied to one side and a **spoon** to the other, rolls through the city: it's the village bus. Dare to **ride**?
k乗.mnemo_lectura: The driver grins: “**No** **ru**les on this **ride**!”: のる.

k意.mnemo: The **sound** coming from your **heart** tells what you really want: your **intention**.
k意.mnemo_lectura: Your **intention** was good, but you slipped on an **ee**l: い (意味, 意見).

k味.mnemo: You bite into an **unripe fruit** and your whole **mouth** puckers: what a **flavor**!
k味.mnemo_lectura: The **flavor** is so good you sing “do, re, **mi**”: み (意味, 興味). On its own, あじ.
k味.nota: Don't confuse it with 妹 (younger sister), which has a woman (女) instead of a mouth.

k母.mnemo: A tilted box with two little dots inside, like two breasts: the one who fed you is your **mother**.
k母.mnemo_lectura: Your **mother** laughs at all your bad jokes: “**Ha ha**!”: はは (politely, お母さん: かあ).
k母.nota: Don't confuse it with 毎 (every), which has a rifle (𠂉) on top.

k部.mnemo: The **town** is split into zones, each with a sign that bans **spit**. Every zone is one **part**.
k部.mnemo_lectura: Every **part** of the stadium boos the rival team: “**Boo**!”: ぶ (全部, 部分).

k屋.mnemo: A mannequin **corpse** lies in the doorway, marking the **finish line** of your stroll: you've reached the **shop**.
k屋.mnemo_lectura: At the ramen **shop**, the cooks greet you with a loud “**Yah**!”: や (部屋, 屋敷).

k呼.mnemo: You open your **mouth** and zoom down a **slide** wearing **antennae**, hanging from a **hook**, yelling to **call** your friends.
k呼.mnemo_lectura: Someone **call**s your name and you answer: “**Yo**!”: よ (呼ぶ).

k九.mnemo: An arm bent with the fist raised, like a cat bragging about all its lives: it has **nine**.
k九.mnemo_lectura: Rack the balls, grab your **cue**, and sink the **nine**: きゅう (九).
k九.nota: Don't confuse it with 丸 (round), which is 九 with a dot inside.

k父.mnemo: Two strokes like a mustache over an X of crossed arms: the pose of the boss of the house, your **father**.
k父.mnemo_lectura: Your **father** makes you say “**Cheese**, **cheese**!” in every photo: ちち (politely, お父さん: とう).
k父.nota: Don't confuse it with 文 (writing): 父 has two strokes in a V on top, 文 has a lid.

k終.mnemo: The **thread** snags on a **sled** sliding across the **ice** until it snaps: that's it, the **end**.
k終.mnemo_lectura: When the game **ends**, the whole stadium groans: “**Oh**, no!”: お (終わる).

k歩.mnemo: A **bus stop** after every **pinch** of road: step by step, no rush, that's how you learn to **walk**.
k歩.mnemo_lectura: You set out to **walk** all the way to **Aru**ba: ある (歩く).

k声.mnemo: A **scholar** sits beside a **corpse** and talks to it all night long, until the dead man gets his **voice** back.
k声.mnemo_lectura: The **co-e**d choir sings with a single **voice**: こえ (声).

k頭.mnemo: You doodle a stick figure: a **page** for a body and a giant **bean** for a **head**.
k頭.mnemo_lectura: Splat! **A toma**to lands right on your **head**: あたま (頭).

k切.mnemo: A sharp **seven** and a **knife** face off in the kitchen: who's faster when it's time to **cut**?
k切.mnemo_lectura: One **cut** and the **ki**lt becomes a miniskirt: き(る).

k国.mnemo: You lock the **king** and his jewel inside a walled **fence**: that's already a **country**.
k国.mnemo_lectura: A pigeon **coo**s on your **knee**: the national bird of your **country**: くに (国).
k国.nota: Don't confuse it with 困 (trouble), which has a tree (木) inside the fence.

k写.mnemo: You throw a black **blanket** over your head, like old-time photographers, and give (与) the button a press: the camera manages to **copy** the scene.
k写.mnemo_lectura: The camera **copies** everything, even your **sha**dow: しゃ, as in 写真.

k真.mnemo: An **eye** with a **ten** painted on its forehead climbs onto a board (**one**) held up by **eight** little legs: it's the lie detector. Only the **truth** gets through.
k真.mnemo_lectura: The **truth** hurts, like a kick in the **shin**: しん, as in 写真, 真剣 and 真実.
k真.nota: 直 (straight) also has 十 and an eye, but it rests on an L, with no little legs.

k忘.mnemo: You put your **heart** in a **coffin** and bury it: whatever you felt, you've just chosen to **forget**.
k忘.mnemo_lectura: “Uh, what **was** I saying?” You **forget** again: わす (忘れる).
k忘.nota: Same coffin (亡) as 忙 (busy): in 忘 the heart goes underneath.

k始.mnemo: A **woman** steps out of her **nook**, opens her **mouth** and gives the signal: the race is about to **begin**.
k始.mnemo_lectura: Every recipe you **begin** turns into a **hodge**podge: はじ (始める).

k体.mnemo: A **person** hugs a **tree** with a line, **one**, marking its roots: trunk, branches, and roots, just like their own **body**.
k体.mnemo_lectura: Your **body** begs for a **Thai** massage: たい (一体, 身体). The whole body: からだ.
k体.nota: Don't confuse it with 休 (rest): 体 has the extra line low on the tree (本).

k働.mnemo: A **person** lifts a **barbell** with pure **muscle**, again and again, eight hours a day: it's not the gym, it's **work**.
k働.mnemo_lectura: You **work** all day to a trumpet tune: “**Ha**, **ta-ra**, **coo**!”: はたらく.

k以.mnemo: A **duckling** lets a **drop** fall on the floor and a **person** circles it in chalk: from now on, everything is measured from that **reference point**.
k以.mnemo_lectura: Take the letter **E** as your **reference point**: い (以上, 以外, 以前).

k夜.mnemo: Under a black **lid**, a **person** watches the **evening** fade out completely: now it's **night**.
k夜.mnemo_lectura: Dress up, tonight is **your** **night**: よる (夜).

k昨.mnemo: You cut the **sun** in two with a **handsaw**, and one half stays behind in **yesterday**.
k昨.mnemo_lectura: 昨日 (きのう) and 昨夜 (ゆうべ) are read whole, by heart. Elsewhere, **yesterday**'s sun went into a **sack**: サク.
k昨.nota: Same handsaw (乍) as 作 (make): here it comes with a sun, because it's about the day.

k立.mnemo: They call you up to the **podium** for your medal, and there's no excuse: you have to **stand**.
k立.mnemo_lectura: You **stand** up from the couch and yell “**Ta**-da!”: た (立つ).

k活.mnemo: A **tongue** splashes in fresh **water** and leaps like a fish: now that's **vitality**.
k活.mnemo_lectura: A box of kittens bouncing off the walls: **cats** full of **vitality**: かつ.

k住.mnemo: A **person** settles next to a **king** with a burning **drop** of oil on his crown: where there's light, that's where they want to **reside**.
k住.mnemo_lectura: Where do you **reside**? At **Sue**'s place, of course: す (住む).
k住.nota: Don't confuse it with 主 (master), which is the same without the person (亻).

k店.mnemo: Under a **shed**, a **fortune teller** opens her **mouth** and reads your palm for two bucks: she's set up her own **store**.
k店.mnemo_lectura: “Who runs this **store**?” “**Me**,” **sa**ys the fortune teller: みせ.

k早.mnemo: The **sun** rises over the cross of **ten**: it's ten o'clock and you're already late. You should have gotten up **early**!
k早.mnemo_lectura: You get up **early** and greet the sun: “**Hi-ya**!”: はや (早い).
k早.nota: 早い means early; 速い (with the road) means fast. Both are read はやい.

k初.mnemo: Before sewing a **kimono**, the **knife** has to make a cut: the very **first**.
k初.mnemo_lectura: “**Ha**! **Gee**, I got it on the **first** try!”: はじ (初めて). In 最初, しょ.
k初.nota: 初めて (for the first time) and 始める (to begin) sound the same: 初 is the first time; 始 is getting something started.

k単.mnemo: Three **small** sparks over a **field** stuck on a **ten**: a kid's drawing, as **simple** as it gets.
k単.mnemo_lectura: As **simple** as lying in the sun to get a **tan**: たん (簡単, 単純).

k族.mnemo: With a **compass**, a **rifle** and an **arrow**, they cross the desert together: not tourists, a **tribe**.
k族.mnemo_lectura: The whole **tribe** visits the **zoo** and says “**coo**l!”: ぞく (家族).
k族.nota: Don't confuse it with 旅 (trip): same compass and rifle, but 族 has an arrow (矢).

k受.mnemo: A **claw** reaches down over a **blanket** and drops the **boomerang** into your hand: all you do is **receive**.
k受.mnemo_lectura: You **receive** the gift and gasp: “**Oo**h, for me?”: う (受ける).
k受.nota: Don't confuse it with 愛 (love), which has a heart in the middle.

k場.mnemo: You plant a **flag** in the **soil** under a blazing **sun**: this is your **place**.
k場.mnemo_lectura: The perfect **place** to meet up: a **ba**r: ば (場所, 場合).
k場.nota: Don't confuse it with 湯 (hot water), which has water (氵) instead of soil.

k合.mnemo: A **person** with open arms and a line (**one**) close right over the **mouth** of the jar: everything starts to **fit**.
k合.mnemo_lectura: When it all **fit**s together, you say: “**Ah**, of course!”: あ (合う, 似合う).
k合.nota: Looks like 今 (now) and 会 (meeting): 合 ends in a mouth (口).

k変.mnemo: A **swing** tied to a **sled**: one second it flies, the next it drags. It's always about to **change**.
k変.mnemo_lectura: You **change** your **ca**r every week: か (変える, 変わる). Something weird? A **hen** in the back seat: へん (変).

k世.mnemo: Three generations holding hands under one line: together they make up the **world**.
k世.mnemo_lectura: The whole **world** has something to **say**: せ (世界).

k界.mnemo: At the edge of the **field**, a **person** plants a **stick** and a **slide**: nobody goes past here, it's the **boundary**.
k界.mnemo_lectura: At the river's **boundary**, a **kay**ak waits to cross: かい (世界, 限界).

palabras.furigana: 世界大戦[せかいたいせん]

k寝.mnemo: Under the **roof**, you rest your **snout** on a **plank**, pull up a **blanket** and throw a **boomerang** at the clock: time to **sleep**.
k寝.mnemo_lectura: To **sleep** on the plane, you need a **ne**ck pillow: ね (寝る).

k結.mnemo: A **scholar** with **thread** between the teeth of his **mouth** makes knots at top speed: his one and only talent is to **tie**.
k結.mnemo_lectura: You **tie** the **ketch**up bottle shut so nothing leaks: けつ, shortened to けっ before another consonant.
