k婚.mnemo: A **woman** embroiders her **family crest** under the June **sun**: she'll wear it on her veil on the day of her **wedding**.
k婚.mnemo_lectura: At the **wedding**, there's **con**fetti everywhere: こん.

k走.mnemo: The **runner** bolts off the starting block: the only thing he knows how to do is **run**.
k走.mnemo_lectura: You go for a **run** and post it with a **hash**tag: はし (走る).

k朝.mnemo: On the **calendar** you can still see the **moon**, but the sun peeks through the crosses: it's **morning**.
k朝.mnemo_lectura: Every **morning** your boss wants it **ASA**P: あさ (朝).

k転.mnemo: A **car** drives onto a **cloud**, loses its balance and tumbles down the hillside, flipping end over end: all it can do is **roll**.
k転.mnemo_lectura: A **Colo**rado boulder breaks loose and starts to **roll** downhill: ころ(がる).
k転.nota: 伝 (convey, つたえる) has the same cloud with a person.

palabras.furigana: 運転免許[うんてんめんきょ]

k性.mnemo: The **heart** you had in the **cradle** stays with you forever: it's who you are, your **nature**.
k性.mnemo_lectura: Your true **nature**? A free-spirited **sai**lor: せい (女性, 男性, 性格).
k性.nota: Don't confuse it with 生 (life) alone: 性 adds the heart (忄).

palabras.furigana: 重要性[じゅうようせい]

k心.mnemo: Four strokes that beat: a curve like a cup and three drops jumping out. It's a **heart**.
k心.mnemo_lectura: Your **heart** pounds so hard it kicks your **shin**: しん (心配, 安心). On its own, こころ.
k心.nota: Don't confuse it with 必 (without fail), which is a heart slashed by a diagonal.

k点.mnemo: The **fortune teller** opens his **mouth** and spits **fire**: each spark that lands leaves a **point**.
k点.mnemo_lectura: You score a perfect **ten**, **point** by **point**: てん (点).

k質.mnemo: Two **axes** hack at a **shell** to test it: not a scratch. This shell is top **quality**.
k質.mnemo_lectura: Top **quality** or nothing: “**She**'s **too** picky!” sighs the shop clerk: しつ(もん).

k口.mnemo: A little empty square, open for eating and for yelling: a **mouth**.
k口.mnemo_lectura: The baby's tiny **mouth** goes “**coo**… **chee**…”: くち (口). In 入り口, ぐち.
k口.nota: Don't confuse it with 囗 (fence), the big frame that wraps around other pieces.

k毎.mnemo: Your **mother** wakes you with a **rifle**: bang, seven sharp. Tomorrow too, and the day after: **every** day.
k毎.mnemo_lectura: **My** alarm goes off **every** single morning: まい (毎日).
k毎.nota: Don't confuse it with 母 (mother): 毎 has the rifle (𠂉) on top.

k関.mnemo: At the **gate**, a **giant** with **antennae** controls who gets in: with every neighbor he has some **relation**.
k関.mnemo_lectura: You brag about your **relation** to a movie star at **Cannes**: かん (関係).

k係.mnemo: A **person** pulls the **thread** that runs down a **slide**: if anything tangles, it's up to whoever is **in charge**.
k係.mnemo_lectura: The one **in charge** of the party bakes the **cake**: けい (関係).

k下.mnemo: The **fortune teller** hangs upside down from line **one** and points his finger **below**.
k下.mnemo_lectura: Down **below**, in the basement (地下), you park your **ca**r: か (地下, 廊下). Underneath: した.
k下.nota: Its opposite is 上 (up): the same drawing, flipped over.

k若.mnemo: On the **grass**, a **mouth** rides down the **slide** standing on **one** like a skateboard, yelling “woo-hoo!”: it's clearly **young**.
k若.mnemo_lectura: At the arcade, the **young** kids chant “**Wacka**-**wacka**!”: わか(い).
k若.nota: 苦 (suffer) also has grass on top, but 古 underneath.

k死.mnemo: The **Grim Reaper** sits at your table and stirs the soup with a **spoon**: he's serving you **death**.
k死.mnemo_lectura: **Death** knocks, and **she** is at the door: し (死ぬ, 必死). That's why 4, also read し, feels unlucky in Japan.

k飛.mnemo: A **duckling** flaps its **two hands** like wings, one up, one down, faster and faster… and suddenly it starts to **fly**!
k飛.mnemo_lectura: The duckling pushes off with one **toe** and starts to **fly**: と(ぶ).

k機.mnemo: A **tree** with two balls of **yarn** hanging from it and a **halberd** that rises and falls on its own: it's a knitting **machine** made in the woods.
k機.mnemo_lectura: The old **machine** only starts after a good **kick**: き.

k花.mnemo: On the **grass**, a **person** holding a **spoon** slowly changes shape until turning into a giant **flower**.
k花.mnemo_lectura: **Hanna**h picks a **flower** for you: はな.
k花.nota: 鼻 (nose) is also read はな.

k楽.mnemo: A **tree** with a **white** drum on top and two little notes flying off its sides: the whole forest dances. What **fun**!
k楽.mnemo_lectura: The party is **to**p-**no**tch **fun**: たの (楽しい).
k楽.nota: Don't confuse it with 薬 (medicine), which is 楽 with grass (艹) on top.

k雨.mnemo: A window with a frame and four drops sliding down the glass: the **rain** element stands alone and means exactly that, **rain**.
k雨.mnemo_lectura: So much **rain** that the yard is **a me**ss of puddles: あめ.

k道.mnemo: Down the **road** comes a **nose** with **antennae**, sniffing left and right: that way it never loses its **path**.
k道.mnemo_lectura: A mouse follows a **path** of crumbs, squeaking “**Me**! **Chee**se!”: みち.

k山.mnemo: Three peaks with the middle one tallest: the classic drawing of a **mountain**.
k山.mnemo_lectura: A **Yama**ha motorbike roars up the **mountain**: やま (山). In 沢山, さん.

k難.mnemo: **Twenty** **husbands** with their **mouths** wide open try to shove a **turkey** into the oven: this is going to be **difficult**.
k難.mnemo_lectura: It's **difficult** to squeeze a **moose** into a **ca**r: むずか (難しい).

k答.mnemo: Under a **bamboo** roof, a **person** raises **one** finger and opens their **mouth**: they've got the **answer**.
k答.mnemo_lectura: The **answer** is carved on a terra **cotta** pot: こた (答える).
k答.nota: Don't confuse it with 合 (fit): 答 is 合 with bamboo (⺮) on top.

k起.mnemo: The **runner** finds a **snake** in his bed and shoots out of it: what a way to **wake up**.
k起.mnemo_lectura: You **wake up** with a bear on your pillow: “**Oh**!”: お (起きる, 起こす).
k起.nota: 起きる is waking up or getting out of bed; 立つ (立) is standing up.

k小.mnemo: A little stick with two crumbs at its sides: it fits on your fingernail, everything about it is **small**.
k小.nota: Don't confuse it with 少 (few), which has one more stroke going down.

palabras.furigana: 小学校[しょうがっこう]

k近.mnemo: An **axe** lies in the middle of the **road**: you see it so **near** that you slam on the brakes.
k近.mnemo_lectura: A **chick**, **a**ww! It waddles so **near** your shoe that you freeze: ちか(い).

k続.mnemo: A **scholar** with **legs** and a **blanket** pulls on an endless **thread**: however hard he pulls, it's going to **continue**.
k続.mnemo_lectura: The ballerina in her **tutu** can't stop: she has to **continue** spinning: つづ (続く).
k続.nota: Don't confuse it with 読 (read): same 売, but with words (訁) instead of thread.

k代.mnemo: A **person** hands the **dart** to their daughter: “Your turn now.” That's how each **generation** takes over.
k代.mnemo_lectura: Every **generation** picks its own hair **dye**: だい.

k犬.mnemo: A giant (大) with one perky ear (丶): the **dog** element at full size. Next to another kanji it shrinks to 犭; alone, it's a **dog**.
k犬.mnemo_lectura: Sled **dogs** pull the **Inu**it across the snow: いぬ.
k犬.nota: 太 (thick) has the dot at the bottom; 犬 has it at the top right, and 大 (big) has none.

k覚.mnemo: A **watcher** hides under a **blanket** while **small** ideas crackle over his head: everything he sees, he's going to **memorize**.
k覚.mnemo_lectura: To **memorize** the list, you chant it in a **cac**tus garden: かく (感覚, 自覚). To memorize: おぼ(える), like an **obo**e.
k覚.nota: Looks like 学 (learn): same top, but with a watcher (見) instead of a child.

k旅.mnemo: A **compass** in one hand and a **rifle** on your shoulder, you set off across the desert: time to **travel**.
k旅.mnemo_lectura: Pack light when you **travel**: just a **tabby** cat and a toothbrush. たび.
k旅.nota: 族 (tribe, 家族) has an arrow (矢) at the bottom.

palabras.furigana: 海外旅行[かいがいりょこう]

k最.mnemo: Under the **sun**, you cover one **ear** and hurl the **boomerang** to the horizon: a record throw, the **most** ever.
k最.mnemo_lectura: The **most** romantic scene ever makes the whole theater **sigh**: さい (最高, 最後).

k映.mnemo: The **sun** hits a glass **goal**, and the silhouette of the **giant** underneath shows up on every wall: light knows how to **reflect**.
k映.mnemo_lectura: “**Oo**h, **two** suns!” The lake **reflect**s the sky: うつ(る).
k映.nota: 央 (center) is its right side; 英 (English) has it under grass.

k画.mnemo: A **root** pokes out of a **bowl** and, under **one** (the top line), draws in the mud: nature's pencil. That's how it learns each **stroke**.
k画.mnemo_lectura: In art class you draw a prickly **cac**tus, one **stroke** per spine: かく, as in 計画.

k色.mnemo: After the storm, a giant **rainbow** melts over the city and paints every roof a different **color**.
k色.mnemo_lectura: A superhero whose cape keeps changing **color**: say **hero** with a silent h: いろ.

k四.mnemo: Inside the **fence** you spot two **legs**, but when the creature steps out, it has **four**.
k四.mnemo_lectura: Over **yon**der, **four** horses graze on the hill: よん (四).

k曜.mnemo: A **turkey** with colorful **feathers** announces every morning which **sun** it is: Monday, Tuesday… It's the town crier of the **weekday**.
k曜.mnemo_lectura: **Yo**-**Yo** Ma plays a different piece every **weekday**: よう, as in 月曜日.
k曜.nota: 躍 (leap) and 濯 (rinse) have the same right side.

k足.mnemo: A round knee (**mouth**) on top of a **bus stop** sign: the leg that stops you in your tracks ends in a **foot**.
k足.mnemo_lectura: Your **foot** is covered in volcanic **ash**: あし (足). To be enough: た(りる).

k嫌.mnemo: A **woman** hauls two tied bundles (兼) that aren't even hers: she can't stand it, and she's starting to **detest** it.
k嫌.mnemo_lectura: Broccoli on your plate? You **detest** it, so you glare at it like a **killer**: きら (嫌い).

k年.mnemo: **Rifle** raised high, the **gang** hangs party flags on the **clothesline**: another **year** is ending.
k年.mnemo_lectura: Another **year** older, you stub your **toe**: “**Shee**sh!”: とし (毎年, 今年). In 来年, ねん.

k外.mnemo: In the **evening**, the **fortune teller** drags his little table into the street and reads fortunes out there, **outside**.
k外.mnemo_lectura: Some **guy** is shouting **outside** your window: がい (以外, 意外). The outdoors itself, そと.
k外.nota: Don't confuse it with a lone 夕 (evening) or with 多 (many).

k遊.mnemo: Down the **road** goes a **child** with a **compass** in one hand and a water **rifle** in the other: not looking for anything, just out to **play**.
k遊.mnemo_lectura: **A so**ccer **boo**t is all you need to **play**: あそぶ.

k面.mnemo: You put on a wooden **mask**: nobody sees your real face, only its **surface**.
k面.mnemo_lectura: You rub **men**thol all over the mask's **surface**: めん (地面, 面倒).

k白.mnemo: A ray of light zooms down a **slide** and crashes into the **sun**: the sky goes blinding **white**.
k白.mnemo_lectura: **She row**s a snow-**white** boat across the lake: しろ (白い).
k白.nota: It's 日 (day) with a stroke on top; add one more line up there and you get 百 (hundred).

k速.mnemo: A **bundle** of flowers shoots down the **road** and passes every car: nobody has ever seen anything so **fast**.
k速.mnemo_lectura: You're running so **fast** that your **sock** flies off: そく.
k速.nota: 早い means “early”; 速い means “fast.” Both are read はやい.

k開.mnemo: A **torii** pushes the doors of the **gate** from inside: nobody can stop it, it's going to **open**.
k開.mnemo_lectura: You **open** the gift: “**Ah**, it's lovely!”: あ (開ける). In 開始, かい.
k開.nota: With a torii (开) inside the gate it's open; its opposite, 閉 (close), has a genie (才).

k所.mnemo: You chop down the **door** with an **axe**: no doubt about it, this is the treasure **spot**.
k所.mnemo_lectura: The perfect **spot** for a **sho**w: しょ (場所). On its own, ところ.

k音.mnemo: A **podium** on top of a **sun**: the champion blows a trumpet at dawn. What a **sound**.
k音.mnemo_lectura: Your neighbor **Otto** makes a strange **sound** every time he sneezes: おと (音).
k音.nota: With a heart (心) underneath, it becomes 意 (intention).

k病.mnemo: In the **hospital** there's a **goal** with **one** on top; underneath, a **person** with a raging fever. Diagnosis: **illness**.
k病.mnemo_lectura: **Beyo**nd a cold: a real **illness**. びょう, as in 病院 and 病気.
k病.nota: 痛 (pain) and 疲 (fatigue) have the same hospital.

k着.mnemo: A **sheep** comes down a **slide** and stares at you with one **eye**: you shear it, and now you have wool to **wear**.
k着.mnemo_lectura: To **wear** something truly Japanese, start with a **ki**mono: き (着る). To arrive: つ (着く).
k着.nota: 着く (arrive) and 付く (stick) sound the same: つく.

k戻.mnemo: A **giant** squeezes out the **door**, pats his pockets… he forgot his keys. He has to **go back**.
k戻.mnemo_lectura: You have to **go back**: you forgot to turn off airplane **mode**: もど (戻る).

k別.mnemo: A **mouth** with **muscle** takes a bite and the **knife** cuts off the bitten piece: that one you set **apart**.
k別.mnemo_lectura: You keep your poker **bets** **apart** from your savings: べつ (別に, 特別).

k全.mnemo: A greedy **king** crawls into his **teepee** with every jewel, every coin and every goat: he takes it **all**.
k全.mnemo_lectura: The **Zen** master owns nothing and has it **all**: ぜん (全部).
k全.nota: On top it has a teepee (入), not a person: don't mix it up with 金 (gold).

k院.mnemo: In the **town**, under a **roof** that covers a **fountain**, they put up an official building with a guard at the entrance: it's the **institution**.
k院.mnemo_lectura: Every **in**stitute is an **institution**: いん, as in 病院.
k院.nota: 完 (complete) is its right side on its own.

k座.mnemo: In the **shed**, one **person** and another **person** settle down on the **soil** floor: it's time to **sit**.
k座.mnemo_lectura: Cross your legs and **sit** like a **sua**ve movie star: すわ (座る).

k町.mnemo: You drive a **nail** into the corner of each **field** to mark out the streets: that's how a **neighborhood** is born.
k町.mnemo_lectura: At night, everyone in the **neighborhood** strikes a **match** on the porch: まち (町).

k木.mnemo: A trunk, two drooping branches and roots planted deep: you've drawn the simplest thing in the world, a **tree**.
k木.mnemo_lectura: A karate chop, “**Ki**-ya!”, and the **tree** comes down: き.

k説.mnemo: The **flirt** pours out sweet **words** until you're convinced: he can **explain** anything.
k説.mnemo_lectura: To **explain** tennis, you start with a **set**: せつ (説明).

k歌.mnemo: You get two **gold stars** in a row and open your mouth like a giant **yawn**… but you don't yawn: you belt out your **song**.
k歌.mnemo_lectura: The **song** starts like this: “**Oo**h, **ta**-da-da!”: うた, うた(う).
k歌.nota: 欲 (crave) has a valley next to the yawn.

k室.mnemo: You run a marathon and the **finish line** is under a **roof**: you cross it and collapse into an air-conditioned **room**.
k室.mnemo_lectura: The whole **room** is buried in exam **sheets**: しつ, as in 教室.
k室.nota: 屋 (shop, house) also has a finish line (至), but under a corpse (尸).

k飯.mnemo: You set your **food** in front of the **mirror** and see a double serving: two steaming bowls of **cooked rice**.
k飯.mnemo_lectura: A bowl of **cooked rice** for **Han** Solo: はん (ご飯).

k送.mnemo: A **giant** with **antennae** and **one** for a hat runs down the **road** loaded with packages: he's the mailman, and he lives to **send**.
k送.mnemo_lectura: “**Oh, coo**l, you **send** me a postcard!”: おく(る).

k川.mnemo: Three lines of water running side by side: the **river** element in person. Alone, it means the same: **river**.
k川.mnemo_lectura: A **cow wa**des across the **river**: かわ.
k川.nota: 州 (state, province) adds three drops between the lines.

k紙.mnemo: With the finest **thread**, you weave your **family crest** onto a flat sheet: that's how **paper** is born.
k紙.mnemo_lectura: A **kami**kaze **paper** plane dives straight at the teacher: かみ.
k紙.nota: 神 (god) and 髪 (hair) are also read かみ.

k料.mnemo: You measure the **rice** with a **ladle**: one, two, three scoops. In this kitchen every **ingredient** is measured down to the grain.
k料.mnemo_lectura: The chef's secret **ingredient** is flown in from **Rio**: りょう.

k理.mnemo: The **king** divides his **farm** into perfect plots, everything in its place: it all follows its own **logic**.
k理.mnemo_lectura: Your **logic** is as twisted as a coral **ree**f: り (理由, 無理).

k昔.mnemo: Grandpa counts **twenty** winters, crosses out **one**, and the **sun** sinks below the line: “This happened **long ago**, back when I still had hair.”
k昔.mnemo_lectura: Grandpa's farm tales go **moo**, **ca**lf, **she**ep… and every one starts **long ago**: むかし.
k昔.nota: You'll find 昔 inside 借 (borrow), with a person at its side.

k探.mnemo: With one **hand** you feel around under the number **pi** carved into a **tree**: the treasure is there, you just have to **search**.
k探.mnemo_lectura: To **search** for the treasure, you read the whole **saga**: さが (探す).

k選.mnemo: Two **snakes** cross the **road** and your **two hands** tremble: which one do you grab? You have to **choose**.
k選.mnemo_lectura: You have to **choose** between two **era**s: the dinosaurs or today: えら (選ぶ).

k注.mnemo: The **king**, with a **drop** for a crown, calls for silence and serves **water** into the cups: everyone watches closely as he starts to **pour**.
k注.mnemo_lectura: You **pour** the sauce and everyone **chew**s in careful silence: ちゅう, as in 注意.
k注.nota: 住 (reside) has a person; 柱 (pillar) has a tree; 主 (master) is the right side alone.

k夏.mnemo: A line, **one**, over a sunburned **nose** and a **sled** melting in the sand: it's the height of **summer**.
k夏.mnemo_lectura: The **summer** heat drives everyone **nuts**: なつ (夏).

k困.mnemo: A **tree** locked inside a **fence** with no room to grow: poor thing, it's in real **trouble**.
k困.mnemo_lectura: You're in **trouble** over one missing **comma**: こま (困る).
k困.nota: Don't confuse it with 国 (country), which has a king (王) inside the fence.

k由.mnemo: From the **root**, a shoot pushes up through the dirt: nothing just happens, everything has a **reason**.
k由.mnemo_lectura: The **reason** you never study: **You**Tube: ゆう (理由, 自由).
k由.nota: Don't confuse it with 田 (field) or 申 (declare): in 由 the stick only pokes out the top.

k頃.mnemo: A **spoon** marks the diary **page** where you stopped reading: what were you up to in **those days**? You can't even remember.
k頃.mnemo_lectura: In **those days**, you lived way out in **Colo**rado: ころ.

k海.mnemo: A **mother** armed with a **water** **rifle** shoots and shoots, nonstop, until she fills the **sea**.
k海.mnemo_lectura: “**Ooh**, **me**? Swim in the **sea**? Yes!”: うみ.

palabras.furigana: 海外旅行[かいがいりょこう]

k決.mnemo: A giant with a hook in his hand (夬) leans over the edge of the **water**: jump or not? He has to **decide**.
k決.mnemo_lectura: You **decide**: grab the **key** and go: き (決める). In 解決, けつ.

k簡.mnemo: You hang **bamboo** over the **gate** and the **sun** slips through the gaps: decorating has never been so **easy**.
k簡.mnemo_lectura: As **easy** as kicking a **can** down the street: かん (簡単).
k簡.nota: Don't confuse it with 間 (interval), which is the same without the bamboo (⺮).

k降.mnemo: From the top of **town**, a **gang** launches down the hill on a **sled**, screaming: there's no faster way to **descend**.
k降.mnemo_lectura: “**Oh**, **rea**lly? My stop!” You **descend** from the train: おりる.
k降.nota: For rain and snow, use ふる: 雨が降る.

k絵.mnemo: With colored **thread**, a **person** embroiders a **cloud** across the sky: the stitching ends up looking like a **picture**.
k絵.mnemo_lectura: You look at the **picture** and blurt out: “**Eh**? That's me!”: え.
k絵.nota: 会 (meeting, あう) is its right side; 給 (salary) has 合.

k力.mnemo: An arm bent to show off its **muscle**: that's where all the **strength** is.
k力.mnemo_lectura: On a beach in **Rio**, a **coo**l bodybuilder flexes his **strength**: りょく (努力, 能力). On its own, ちから.
k力.nota: Don't confuse it with 刀 (knife): in 力 the stroke pokes out on top.

k普.mnemo: A **hedgehog** with **antennae** sunbathes under the **sun** in the town square: around here, that's totally **common**.
k普.mnemo_lectura: In this town, kung **fu** is pretty **common**: ふ (普通, 普段).

k通.mnemo: A **kangaroo** with his **toolbox** hops across the **road**: here, anyone can **pass through**.
k通.mnemo_lectura: A **tow** truck clears the way so you can **pass through**: とお (通る). In 普通, つう.

k寒.mnemo: Under the **roof**, next to the **well**, everything is **ice**: your teeth chatter. So **cold**.
k寒.mnemo_lectura: Poor **Sam** forgot his coat, and now he's so **cold**: さむ(い).

k実.mnemo: Under the **roof** are **two** beds and a **giant** snoring on top of them: you thought it was a dream, but it's pure **reality**.
k実.mnemo_lectura: **Reality** puts you in a jiu-**jitsu** hold: じつ.

k安.mnemo: A **woman** under the **roof**, with a blanket and tea: outside it's pouring, but inside everything is **peaceful**.
k安.mnemo_lectura: **Ann** curls up on the couch, **peaceful** as a cat: あん.
k安.nota: Heads-up: 安い means “cheap.” With a tree underneath it's 案 (proposal, as in 案内).

k古.mnemo: A **tombstone** is a cross (**ten**) over a **mouth** that no longer speaks: it's been there for centuries. Everything here is **old**.
k古.mnemo_lectura: That **fru**it is **old** and full of flies: ふる(い).
k古.nota: 舌 (tongue) has a slanted stroke on top; 右 (right) has ナ instead of 十.

k配.mnemo: A waiter **snake** coils around the **sake** bottle and pours cup after cup: it's his job to **distribute**.
k配.mnemo_lectura: Santa **distribute**s gifts with a big “**Hi**!” for every kid: はい (心配, 支配).

k動.mnemo: You lift a huge **barbell** on pure **muscle**: at last you get it to **move**.
k動.mnemo_lectura: The old car finally starts to **move**: “**Ooh**, **go**!”: うご (動く). In 行動, どう.
k動.nota: Don't confuse it with 働 (work), which is 動 with a person (亻) in front.

k物.mnemo: You plant a **flag** on the **cow**'s back, like on the moon: it's not an animal anymore, now it's your **thing**.
k物.mnemo_lectura: Every **thing** in that weird shop is **mono**chrome, black and white: もの (物).
k物.nota: 者 (person) is also read もの: 物 is a thing, 者 is a person.

k月.mnemo: The **moon** takes about thirty days to go all the way around: that's a **month**.
k月.mnemo_lectura: Every **month** you **get** paid: げつ (来月, 月曜日). The moon in the sky is つき.

k売.mnemo: A **scholar** with super-long **legs** spreads a **blanket** at the flea market, lays out his wisdom and starts to **sell**.
k売.mnemo_lectura: You try to **sell** an entire mountain range: the **Ur**als: うる.
k売.nota: Its partner is 買 (buy), with a net and a shell: don't mix them up.

k他.mnemo: A **person** finds a **scorpion** in his boot and quietly swaps it for the one next to it: better the **other** one.
k他.mnemo_lectura: The **other** kid always grabs the last **ta**co: た (他人). On its own, “something else”: ほか.
k他.nota: Don't confuse it with 地 (ground), which has soil (土) instead of a person.

k元.mnemo: Above the number **pi** you draw a line, **one**: all of math starts right there. It's the **origin**.
k元.mnemo_lectura: Back to your **origin**: your very first **mo**torcycle: もと (元). In 元気, げん.
k元.nota: Looks like 兄 (older brother): 元 has two lines on top, 兄 has a mouth.

k兄.mnemo: A huge **mouth** on two long **legs**: the one who yells loudest and bosses everyone around at home is your **older brother**.
k兄.mnemo_lectura: Your **older brother** has a huge crush on **Annie**: あに (sweetly, お兄さん: にい).

k娘.mnemo: A **woman** stomps on an imaginary **brake**, a **drop** of sweat on her brow. The new driver at the wheel? Her **daughter**.
k娘.mnemo_lectura: At the zoo, your **daughter** yawns: “A **moose**? **Meh**”: むすめ.

k利.mnemo: You cut the **grain** with a **knife** at just the right moment and sell it at the best price: it's all **profit**.
k利.mnemo_lectura: You count the **profit** and squeal: “**Re**ally?!”: り.

k用.mnemo: A **toolbox** hangs on the wall with a tag: “For emergencies only.” Nobody ever opens it, so who knows its real **utility**.
k用.mnemo_lectura: What's the **utility** of that string? “It's for my **yo**-yo!”: よう.

k度.mnemo: In the **shed**, you throw the **boomerang** **twenty** times in a row, and it always comes back. Again and again, so many **times**.
k度.mnemo_lectura: The same note, too many **times**: “**Do**, **do**, **do**”: ど (今度, 一度).
k度.nota: Don't confuse it with 席 (seat): same shed and twenty, but with a scarf (巾).

k有.mnemo: A hand (ナ) reaches for the **moon**, grabs it and stuffs it in its pocket: now it's theirs. That's what it means to **possess**.
k有.mnemo_lectura: You're famous: fans point and scream “It's **you**!” on every street: ゆう, as in 有名.
k有.nota: 右 (right, みぎ) and 左 (left) start with the same hand (ナ).

k窓.mnemo: You punch a **hole** in the **nook** of the wall, and a lovesick **heart** peeks through it. Now your room has a **window**.
k窓.mnemo_lectura: “**Ma**, **do**n't open the **window**, it's freezing!”: まど.

k俺.mnemo: A **giant** **person** with a **sun** on his belly and a **duckling** at his feet pounds his chest: “Make way for **yours truly**!”
k俺.mnemo_lectura: Who's the toughest guy in **Ore**gon? **Yours truly**: おれ (俺).
k俺.nota: 俺 (おれ) is a cocky, macho “I”; 僕 (ぼく) is a softer “I” for guys.

k頼.mnemo: You hand your friend a **bundle** of flowers and a **page** with your plea written on it: he's the one you always **rely** on.
k頼.mnemo_lectura: You can always **rely** on **Ry**an: らい (信頼, 依頼). To ask for something, たの(む).

k遅.mnemo: Down the **road** comes a **corpse** riding a **sheep**: even snails pass them. Nothing on earth is so **slow**.
k遅.mnemo_lectura: “**Oh, so** **slow**!” you groan, stuck in traffic: おそ(い).

k残.mnemo: The **Grim Reaper** takes everyone, but forgets a few **coins** on the table: the only thing that will **remain**.
k残.mnemo_lectura: Only one cookie **remains**, and Mom says: “**No co**okie for you!”: のこ (残る).

k笑.mnemo: A **teen** with **bamboo** leaves on his head bends in the wind as if someone were tickling him: he can't help but **laugh**.
k笑.mnemo_lectura: A **walla**by tells a joke and you **laugh** so hard you fall over: わら (笑う).

k親.mnemo: Standing on a **podium** on top of a **tree**, a **watcher** keeps an eye on every step the kids take: that's a **parent** for you.
k親.mnemo_lectura: At midnight, your **parent** lets out a huge “**Oh**… **ya**wn”: おや.

k痛.mnemo: At the **hospital**, a **kangaroo** in a lab coat pokes your belly with a tool from his **toolbox**: what **pain**!
k痛.mnemo_lectura: “**Eat a** chili,” they said. Now your mouth is on fire: what **pain**!: いた (痛い).

k丈.mnemo: A line, **one**, nailed across the X of **five**: a post that can take anything you throw at it, **sturdy**.
k丈.mnemo_lectura: Your buddy **Joe**, tall and **sturdy**, always says he's fine: じょう (大丈夫).
k丈.nota: Don't confuse it with 大 (big) or 文 (writing).

k夫.mnemo: A giant (大) with a second line across his head: the hairpin he wore on his wedding day. Now he's a **husband**.
k夫.mnemo_lectura: The **husband** kicks off his **boo**ts and sighs: all good: ぶ (大丈夫).
k夫.nota: Don't confuse it with 天 (sky): in 夫 the stick pokes out on top.

k雪.mnemo: **Rain** falls on a **snout** and freezes, white and fluffy: it's **snow**.
k雪.mnemo_lectura: You drop your keys in the **snow**: “Where are **you**, **key**s?”: ゆき.
k雪.nota: 雷 (thunder) has a field under the rain; 電 (electricity), lightning.

k服.mnemo: The **moon** shows off a new suit: a cape with a royal **stamp** and a **boomerang** for a buckle. No more going out naked: it finally has **clothes**.
k服.mnemo_lectura: Hang your **clothes** on the **hook** by the door: ふく.

k疲.mnemo: At the **hospital**, your **skin** is so gray and wrinkled that the doctor's diagnosis is: nothing serious, pure **fatigue**.
k疲.mnemo_lectura: An old elephant drags its **tusk** **a**long the ground, heavy with **fatigue**: つか(れる).

palabras.furigana: お 疲[つか]れ 様[さま]

k特.mnemo: A **cow** lives inside the **temple** and the monks bow to her: she's no ordinary cow, she's **special**.
k特.mnemo_lectura: Tick-**tock**: the temple's **special** clock chimes: とく.
k特.nota: 持 (hold) and 待 (wait) also contain 寺; in 特, the cow is the boss.

k客.mnemo: Under your **roof**, the **courier** parks his **sled**, but today he brings no package: he's here to buy. He's your **customer**.
k客.mnemo_lectura: “**Kya**!” squeals the clerk: her first **customer** is a **cu**ddly bear: きゃく.
k客.nota: 容 (contents) has a valley under the roof; 各 (each) is the bottom part alone.

palabras.furigana: お 客様[きゃくさま]
観光客[かんこうきゃく]

k渡.mnemo: Under a **shed** floating on the **water**, **twenty** rowers throw a **boomerang** to the far shore: that's their way to **cross**.
k渡.mnemo_lectura: You **cross** the **wat**er to hand over a letter: わた(す).
k渡.nota: Without the water it's 度 (times, degree).

k運.mnemo: Down the **road** goes a **car** covered with a **blanket**: there's something secret inside, and its mission is to **transport** it unseen.
k運.mnemo_lectura: “**Ha**! **Co**ffee!” A drone **transport**s it to you: はこ(ぶ).
k運.nota: 運 also means “luck”: 運がいい = to be lucky.

k風.mnemo: A **table** flies out the window with a **bug** clinging to one leg: what a gust of **wind**!
k風.mnemo_lectura: Remember kami**kaze**, “divine wind”? The **kaze** part is the **wind**: かぜ.

k午.mnemo: You stick a **ten** in the ground, set **one** on top and add a shadow **slide**: when the shadow disappears, it's **noon**.
k午.mnemo_lectura: At **noon**, you **go** grab lunch: ご, as in 午後.
k午.nota: 牛 (cow, うし) pokes its middle stick out the top; 午 doesn't.

palabras.furigana: 一生懸命[いっしょうけんめい]

k命.mnemo: Under the little roof of a **person**, on top of **one**, a **mouth** swears an oath before the king's royal **stamp**: from now on, the king decides its **fate**.
k命.mnemo_lectura: The king decides your **fate** by e-**mai**l: めい.

palabras.furigana: 一生懸命[いっしょうけんめい]

k夢.mnemo: Lying on the **grass** in the **evening**, you pull a **blanket** and a mosquito **net** over you: straight into a **dream**.
k夢.mnemo_lectura: “**You**? **Me**?” In the **dream**, you and I swap faces: ゆめ (夢).

k空.mnemo: You bash a **hole** in the ceiling with an **I-beam** and peek out: nothing but blue. You've just opened up the **sky**.
k空.mnemo_lectura: A pigeon glides across the empty **sky**: “**Coo**, **coo**”: くう.

k故.mnemo: You lash an old **tombstone** with a **whip** and it topples onto you: what a **mishap**.
k故.mnemo_lectura: A **mishap** with your **co**ffee, all over the laptop: こ, as in 事故.
k故.nota: 固 (solid) has the tombstone locked inside a fence.

k計.mnemo: You count out loud in **words** up to **ten**, again and again, scribbling on a napkin: you're trying to **calculate** the bar tab.
k計.mnemo_lectura: You **calculate** how many slices each **cake** will make: けい.

k調.mnemo: With **words** and questions you circle an entire **racetrack**: not one corner is too small to **investigate**.
k調.mnemo_lectura: The detective **investigate**s with a mouthful of **cho**colate: ちょう (調子). To look something up, しら (調べる).

k忙.mnemo: Your **heart** ends up in a **coffin** from so much work: you never stop, always **busy**.
k忙.mnemo_lectura: “**Ee**k, **so**rry, **go**tta run!” You're always so **busy**: いそが (忙しい).
k忙.nota: Same coffin (亡) as 忘 (forget): in 忙 the heart sits on the left; in 忘, underneath.

k薬.mnemo: You pull **grass** from the foot of a **tree** with **white** flowers, crush it and swallow it: works like a charm. It's **medicine**.
k薬.mnemo_lectura: Three pharmacists, **Coo**, **Sue** and **Ree**, mix your **medicine**: くすり.
k薬.nota: 楽 (fun, たのしい) is the same without the grass on top.

k向.mnemo: A **slide** shoots you into a **goal**, where a **mouth** yells: “That way!” So you turn and run **toward** it.
k向.mnemo_lectura: You head straight **toward** the **moo**ing cow: む (向かう, 向く).
k向.nota: Don't confuse it with 同 (same), which has a line above the mouth.

k深.mnemo: A **tree** sinks into the **water** until only a **pi** floats above its crown: the lake is so **deep** that nobody has seen the bottom.
k深.mnemo_lectura: A **foo**d **ca**rt rolls off the pier and sinks into the **deep**: ふか(い).

palabras.furigana: 興味深[きょうみぶか]い

k耳.mnemo: You draw an **ear** in profile: the rim, the folds, the tiny hole… Touch yours: that's your **ear**.
k耳.mnemo_lectura: “**Me**! **Me**!” yell the kids, tugging at your **ear**: みみ.

k徒.mnemo: A **walker** follows a **runner** everywhere to copy his technique: he's his most loyal **pupil**.
k徒.mnemo_lectura: The eager **pupil** stands on tip**toe** to answer first: と.

k重.mnemo: You try to lift the gym **barbell** and it doesn't budge: it's as **heavy** as a grand piano.
k重.mnemo_lectura: “**Oh**, **mo**m, this backpack is so **heavy**!”: おも(い).

k進.mnemo: A **turkey** sprints down the **road** without looking back: birds never go in reverse, they only **advance**.
k進.mnemo_lectura: You **advance** on tiptoe, whispering “**Sue**, **Sue**…”: すす (進む).

k両.mnemo: Under the line of **one**, inside a **goal**, rises a **mountain** with twin peaks. You'll have to climb **both**.
k両.mnemo_lectura: **Both** your parents dance samba all night at the carnival in **Rio**: りょう.

k七.mnemo: A line, **one**, crossed by a **duckling** that bends its neck to the right: the number **seven**.
k七.nota: Don't confuse it with 匕 (spoon): in 七 the line cuts across the stroke.

k感.mnemo: A **halberd** grazes your **mouth** and a shiver runs down to your **heart**: you notice everything, you **feel** it all.
k感.mnemo_lectura: Yes, you **can** **feel** it: かん (感じる, 感情).

k横.mnemo: You chop down a **tree** and lay it flat: from its **twenty** branches hangs **one**, from the **root** crawl **eight** bugs... Everything ends up lying on its **side**.

k村.mnemo: A **tree**, then an **inch** away another, and another: four trees, three houses, and you've got a **village**.
k村.mnemo_lectura: In this **village**, the cows cheer: “**Moo**-**rah**!”: むら.

palabras.furigana: お 医者[いしゃ]さん

k者.mnemo: An **old man** soaking up the **sun** in the square, every day on the same bench in the same cap: quite the **individual**.
k者.mnemo_lectura: That **individual** plays **Mono**poly all day long: もの (者).
k者.nota: 物 is also read もの: 者 is a person, 物 is a thing.

palabras.furigana: お 医者[いしゃ]さん

k広.mnemo: The **shed** has only one **nook**, but three cars fit inside it. You've never seen a shed this **wide**.
k広.mnemo_lectura: A true **hero** spreads a cape as **wide** as the sky: ひろ(い).

k冬.mnemo: A **sled** glides over two slabs of **ice**: **winter** is here.
k冬.mnemo_lectura: Deep in **winter** you rub your hands: “**Phew**, **you**'re freezing!”: ふゆ (冬).

k確.mnemo: A **turkey** hides under a **blanket** on top of a **stone**: nothing can budge it. Of that, it's **certain**.
k確.mnemo_lectura: You're **certain** the pants are **khak**i: かく (確認, 正確). “Surely” is たし(か).

k泣.mnemo: The runner-up climbs onto the **podium** and **water** streams down his cheeks: he can't help but **cry**.
k泣.mnemo_lectura: Going to **cry**? **Na**h, not me!: な (泣く).

k低.mnemo: A **person** holds up the **family crest**, but a **drop** of sweat falls and he bends down to wipe it: now the crest hangs very **low**.
k低.mnemo_lectura: A pigeon coos in a very **low** voice: “**Hee**-**coo**”: ひく(い).

k息.mnemo: Your **nose** sits right above your **heart**: that's where the air comes in to keep it beating. It's your **breath**.

lecturas.nota: 息子 se lee todo junto: むすこ

k息.mnemo_lectura: Garlic for dinner? Your morning **breath** is **icky**: いき.
k息.nota: In 息子 (son), you read it all together: むすこ.

k伝.mnemo: A **person** whispers a secret to a **cloud**, and the cloud carries it from town to town: it wants to **convey** everything.
k伝.mnemo_lectura: You **convey** the message to King **Tut**ankhamun: つた (伝える).

k箱.mnemo: With **bamboo** and wood from a **tree** you build something with an **eye** on the side, so you can see what's inside: a **box**.
k箱.mnemo_lectura: A **hawk** named **O**scar lives in a cardboard **box**: はこ.
k箱.nota: 相 (mutual) is its bottom part alone.

k予.mnemo: A **kangaroo** hangs from a **hook** with an alarm clock in its pouch: it's always up first and gets everything ready **in advance**.
k予.mnemo_lectura: “**Yo**, I called it **in advance**,” your friend brags: よ.

palabras.furigana: 天気予報[てんきよほう]

k定.mnemo: Under the **roof**, a table stands on a single wooden **hoof**. You cement it to the floor: now the dinner spot is **set** for good.
k定.mnemo_lectura: The plan is **set**: you **tape** it to the wall: てい.

k茶.mnemo: At the top of a **tree**, a **person** picks the **grass** sprouting from the crown: tender leaves for your **tea**.
k茶.mnemo_lectura: You order a **chai**, which is really just spiced **tea**: ちゃ, as in お茶.

k庭.mnemo: Under a **shed**, a **scholar** takes one **stride** and steps outside, among flowerpots and a hammock: the **yard**.
k庭.mnemo_lectura: You scrape your **knee** in the **yard** and cry “**Wa**ah!”: にわ.

k右.mnemo: One hand (ナ) brings food to your **mouth**: the hand you eat with, your **right**.
k右.mnemo_lectura: On your **right**, a kid waves wildly: “**Me**! **Gee**, pick me!”: みぎ (右).
k右.nota: Don't confuse it with 左 (left): 右 has a mouth (口); 左, an I-beam (工).

k美.mnemo: A **sheep** rides on a **giant**'s shoulders down the runway: the audience rises to its feet before such **beauty**.

lecturas.nota: 美味しい se lee todo junto: おいしい

k美.mnemo_lectura: “**Ooh**, i**t's coo**l!” the crowd gasps at such **beauty**: うつく(しい).

k研.mnemo: You rub a **stone** against the posts of a **torii** day and night until they shine: your trade is to **polish**.
k研.mnemo_lectura: You **polish** the dog's **ken**nel until it sparkles: けん, as in 研究.
k研.nota: 形 (shape) and 型 (mold) have the same torii (开).

k究.mnemo: You crawl into the same **hole** **nine** times to see what's at the bottom: you just can't stop your **research**.
k究.mnemo_lectura: A good detective's **research** starts with one tiny **cue**: きゅう, as in 研究.
k究.nota: 空 (empty) has an I-beam (工) under the hole; 究 has nine.

k止.mnemo: A **bus stop** sign planted in the middle of the sidewalk: no matter how rushed you are, you have to **stop**.
k止.mnemo_lectura: The **tow** truck hooks your car and makes it **stop**: と (止まる, 止める).
k止.nota: Don't confuse it with 上 (up) or with 正 (correct), which has a line on top.

k押.mnemo: Your **hand** plants a **stick** in the middle of the **field**, and to drive it all the way in, there's only one move: **push**.
k押.mnemo_lectura: “**Oh**, **s**orry!” you say after you **push** past someone: おす.
k押.nota: Door buttons in Japan say 押 (push) or 引 (pull).

k魚.mnemo: A **fishhook** pulls up a critter with scales in a grid, like a **field**, and a tail flapping like **fire**: you caught a **fish**.
k魚.mnemo_lectura: You reel in a **sock**… **nah**, it's a **fish**!: さかな.

k姉.mnemo: A **woman** wearing a **lid** as a hat and a **scarf** around her neck, acting like queen of the market: your **older sister**.
k姉.mnemo_lectura: Your **older sister**'s name? **Anne**, of course: あね (姉). Said sweetly, お姉さん: ねえ.
k姉.nota: Don't confuse it with 妹 (younger sister): the older one has a market (市); the younger, an unripe fruit (未).

k隣.mnemo: In **town**, one **evening**, a **gang** tosses **rice** over your fence. You know exactly who they are: the kids of your **neighbor**.
k隣.mnemo_lectura: Through the wall, your **neighbor** clips his **toena**ils at 3 a.m., **ri**ght on schedule: となり.

k構.mnemo: With **trees** you build a **well**, and on top a wobbly **scaffold**: now you have the **structure** of your house.
k構.mnemo_lectura: The whole **structure** is built out of **co**conut shells: こう.

k相.mnemo: A **tree** and an **eye** stare at each other without blinking: the respect is **mutual**.
k相.mnemo_lectura: A **mutual** crush: you meet **eye** to **eye**: あい (相手). In 相談, そう.

k赤.mnemo: An iron **swing** stuck in the desert **soil**: at noon the metal gets so hot that it turns **red**.
k赤.mnemo_lectura: **A ca**rdinal lands on the fence, bright **red**: あか.

k妻.mnemo: A **woman** holds over her head a **snout** pierced by a **ten**: the house broom. “Now you sweep!” That's how your **wife** runs things.
k妻.mnemo_lectura: “**Too ma**ny socks on the floor!” yells your **wife**: つま.
k妻.nota: 凄 (amazing, すごい) adds ice in front.

k連.mnemo: Down the **road** roll **cars** hooked together like train wagons. The lead car has one job: **take along** all the others.
k連.mnemo_lectura: A **tsu**nami rolls in and **take**s **along** everything in its path: つ(れる).

k絡.mnemo: The **courier** trails a **thread** to every house he visits. By nightfall, the whole neighborhood is linked up in one giant **tangle**.
k絡.mnemo_lectura: All your **tangle**d cables end up hanging from one coat **rack**: らく.

k軽.mnemo: You load a **hoe** onto a toy **car** and it flies off at the first breeze: everything is **lightweight**.
k軽.mnemo_lectura: You ride a **carou**sel, **lightweight** as a feather: かる (軽い).

k園.mnemo: Inside a **fence** you spread rich **soil** and plant a **kimono** with a **mouth** that sings to the flowers: your **garden**.
k園.mnemo_lectura: An **enchanted** **garden** where every flower sings: えん, as in 学園.
k園.nota: 遠 (far) has the same 袁 on a road, and is also read エン.

k無.mnemo: You fire the **rifle** at a four-post fence (卌), the **fire** eats it up, and in the end there's **nothing** left.
k無.mnemo_lectura: The cow stares at the empty barn, with **nothing** left in it: “**Moo**…”: む (無理).

k借.mnemo: A **person** asks you for **twenty** bucks, then **one** more, swearing to pay it back before the **sun** rises... years ago. They just love to **borrow**.
k借.mnemo_lectura: “Can I **borrow** your **car**?” Every week, the same question: かり(る).
k借.nota: 貸す is lending to someone; 借りる is borrowing. Inside it hides 昔 (long ago).

k静.mnemo: Under a **blue** sky, the angler eases his **fishhook** and a second **hook** toward the fish's **snout**: nobody breathes. The whole lake goes **quiet**.
k静.mnemo_lectura: “**She's** asleep,” the librarian whispers. Keep it **quiet**: しず(か).

k消.mnemo: You pour **water** on a burning **moon** until it's something **small**: you just managed to **extinguish** it.
k消.mnemo_lectura: You **extinguish** the grill fire with **ke**tchup: け (消す). To vanish: き (消える).

k願.mnemo: From a **cliff**, a **small** monk dressed in **white** tosses a **page** into the wind with his **wish**.
k願.mnemo_lectura: You make a **wish**, and the answer comes back **nega**tive: ねが (お願い).

k洗.mnemo: A **cow** with mud-caked **legs** steps into a tub of **water**: time to **wash**.
k洗.mnemo_lectura: You **wash** an old lamp and **Ala**ddin's genie pops out: あら(う).
k洗.nota: 先 (ahead, さき) is its right side on its own.

k返.mnemo: You hit the **road** with the **mirror** your neighbor lent you under your arm: time to **give back** what you borrowed.
k返.mnemo_lectura: “Borrowed my **car**, **eh**? Now **give back** the keys!”: かえ (返す). In 返事, へん.
k返.nota: 返す (give back) sounds like 帰る (go home): 返 has the mirror (反).

k練.mnemo: At **sunrise**, you pass a **thread** through a needle a thousand times. No rest, no excuses: time to **train**.
k練.mnemo_lectura: A tiny **wren** **train**s by flying laps around the yard: れん.

k習.mnemo: A **white** chick flaps its **feathers** every morning, falls, gets up and tries again: it learns to fly through **practice**.
k習.mnemo_lectura: You **practice** tying your **shoe** a hundred times: しゅう.

k正.mnemo: You set **one** right on top of the **bus stop** sign: the bus brakes exactly on the line. **Correct**!
k正.mnemo_lectura: Six out of six: the teacher can only **say** “All **correct**!”: せい.

k春.mnemo: Under the **power line**, a warm **sun** shines and the fields start to bloom: it's **spring**.
k春.mnemo_lectura: In **spring**, a baby kangaroo hops out and you laugh: “**Ha**! A **roo**!”: はる (春).

k優.mnemo: A **person** wraps their **nose** and **heart** in a **blanket** and pulls them on a **sled** so they won't get cold: so gentle, so **kind**.
k優.mnemo_lectura: The **kind** butler answers every request with a posh “**Yah, sah**!”: やさ (優しい).

k法.mnemo: **Water** drags the **soil** into a **nook**: everything ends up following its course, just as the **law** demands.
k法.mnemo_lectura: By **law**, every farmer must own a **hoe**: ほう (魔法, 方法).

k天.mnemo: A **giant** stretches out his arms and, above his head, holds up **one** more line: the highest line there is, the **heavens**.
k天.mnemo_lectura: The **heavens** stretch over you like a giant **ten**t: てん, as in 天 and 天井.
k天.nota: 夫 (husband) crosses the top line; 天 doesn't.

palabras.furigana: 天気予報[てんきよほう]

k経.mnemo: A **thread** tied to a **hoe**: each time you dig, it winds up a little more. By the time the ball runs out, years will **elapse**.
k経.mnemo_lectura: Months **elapse**, and all you eat is **ka**le: けい.

k験.mnemo: The whole **assembly** watches a **horse** jump fences: it's the final **trial** to make the team.
k験.mnemo_lectura: Your puppy's first **trial**: one night alone in the **ken**nel: けん.
k験.nota: 険 (risk) has the town (阝) in place of the horse.

k可.mnemo: A **nail** pierces a **mouth** that still smiles and says “approved”: with that attitude, anything is **possible**.

k能.mnemo: In a **nook**, under the **moon**, a bear juggles two **spoons**: what an **ability**.
k能.mnemo_lectura: “**No**, you have no **ability**!” sneers the judge: のう.
k能.nota: With a heart underneath it's 態 (state, attitude).

k果.mnemo: At the top of a **tree** grows a whole **field**; when it ripens, down to the ground drops the **fruit**.
k果.mnemo_lectura: The **fruit** falls, thunk, right on your **ca**r roof: か.
k果.nota: Add grass on top and you get 菓 (sweets).

k頑.mnemo: Again and again you go back to the **fountain** with the same **page** of your essay: still there, still **stubborn**.
k頑.mnemo_lectura: Too **stubborn** to quit, he sticks to his **gun**s: がん (頑張る).

k張.mnemo: You string your **bow** with a lock of **long hair** and pull with all your might to **stretch** it.
k張.mnemo_lectura: As you **stretch** the bow, you let out a grunt: “**Ha**!”: は (張る). In 頑張る it's ば.

k試.mnemo: With **words** of encouragement you throw a **dart** at an **I-beam**: will it stick? You won't know until you **try**.
k試.mnemo_lectura: **Try** to **tame** a wild horse: ため(す).
k試.nota: 式 (ceremony) is its right side alone.

k似.mnemo: A **person** stands beside a stooped figure (以) and copies its pose: same quiff, same crooked leg. Not even their mom can tell how much they **resemble** each other.
k似.mnemo_lectura: Twin brothers: even their **knee**s **resemble** each other: に(る).

k引.mnemo: You grab the **bow**, set a **stick** as an arrow and draw back the string with all your strength: time to **pull**.
k引.mnemo_lectura: You **pull** your sister's braid and giggle: “**Hee**, **hee**!”: ひ(く).

k様.mnemo: A **sheep** up a **tree**, dripping **water**: nobody else does it that way, but that's just her **manner**.
k様.mnemo_lectura: A Good **Sama**ritan with fine **manner**s: さま (神様). In 様子, よう.

palabras.furigana: お 疲[つか]れ 様[さま]
お 客様[きゃくさま]

k形.mnemo: A scruffy **torii** with **three hairs** sticking out: the barber trims it until it has the perfect **shape**.
k形.mnemo_lectura: A **cat**, **a chee**tah: same family, different **shape**: かたち.

k興.mnemo: Two **clones** crammed inside a giant **mortar** that stands on **eight** legs: everyone comes over to stare. They draw huge **interest**.
k興.mnemo_lectura: You find a golden **key**: “**Oh**!” Suddenly you're full of **interest**: きょう(み).

palabras.furigana: 興味深[きょうみぶか]い

k授.mnemo: A **hand** passes a **boomerang**, wrapped in a **blanket**, to a **claw**: the master hands his knowledge to the student. That's how you **impart**.
k授.mnemo_lectura: The sensei loves to **impart** the secrets of **ju**jitsu: じゅ, as in 授業.
k授.nota: 受 (receive, うける) is the same without the hand on the left.

k業.mnemo: A **hedgehog** with **antennae** climbs a **tree** and spends all day pruning without a break: that's his **business**.
k業.mnemo_lectura: Your **business**: folding a thousand **gyo**za a day: ぎょう, as in 作業 and 授業.

k育.mnemo: Under a **lid**, in a cozy **nook**, sleeps a baby. Every night the **moon** watches over him: that's the child it will **raise**.
k育.mnemo_lectura: You **raise** your kids on lemon **soda**: そだ(てる), そだ(つ).

k休.mnemo: A **person** leans against a **tree** in the shade, closes their eyes and starts snoring: time to **rest**.
k休.mnemo_lectura: “**Yas**, a day off!” you cheer, and flop down to **rest**: やす(む).
k休.nota: 体 (body) has one extra line at the bottom.

k周.mnemo: Inside a **goal**, someone packs down **soil** and leaves a **mouth** in the middle: it's a circuit, and the cars zoom round and **around**.
k周.mnemo_lectura: Every lap **around**, the cars whoosh past: “**Shoo**, **shoo**!”: しゅう.

k肉.mnemo: Inside the **goal**, one **person** wrestles another **person** for a steak: in this league, the trophy is **meat**.
k肉.mnemo_lectura: Your friend **Nick** eats his **meat** with bare hands, no fork needed: にく.

k驚.mnemo: A **horse** grazes on **grass** next to a **wrapping** with a **mouth** inside; a **whip** cracks and the horse leaps: what a **surprise**.

k増.mnemo: You toss **soil** into the **pot** and, instead of ruining the stew, it just grows. Every scoop you take only makes it **increase**.
k増.mnemo_lectura: “**Phooey**!” Your to-do list **increase**s again overnight: ふえ(る).

k怖.mnemo: Your **heart** hides behind a **scarf** held up by a hand (ナ): it won't come out, it's frozen with **fear**.
k怖.mnemo_lectura: A zombie **koala** fills you with **fear**: こわ (怖い).

k短.mnemo: An **arrow** no longer than a **bean**: you fire it and it drops at your feet. Your shot falls painfully **short**.
k短.mnemo_lectura: “**Me**? **Gee**, **ca**n't reach!” sighs the **short** guy: みじか(い).

k弟.mnemo: A kid with toy **antennae** wraps himself around your **bow** and won't leave you alone: your **younger brother**.
k弟.mnemo_lectura: Your **younger brother** drives his toy **auto** right over your **toe**: おとうと (弟).

k情.mnemo: A **heart** painted **blue**: sad, calm, or wistful, every shade is an **emotion**.
k情.mnemo_lectura: A good **jo**ke can stir every **emotion**: じょう (感情, 表情, 情報).

k報.mnemo: News of your good luck (幸) arrives with an official **stamp** and a **boomerang** that brings it back: it's a **report**.
k報.mnemo_lectura: “**Ho**ld on, not another **report**!” groans your boss: ほう (情報, 報告).

palabras.furigana: 天気予報[てんきよほう]

k席.mnemo: Under the **shed** there are **twenty** chairs with a **scarf** on each one: that's how people save their **seat**.

k紹.mnemo: You cut a red **thread** with a **knife**, tie two pinkies together, and your **mouth** says both names out loud. That's how you **introduce**.
k紹.mnemo_lectura: You **introduce** your best friend to the **Sho**gun: しょう, as in 紹介.
k紹.nota: 招 (invite, まねく) has a hand instead of a thread.

palabras.furigana: 自己紹介[じこしょうかい]

k介.mnemo: A **person** with open arms steps between a **slide** and a **stick** that are fighting: he stands in the middle to **mediate**.
k介.mnemo_lectura: To **mediate** the peace talks, the diplomat flies to **Cai**ro: かい, as in 紹介.

palabras.furigana: 自己紹介[じこしょうかい]

k払.mnemo: A **hand** digs for the wallet hidden in a **nook** of the pocket… no way out: time to **pay**.
k払.mnemo_lectura: **Harry** always offers to **pay** for lunch: はら(う).
k払.nota: 仏 (Buddha, ほとけ) has a person instead of a hand.

k勝.mnemo: Under the **moon**, a **beetle** flexes its **muscle** and lifts the trophy over its head: against all odds, it managed to **win**.
k勝.mnemo_lectura: The beetle **win**s and steals the whole **show**: しょう.

k途.mnemo: Down the **road**, you drop **leftovers** from your sandwich every mile: the birds follow you for the whole **journey**.
k途.mnemo_lectura: Halfway through the **journey**, you stop for a bowl of **to**fu: と(ちゅう).

k並.mnemo: A **hedgehog** with **antennae** arranges its siblings in a perfect row, spine to spine: it loves to make everyone **line up**.
k並.mnemo_lectura: In **Nara**, even the deer **line up** politely for crackers: なら(ぶ).

palabras.es: to line up (things in a row)

k光.mnemo: Three **small** sparks jump over the number **pi**: the math glows, and there is **light**.
k光.mnemo_lectura: **He car**ries a lantern full of **light**: ひかり (光).

palabras.furigana: 観光客[かんこうきゃく]

k妹.mnemo: A **woman** who hasn't ripened yet, like an **unripe fruit**: your **younger sister**.
k妹.mnemo_lectura: Your **younger sister** went **emo**: black polish on every **toe**: いもうと (妹).
k妹.nota: Don't confuse it with 味 (flavor), which has a mouth instead of a woman, or with 姉 (older sister).

k危.mnemo: Leaning over a **cliff**, fishing with a **fishhook**, your life insurance **stamp** still wet: everything in this photo screams **danger**.
k危.mnemo_lectura: **A boo** in the **nigh**t from a haunted house: **danger**!: あぶない.

k険.mnemo: In a **town** hanging off a cliff, the **assembly** meets: another house right on the edge? Every hand goes up. Here, people live on **risk**.
k険.nota: 験 (test) has a horse; 検 (inspect) has a tree.

k秋.mnemo: You burn the straw from the **grain** in a **fire** after the harvest: the smoke smells like **autumn**.
k秋.mnemo_lectura: In **autumn** you find your lost keys under the leaves: “**Ah**, **key**s!”: あき (秋).

k暗.mnemo: The **sun** switches off and all that's left is **sound**: footsteps, creaks, breathing... everything is **dark**.
k暗.mnemo_lectura: Dra**cula** only goes out when it's **dark**: くら(い).
k暗.nota: 闇 (darkness) puts the sound inside a gate.

k建.mnemo: You draw the blueprints with a giant **brush** and, with each **stride**, a wall goes up: now that's a fun way to **build**.
k建.mnemo_lectura: You **build** a whole house out of **tater** tots: たて, as in 建物.
k建.nota: 健 (health) is the same with a person (亻) in front; 鍵 (key) adds gold.

k原.mnemo: Under the **cliff**, a **small** **white** trickle bubbles up: there's the **source** of the whole river.
k原.mnemo_lectura: The **gen**eral goes looking for the **source** of the leak: げん.
k原.nota: With water beside it, it's 源 (wellspring).

k因.mnemo: A **giant** locked inside a tiny **fence**: that's why the boards creak all night. Now you know the **cause** of the noise.
k因.mnemo_lectura: At the **inn**, a detective hunts for the **cause** of the noise: いん.
k因.nota: 困 (trouble) has a tree inside the fence.

k怒.mnemo: A **boomerang** hits a **woman** on the head and her **heart** starts to boil: she's full of **anger**.
k怒.mnemo_lectura: Red with **anger**, you yell: “**Oh, co**me on!”: おこ (怒る).
k怒.nota: Don't confuse it with 奴 (guy): 怒 is 奴 with a heart underneath.

k皆.mnemo: Some **twins** in **white** shout “Group photo!” In come the twins, the cousins, the dog... and then **everyone**.
k皆.nota: 全 means “all, whole”; 皆 means “everyone,” the people.

k椅.mnemo: You chop down a **tree**, a **giant** sits on the stump, and it holds without a creak: **gold star**. Now you have a **chair**.
k椅.mnemo_lectura: The **chair** lets out a high “**eee**!” when you flop down on it: い, as in 椅子.
k椅.nota: 奇 (odd) is its right side; 寄 (draw near) puts it under a roof.

k例.mnemo: A **person**, the **Grim Reaper** and a **knife** wait in line in perfect order: if you want to see a proper line, here's an **example**.
k例.mnemo_lectura: **Ray** is the classic **example** of the perfect student: れい, as in 例.
k例.nota: 列 (row) is its right side alone.

k警.mnemo: In the **grass**, a **mouth** screams from inside a **wrapping**; someone cracks a **whip** and shouts **words** of warning: everybody on **alert**!
k警.mnemo_lectura: Police **K**-9 dogs never really sleep: they're always on **alert**: けい, as in 警察 and 警戒.
k警.nota: 驚 (surprise) has a horse under the same top part.

k察.mnemo: Under the temple **roof** there's a festival (祭): **moon**, **boomerang** and **altar**. The cop doesn't say a word, but he can **perceive** everything.
k察.mnemo_lectura: The cop **perceive**s you pocketing a **sats**uma: さつ, as in 警察; in 察する, さっ.
k察.nota: 際 (occasion) has the same festival (祭) with a town (阝).

k鳥.mnemo: A head with an eye, a body with wings and four dots for feet: the **bird** element perched right here. It means **bird**.
k鳥.mnemo_lectura: Every **bird** has a s**tory** to tweet: とり.
k鳥.nota: 烏 (crow, からす) is the same without the line in the eye: the crow is so black you can't see it.

k打.mnemo: Your **hand** holds a **nail** bent like a **hook** and you swing the hammer, bam, bam: one **strike** after another.
k打.mnemo_lectura: You **strike** your thumb with the hammer: “**Oo**-**ts**!”: うつ.
k打.nota: 撃つ is also read うつ, but it means to shoot.

k半.mnemo: A robot with **antennae** and a body shaped like **ten** splits right down its center pole: now there are two, each one a **half**.
k半.mnemo_lectura: You snap the cookie in **half** with one **han**d: はん.
k半.nota: With a knife beside it, it's 判 (judge).

k喜.mnemo: A **scholar** opens his **mouth**, you toss in a **bean**, and he starts dancing on the table: he has never felt such **joy**.
k喜.mnemo_lectura: “**Yo**, **Roco**! **Boo**-yah!” You shout for **joy**: よろこぶ.

k腹.mnemo: The full **moon** plays with a **yo-yo** that goes up and down… until it swallows it and its **belly** swells.
k腹.mnemo_lectura: After the feast you pat your full **belly**: “**Hurrah**!”: はら. Watch out: お腹 is read おなか.
k腹.nota: 複 (complex, 複雑) has the same yo-yo with a kimono in front.

k反.mnemo: You throw a **boomerang** at a **cliff** and it bounces straight back at your face: whatever you throw comes back the **opposite** way.
k反.mnemo_lectura: A car speeds the **opposite** way down the street, **hon**king like mad: はん.

k対.mnemo: You get an **inch**-long **tattoo** on each fist and hold them face to face: one **versus** the other.
k対.mnemo_lectura: One **versus** one, and the match ends in a **tie**: たい (絶対, 反対).

k弱.mnemo: Two **bows** so old there's **ice** on their strings. You draw them and they snap: they're hopelessly **weak**.
k弱.mnemo_lectura: “**Yo**, **wa**ter, please… I feel so **weak**”: よわ(い).

k吸.mnemo: A **mouth** with a **long arm** like a straw reaches the neighbor's glass and starts to **inhale**.
k吸.mnemo_lectura: You **inhale** your **sou**p through a straw: す(う). In 呼吸 it's きゅう.
k吸.nota: 扱 (handle) has a hand; 吸, a mouth.

k遠.mnemo: Down the **road** walks a **kimono** with a huge **mouth** and **soil** on its head. You chase it for hours, but it's always **far**.
k遠.mnemo_lectura: An **endless** road trip: “Are we there yet?” every five minutes. It's so **far**: えん, as in 遠慮 and 永遠.
k遠.nota: 園 (garden, as in 学園) has the same 袁 and is also read エン, but inside a fence (囗).

k急.mnemo: A **fishhook** snags your **snout** and someone yanks the line hard: your **heart** races and you run off in a **hurry**.
k急.mnemo_lectura: Right on **cue**, the doors start to close: **hurry**!: きゅう.

k掃.mnemo: Your **hand** grabs the broom: a **snout** of bristles, a **blanket** and a **scarf** tied to the handle. No more excuses: time to **sweep**.
k掃.mnemo_lectura: You **sweep** the floor until it's **so** clean it shines: そう, as in 掃除.
k掃.nota: 婦 (lady) has a woman next to the same broom.

k除.mnemo: After the festival, the **town** is buried in **leftovers**. The mayor has one word for all of it: **remove**.
k除.mnemo_lectura: Big **Jee**ps haul off everything you **remove**: じ, as in 掃除.
k除.nota: 徐 (slowly) has a walker; 途 (journey), a road.

k左.mnemo: One hand (ナ) holds the **I-beam** while the other swings the hammer: the one holding on is your **left**.
k左.mnemo_lectura: You **hid a ree**d basket on your **left**: ひだり (左).
k左.nota: Don't confuse it with 右 (right): 左 has an I-beam (工); 右, a mouth (口).

k失.mnemo: The **husband**'s wedding ring zooms off down a **slide**. Now he's in trouble: it's the one thing he should never **lose**.
k失.mnemo_lectura: You **lose** your **Shih Tzu** at the park: しつ (失礼, 失敗).
k失.nota: Don't confuse it with 矢 (arrow): in 失 the stick pokes out on top.

k敗.mnemo: You lash a **shell** with your **whip** to crack it open, and all you manage is to snap the whip: a humiliating **failure**.
k敗.mnemo_lectura: Your latest baking **failure**: a charred apple **pie**: はい, which turns into ぱい after っ.

k邪.mnemo: A giant **fang** rises over the **town** every night: nobody leaves home. Out there lives something **evil**.
k邪.mnemo_lectura: The **evil** villain strokes his pet **ja**guar: じゃ.

k然.mnemo: A **dog** steals a **moon**-shaped steak and grills it over the **fire**: to him, it's the most **natural** thing.
k然.mnemo_lectura: Staying **Zen** feels **natural**. It sounds just like 全, and together they make 全然: ぜん.

k準.mnemo: A **turkey** floats in the **water** above a cross of **ten**: the waterline marks the **level**.
k準.mnemo_lectura: In **June**, you check that the pool is **level**: じゅん (準備).

k備.mnemo: A **person** stores dry **grass** and a **toolbox** in a cave in the **cliff** in case winter comes: time to **prepare**.
k備.mnemo_lectura: To **prepare** for winter, the **bee**s store honey: び (準備).

k発.mnemo: A pair of **boots** climbs a **torii**, lights the fuse and… boom! Light, smoke, sparks: everything a torii can **emit**.
k発.mnemo_lectura: The cannon **emits** a blast that blows off everyone's **hats**: はつ, clipped to はっ before some sounds, as in 発見 and 発生.
k発.nota: 登 (climb, のぼる) has the same boots over a bean (豆).

k歴.mnemo: A patch of **hemp** with a **bus stop** sign: every army of the past halted right here. Each stalk keeps a piece of their **track record**.
k歴.mnemo_lectura: Your driving **track record**? One **wreck** after another: れき, as in 歴史.
k歴.nota: 暦 (calendar, こよみ) has a sun instead of a bus stop.

k史.mnemo: A **mouth** perched on legs crossed in an X (**five**): the chronicler who travels the world telling it all. That's **history**.
k史.mnemo_lectura: **She**'s a walking **history** book: し, as in 歴史.
k史.nota: 使 (use) puts a person in front; 吏 (official), a line on top.

k比.mnemo: The **twins** stand shoulder to shoulder to see who's taller: all day long, all they do is **compare**.
k比.mnemo_lectura: Grape or cherry? You **compare** two flavors of **Kool**-**A**id: くら(べる).
k比.nota: 北 (north, きた) has its two halves back to back; 比 has them facing the same way.

k現.mnemo: You rub the **king**'s jewel, and the **watcher** locked inside is about to **appear**.
k現.mnemo_lectura: A new **Gen** Z trend is about to **appear**: げん (現実, 現在).

k在.mnemo: A **genie** with his feet planted in the **soil**: he does nothing at all, his only talent is his **presence**.
k在.mnemo_lectura: Your **presence** is loud: you're always home banging a **xy**lophone: ざい (存在, 現在).
k在.nota: Don't confuse it with 存 (exist): 在 has soil (土); 存, a child (子).

k奥.mnemo: A **slide** drops you into a **goal** full of **rice** where a **giant** snores: you've reached the **innermost** spot.
k奥.mnemo_lectura: In the **innermost** corner of the forest stands an old **oak**: おく (奥).

k嘘.mnemo: A **mouth** swears it saw a **tiger** riding a **hedgehog**: nobody buys it. It's a huge **lie**.
k嘘.mnemo_lectura: “**Ooh**, **so** you had lunch with the president?” Total **lie**: うそ.

k雑.mnemo: **Nine** **turkeys** climb the same **tree**: feathers, gobbles, broken limbs… a jumbled, **miscellaneous** mess.
k雑.mnemo_lectura: A **za**ny **tsu**nami of **miscellaneous** junk bursts out of your drawer: ざつ, as in 複雑.
k雑.nota: 難 (difficult) also has a turkey on the right.

k甘.mnemo: You pop a giant **candy** in your mouth: it has so much **sweetness** that your eyes water.

k約.mnemo: You tie a **thread** around the **wrapping** and seal it with a **drop** of wax: the seal of a **promise**.
k約.mnemo_lectura: A **promise** between **yak**s: they swear it on their shaggy fur: やく (約束).

k束.mnemo: A **bundle** of firewood cinched with rope so not one branch can escape: that's how tightly you **bind** it.
k束.mnemo_lectura: “Help! They **bind** my hands with **sock**s!”: そく (約束).
k束.nota: Don't confuse it with 東 (east): 束 has a mouth (口) on the trunk; 東, a sun (日).

k解.mnemo: With a **knife** you separate the **horn** from the **cow**, piece by piece: that's how you start to **solve** a problem.
k解.mnemo_lectura: You **solve** the puzzle and fly a **ki**te to celebrate: かい (理解, 解決).

k技.mnemo: A **hand** juggles a **branch** and a **boomerang** at once without dropping anything: that takes real **technique**.
k技.mnemo_lectura: “**Gee**!” gasps the crowd at your **technique**: ぎ, as in 技術. On its own, 技 is わざ.
k技.nota: 枝 (branch, えだ) has a tree; 支 (support) is the right side alone.

k術.mnemo: A **walker** stops in front of a **tree** with a **drop** of dew and, with one gesture, makes it float: he's mastered a secret **art**.
k術.mnemo_lectura: The **art** of the ninja: nin**jutsu**: じゅつ, as in 技術.
k術.nota: 述 (mention) has the same middle part over a road.

k際.mnemo: The **town** throws a festival (祭): the **moon** and a **boomerang** decorate the **altar**. It's the **occasion** of the year.
k際.mnemo_lectura: On every special **occasion**, grandma lets out a happy **sigh**: さい, as in 実際.
k際.nota: Without the town (阝) it's 祭 (festival, まつり).

k文.mnemo: A **tattoo** on your chest that isn't a picture but letters: you ink a whole paragraph, and now you carry some **writing** on you.
k文.mnemo_lectura: The **writing** on a **Mon**day memo: もん, as in 文句; in 文字 it shrinks to も.
k文.nota: 父 (father) has two little strokes on top instead of a lid.

k化.mnemo: A **person** looks at their reflection in a **spoon**, sees it all warped... and slowly starts to **transform** into it.
k化.mnemo_lectura: The **ca**terpillar will **transform** into a butterfly: か.

k冷.mnemo: A **person** wearing **one** as a hat steps onto the **ice** and marks it with a **stamp**: everything it touches starts to **chill**.
k冷.mnemo_lectura: The ice queen fires a frozen **ray**, and everything starts to **chill**: れい.
k冷.nota: 冷たい is cold to the touch; cold weather is 寒い.

k地.mnemo: A **scorpion** crawls out of the **soil** and traces a line with its tail: nobody crosses into its **ground**.
k地.mnemo_lectura: A **chee**tah sprints across the open **ground**: ち.

k厳.mnemo: At the edge of a **cliff**, a **small** teacher yanks your **ear** and raises the **whip**: nobody is more **strict**.
k厳.mnemo_lectura: Your **strict** trainer feeds you nothing but dog **kib**ble: きび(しい).

k首.mnemo: A **nose** with **antennae** stretches up and up and up until it grows a giraffe **neck**.
k首.mnemo_lectura: You stretch your **neck** to reach the top **cubby**: くび.
k首.nota: 道 (path) has this same 首 on top of the road.

k黒.mnemo: The whole **farm** burns in a **fire** that lasts all night: by dawn, only **black** charcoal is left.
k黒.nota: With a dog beside it, it's 黙 (silence).

k談.mnemo: Around a **fire** stacked on another fire, everyone trades **words** until late: nothing beats a campfire **chat**.
k談.mnemo_lectura: **Dan** keeps the **chat** going by the campfire all night long: だん.

k状.mnemo: A **dog** lying on a **plank**, not moving a muscle: look closely and guess its **condition**.
k状.mnemo_lectura: How's **Joe** next door? His **condition** is getting better: じょう (状態, 状況).

k態.mnemo: From a **nook**, the **moon** and two **spoons** listen to your **heart**: that's how they guess your **attitude**.
k態.mnemo_lectura: With that **attitude**, you act like a little **ty**rant: たい (態度, 状態).

k鍵.mnemo: With a **brush** dipped in gold (金), you paint, in one **stride**, something with teeth that opens any door: a **key**.
k鍵.mnemo_lectura: “My **car**! **Gee**, where did I put the **key**?”: かぎ.
k鍵.nota: 建 (build) is its right side alone; 健 (health) has it with a person.

k机.mnemo: You chop down a **tree**, cut it into boards and nail them onto a folding **table**: your **desk** is ready.
k机.mnemo_lectura: “**Tsk**, **eh**?” mutters the teacher, staring at your messy **desk**: つくえ.
k机.nota: 肌 (skin, はだ) has a moon instead of a tree.

k土.mnemo: A sprout (十) peeking over the ground line: the **soil** element and the kanji are the same thing, **soil**.
k土.mnemo_lectura: On Saturday (土曜日) you **do**ze off on the couch: ど.
k土.nota: 士 (samurai) has the long line on top; 土, on the bottom.

k信.mnemo: A **person** who always keeps their **words**: someone you can **trust**.
k信.mnemo_lectura: You **trust** him: his record is **shiny** clean: しん (信じる, 自信).

k貸.mnemo: A **person** throws you a **dart** with a note: “Can I borrow a **shell**? I'll pay you back.” Once again, you have to **lend**.
k貸.nota: 借 (borrow, かりる) is the opposite: watch who gives and who receives.

k火.mnemo: Two sparks jump to either side of a flame that opens up like someone dancing: that's **fire**, pure **fire**.
k火.mnemo_lectura: A **fire** keeps the **ca**mpers warm: か. Heads-up: fire on its own is read ひ.

k尋.mnemo: A **snout** sniffs an **I-beam**, opens its **mouth** and moves in an **inch** from your face: “And who are you?” It loves to **inquire**.
k尋.mnemo_lectura: You **inquire** about the cheapest way to get to **Tas**mania: たず(ねる).

k迎.mnemo: At the end of the **road**, your aunt waits with a “welcome” **stamp** to press on your forehead: that's her kind of **welcome**.
k迎.mnemo_lectura: A cow runs to **welcome** her lost calf: “**Moo**!” Then she licks the **ca**lf: むか(える).
k迎.nota: 仰 (look up) has the same right side, but with a person (亻).

k腕.mnemo: **Moon** flesh under a **roof**, in the **evening**, with a **stamp** tattooed on it: that's your **arm**.
k腕.mnemo_lectura: A mosquito lands on your **arm** and buzzes: “**Oo**, **de**licious!”: うで (腕).

k議.mnemo: A **sheep** sitting on a **warrior** spews **words** nonstop in parliament: three hours of **debate** so far.
k議.mnemo_lectura: A flock of **gee**se storms the **debate**, honking over everyone: ぎ.
k議.nota: Take away the words (言) and you get 義 (justice).

k慣.mnemo: The **mother**'s **heart** doesn't even flinch when her kid brings home yet another **shell** for the collection: she's grown **accustomed**.
k慣.mnemo_lectura: You grow **accustomed** to a **na**p every afternoon: な(れる).

k絶.mnemo: You cut the **thread** of the **rainbow** and everything turns gray at once: the silence is **absolute**.
k絶.mnemo_lectura: Pure lemon **zest**: the sourness is **absolute**: ぜつ (絶望). In 絶対 it shrinks: ぜっ.

k荷.mnemo: A **person** hauls a bale of **grass** as big as a house; the customs officer weighs it and says, “**Gold star**.” What a **load**.
k荷.mnemo_lectura: Under such a heavy **load**, your **knee** buckles: に, as in 荷物.
k荷.nota: 何 (what, なに) is the same without the grass.

k将.mnemo: On a **plank**, a **claw** measures the battle map **inch** by inch: the general is planning what's to come, the **future**.
k将.mnemo_lectura: The **sho**gun plans the country's **future**: しょう, as in 将来.
k将.nota: 状 (condition) has a dog next to the same plank.

k髪.mnemo: Super **long hair**, **three hairs** combed to one side, and your **friend** holding scissors: he's about to cut your **hair**.
k髪.mnemo_lectura: Your **hair** is so long it covers your **cami**sole: かみ (髪).
k髪.nota: It's read the same as 紙 (paper) and 神 (god): かみ.

k暇.mnemo: The **sun** warms an old ladder (叚) where you lie with nothing to do: a whole day of **free time**.
k暇.mnemo_lectura: With so much **free time**, you finally hike the **Hima**layas: ひま (暇).

k捨.mnemo: Your mom's **hand** storms into the room, drags the **person** out of bed and tugs his **tongue**: “This goes!” Today it's time to **throw away** junk.
k捨.mnemo_lectura: You **throw away** the burnt **stea**k: すて(る).

k去.mnemo: You sweep the **soil** into a **nook**, hide it under the rug, and that's it: time to **leave**.
k去.mnemo_lectura: Last year (去年) you **left** for **Kyo**to: きょ. In 過去, こ.

k落.mnemo: A **courier** slips on the **water** from freshly watered **grass** and the package goes flying: everything is about to **fall**.
k落.mnemo_lectura: A jar of **o**lives is about to **fall** off the shelf: お (落ちる, 落とす).

k狭.mnemo: A **dog** and a **giant** with **antennae** try to squeeze through the cat flap at once: impossible, the opening is way too **narrow**.
k狭.mnemo_lectura: A **sem**i truck gets stuck in the **narrow** alley: せま(い).
k狭.nota: 挟 (sandwich, はさむ) has a hand instead of a dog.

palabras.furigana: 郵便局[ゆうびんきょく]

k念.mnemo: Right now (今), just above your **heart**, something is born that stays with you all day: a stubborn **thought**.
k念.mnemo_lectura: A **hen** with a stuffy nose can only cluck “**nen**, **nen**.” What a pity (残念): ねん.

palabras.furigana: 郵便局[ゆうびんきょく]

k局.mnemo: A **corpse** behind the counter, with a **mouth** that still asks for coffee: he's the oldest clerk at the **bureau**.
k局.mnemo_lectura: At eleven, the whole **bureau** sneaks out for **Kyo**to **coo**kies: きょく.

palabras.furigana: 郵便局[ゆうびんきょく]

k青.mnemo: A **crown** floats over the full **moon** on a clear night: everything turns **blue**.
k青.mnemo_lectura: You stub your toe so hard it turns **blue**: “**Ow**!”: あお(い).
k青.nota: 晴 (clear up), 精 (essence) and 清 (clean) have 青 on the right.

k負.mnemo: In the fishing contest, all you pull up is an empty **shell** stuck on your **fishhook**: the day ends in **defeat**.
k負.mnemo_lectura: “**Ma**, I lost again!” Another **defeat**: ま(ける).
k負.nota: It's the opposite of 勝 (win): together they make 勝負, “match.”

k船.mnemo: A **boat** with **eight** oars and a **mouth** yelling “Row!”: it's not a boat anymore, it's a **ship**.
k船.mnemo_lectura: A Viking **fune**ral: the burning **ship** drifts out to sea. ふね.
k船.nota: 沿 (along) has the same right side next to water.

k鼻.mnemo: A **nose** on top of a **field**, held up by **two hands**: it's so huge it needs support. That's your **nose**.
k鼻.mnemo_lectura: **Hanna**h wrinkles her **nose** at the smell: はな.
k鼻.nota: 花 (flower) is also read はな: don't mix them up.

k熱.mnemo: You set a **ball** on a **dirt clod** and light a **fire** underneath: soon you can't even touch it because of the **heat**.
k熱.mnemo_lectura: In the summer **heat**, the fishing **nets** start to smell: ねつ.
k熱.nota: 勢 (momentum) has muscle (力) where 熱 has fire.

k非.mnemo: Two rows of **prison bars** turn their backs on each other and neither lets anyone through: everything is “no.” It's **negation**.
k非.mnemo_lectura: “Can I go out?” “**He**-he, no way.” Total **negation**: ひ, as in 非常.
k非.nota: 悲 (sad, かなしい) has the bars over a heart.

k常.mnemo: Every morning, the same ritual: a **small** yawn, your **mouth** under the **blanket** and a **scarf** to blow your nose. The **usual**.
k常.mnemo_lectura: Dad's **usual** morning **jo**ke: じょう, as in 異常 and 非常. In 常に it's つね.
k常.nota: 堂 (hall) and 党 (party) share the top part (尚).

k件.mnemo: A **person** and a **cow** walk into the police station together, each blaming the other: the inspector opens a new **case**.
k件.mnemo_lectura: A detective flies to **Ken**tucky to crack the **case**: けん.

k姿.mnemo: On the **ice**, with a diva's **yawn**, a **woman** poses for the camera: what a **figure**.
k姿.mnemo_lectura: Her **figure** stays perfect even after a **sugar ta**rt: すがた (姿).

k薄.mnemo: The **grass** in the **greenhouse** gets only an **inch** of **water** a day: it grows pale, almost see-through, a **faint** green.
k薄.mnemo_lectura: Tea so **faint** it's just water that **ooz**ed past a leaf: うす(い).

k指.mnemo: Your **hand** points a **spoon** at the **sun**; the spoon melts, and all that's left is a **finger** pointing at the sky.

k集.mnemo: A **turkey** climbs a **tree** and gobbles once: a minute later, a hundred turkeys fill the branches. That's how you make a flock **gather**.
k集.mnemo_lectura: “**Ah**, **tsu**nami!” **Gather** everyone on the hill: あつ(める).

k焼.mnemo: You light a **fire** on the **soil**, lay a giant iron **pi** on top as a grate and… straight onto the coals: time to **grill**.
k焼.mnemo_lectura: The meat hits the **grill** and you yell “**Yahoo**, dinner!”: や(く).
k焼.nota: 暁 (dawn) has a sun; 焼 has fire.

k守.mnemo: Under the **roof**, the door open just an **inch** and you standing watch behind it: nobody gets in, it's your job to **protect**.
k守.mnemo_lectura: Guards riding woolly **mammo**ths **protect** the castle: まも (守る).

k逃.mnemo: A **black cat** crosses the **road** in front of you: bad luck. You run and run, thinking only of how to **escape**.

k認.mnemo: A **knife** with a **drop** of blood points at your **heart** until the **words** spill out: you have to **admit** it.
k認.mnemo_lectura: You **admit** it: you still play your old **Nin**tendo: にん (確認, 認識).

k値.mnemo: A **person** studies a tag marked **ten** with a magnifying **eye**: is it really that good? They work out its **value**.
k値.mnemo_lectura: The **value** of one slice of **cheese**: next to nothing: ち, as in 価値.
k値.nota: 植 (plant) has a tree; 置 (put), a net.

k段.mnemo: You drive a **lance** into the **cliff**, then **two** more a little higher: now you have **step** after step to climb.
k段.mnemo_lectura: “**Done**!” you gasp on the very last **step**: だん.

k組.mnemo: You tie the rungs of a **ladder** with **thread** and hold it up together: alone you couldn't, together you're a **team**.
k組.mnemo_lectura: Your **team** sits around the campfire singing “**Kum**baya”: くみ; in 組む, く; in 組織, そ.
k組.nota: 祖 (ancestor) has an altar; 助 (help), muscle; 組, thread.

k壁.mnemo: The **executioner** piles up **soil**, more and more, until he's built a **wall**: behind it, he hides his axe.
k壁.mnemo_lectura: A **cab** swerves and slams into the **wall**: かべ.
k壁.nota: 避 (avoid) has the same 辟, but with a road.

k派.mnemo: The **water** of a river splits into forking streams (𠂢), each going its own way, like a party after a fight: each stream is a **faction**.
k派.mnemo_lectura: At family dinner, **Pa** leads his own **faction**: ぱ, as in 立派; in 派手 it's は.
k派.nota: 脈 (pulse) has the same right side with a moon.

k血.mnemo: A red drop rolls down the **slide** and lands on the **plate**: it's thick, it's warm, it's **blood**.
k血.mnemo_lectura: You bite your **chee**k and taste **blood**: ち.
k血.nota: Don't confuse it with 皿 (plate): 血 has one more stroke on top.

k的.mnemo: A **white** board with a **sun** painted on it; some **wrapping** covers it and leaves only a red **drop** in the middle: that's where you aim. That's your **target**.
k的.mnemo_lectura: A **techie** locks onto the **target** with a laser pointer: てき.
k的.nota: 約 (promise) has the same 勺, but with thread. As a suffix, 的 works like “-ic” or “-al.”

palabras.furigana: 積極的[せっきょくてき]

k階.mnemo: In **town**, two **twins** dressed in **white** race up a tower, floor by floor. Who reaches the top **story** first?
k階.mnemo_lectura: Climb **story** after story until you touch the **sky**: かい, as in 階段.
k階.nota: Without the town (阝) it's 皆 (everyone, みんな).

k互.mnemo: Between **two** lines, two **snouts** fit together like puzzle pieces, each biting the other: a **reciprocal** favor.
k互.mnemo_lectura: In **tag** it's all **reciprocal**: you chase, then you get chased: たが, as in お互い.

k況.mnemo: Your **big brother** dumps a bucket of ice **water** on you while you sleep: talk about a rude **circumstance**.
k況.mnemo_lectura: Given the **circumstance**s, you catch the first train to To**kyo**: きょう (状況).

k悲.mnemo: A **heart** locked behind **prison bars**, watching the street and unable to get out: pure **sadness**.
k悲.mnemo_lectura: Snowed in all winter in **Cana**da, you feel a wave of **sadness**: かな(しい).

k成.mnemo: With the **halberd**, you drive a **nail** into the castle wall, climb up and plant your flag on top: you just managed to **achieve** it.
k成.mnemo_lectura: A **sai**lor **achieve**s his dream of crossing the ocean: せい.

k功.mnemo: You lift an **I-beam** with pure **muscle** in front of the whole town: they hang a medal on you for your **merit**.
