k功.mnemo_lectura: The **coa**ch hands you a medal for your **merit**: こう.

k挨.mnemo: From a **nook**, a **hand** tosses you a paper **arrow** that says “hi”: someone wants to come closer with a friendly **nudge**.
k挨.mnemo_lectura: You catch their **eye** and give a friendly **nudge**: あい(さつ).
k挨.nota: It's almost only used in 挨拶 (greeting), together with 拶.

k拶.mnemo: In the **evening**, by the **river**, you raise your **hand** to everyone who walks by: it's your daily ritual, the **greeting**.
k拶.mnemo_lectura: You hand everyone a **satsu**ma as a **greeting**: (あい)さつ.
k拶.nota: It only appears in 挨拶 (greeting).

k辛.mnemo: You bite into a **chili pepper** and even your ears start crying: element and kanji say the same thing, **spicy**.
k辛.mnemo_lectura: After **spicy** wings, you scream **kara**oke all night: から(い). When something is tough, つら(い).
k辛.nota: 幸 (happiness, しあわせ) has one more line on top: don't mix them up!

k弾.mnemo: You use a **bow** as a guitar: the notes hop across the **field** like **ten** **small** sparrows. You're learning to **strum**.
k弾.mnemo_lectura: When you **strum** the guitar, a happy “**Hee**!” slips out: ひ(く).
k弾.nota: 単 (simple) is its right side; 戦 (war) has it with a halberd.

k参.mnemo: A **giant** with **three hairs** comes out of his **nook** and signs up for everything: sack race, bingo, dance-off... he loves to **participate**.
k参.mnemo_lectura: Every **Sun**day, he's the first to **participate**: さん.

k加.mnemo: With pure **muscle**, you cram one more meatball into your full **mouth**: there's always room to **add**.
k加.mnemo_lectura: You **add** one more duck to the pond: “**Qua**ck!”: くわ(える).

k鏡.mnemo: You rub gold (金) until it shines, it rings with a high **sound** and a pair of **legs** appears: yours, reflected in the **mirror**.
k鏡.mnemo_lectura: “**Ca**ll me **Ga**ga… it's **me**!” you sing to the **mirror**: かがみ.
k鏡.nota: 境 (border) has soil instead of gold.

k星.mnemo: A tiny **sun** has just been born in its **cradle** of cosmic dust: it's still a baby, but it's already a **star**.
k星.mnemo_lectura: “**Ho**! **She**'s a **star**!” shouts Santa at the school play: ほし.

k責.mnemo: You wear a **crown** and carry a **shell** full of coins: you're king and treasurer. If anything goes wrong, it's on you: all the **responsibility**.
k責.mnemo_lectura: “**Say**, **key**s are your **responsibility**!”: せき, as in 責任. When someone blames you, せ(める).
k責.nota: 積 (pile up) adds grain; 績 (achievement) adds thread.

k任.mnemo: A **person** zooms down a **slide**, lands on a **scholar** and drops a pile of work in his lap: “This, my friend, I **entrust** to you.”
k任.mnemo_lectura: You **entrust** dinner to a talking **macaw**: まか(せる).
k任.nota: 仕 (serve) doesn't have the slide above the scholar.

k神.mnemo: **Lightning** strikes the **altar** and the statue opens its eyes: a **god** has just come down.
k神.mnemo_lectura: **Kami**kaze literally means “wind of the **gods**”: かみ.
k神.nota: 紙 (paper) and 髪 (hair) are also read かみ: look closely at the kanji.

k過.mnemo: A **skull** with its **mouth** wide open tears down the **road** way past the limit: every speed sign it sees, it will **exceed**.
k過.mnemo_lectura: At the **su**permarket you always **exceed** your budget: す (過ぎる). In 過去, か.

palabras.furigana: 通[とお]り 過[す]ぎる

k内.mnemo: A **person** ducks out of the rain into the **goal** and watches the match from its dry **interior**.
k内.mnemo_lectura: At **night**, you stay in the cozy **interior**: ない.

k容.mnemo: You put a **roof** over an entire **valley**: now it's a giant warehouse that can **contain** anything you throw in.
k容.mnemo_lectura: “**Yo**, how much can this box **contain**?” “Everything!”: よう.

k影.mnemo: The **sun** shines on a **lid**, a **mouth** and something **small** with **three hairs**: on the ground appears a monstrous **shadow**.
k影.mnemo_lectura: Your **shadow** copies you all day: it gets an **A** for effort: えい.

k響.mnemo: In **town**, a ball of **yarn** rolls into the **brake** of a cart: the **sound** bounces around the valley and lingers for hours as an **echo**.
k響.mnemo_lectura: You yell “**Heebie**-jeebies!” in the cave, and the **echo** yells it back: ひび(く).

k趣.mnemo: A **runner** heads out every Sunday with an alert **ear** and a **boomerang** in hand: running and throwing is his **hobby**.
k趣.mnemo_lectura: Your **hobby**: collecting **shoe**s: しゅ, as in 趣味.
k趣.nota: 取 (take, とる) is its right side.

k震.mnemo: The **rain** soaks the **rooster** down to its feathers, and the poor bird starts to **tremble**.
k震.mnemo_lectura: “You **fool**!” you yell, and **tremble** with rage: ふる(える).

k努.mnemo: A **woman** throws a **boomerang** again and again until her **muscle** burns: she'll never stop, she'll always **strive**.
k努.mnemo_lectura: You **strive** all night, kneading **dough** until dawn: ど, as in 努力.
k努.nota: 怒 (get angry, おこる) has a heart below instead of muscle.

k量.mnemo: The **sun** checks the **farm**'s harvest and writes it on line **one** of the notebook: sacks, gallons, pounds… All it cares about is the **amount**.
k量.mnemo_lectura: **Leo** the lion eats a huge **amount** of meat every day: りょう, as in 量 and 大量.
k量.nota: 重 (heavy, おもい) looks similar, but has no sun on top.

k役.mnemo: A **walker** with a **lance** and a **boomerang** rehearses on stage: today he plays the warrior. It's his **role**.
k役.mnemo_lectura: Your only **role** in the school play: shouting “**Yuck**!”: やく, as in 役 and 役に立つ.
k役.nota: 投 (throw, なげる) has a hand instead of the walker.

k寂.mnemo: Under the **roof** lives a **small** **fortune teller** who plays alone with a **boomerang**: he throws, it comes back, nobody claps. Pure **loneliness**.
k寂.mnemo_lectura: Alone at the sushi bar, you eat the wa**sabi** and cry from **loneliness**: さび(しい).

k期.mnemo: Every full **moon** you drop a stone in the **basket**: when there are twelve, the **period** is over.
k期.mnemo_lectura: **Kee**p going: the exam **period** is almost over!: き.
k期.nota: 基 (base) has soil where 期 has a moon.

k従.mnemo: A **walker** with **antennae** reaches a **bus stop** sign and stops dead, without a word of protest: he knows how to **obey**.
k従.mnemo_lectura: Your little sister? **She tag**s along and **obey**s every word you say: したが(う).
k従.nota: 徒 (pupil, 生徒) has soil where 従 has antennae.

k離.mnemo: A **turkey** steps on a **trap** hidden under a **lid** and leaves a **footprint** in the mud: it flaps away to **separate** from it all.
k離.mnemo_lectura: You **separate** from **Hanna** at the station: はな (離れる).

k幸.mnemo: A patch of **soil**, **antennae** with good Wi-Fi and a **clothesline** drying in the sun: that's all you need for **happiness**.
k幸.mnemo_lectura: **She**'s **a wa**sabi **se**ller, and nothing burns her **happiness**: しあわせ.
k幸.nota: Don't confuse it with 辛 (spicy): 幸 has soil (土) on top and one extra line.

k恥.mnemo: Your **ears** turn red and your **heart** races: you could die of **shame**.
k恥.mnemo_lectura: What **shame**: a “**Ha**!” slips out in the middle of a funeral: は (恥ずかしい).

k森.mnemo: On top of a **grove** you plant one more **tree**: three trees together, and you're already lost in the **forest**.
k森.mnemo_lectura: **Maury** gets lost in the **forest** every single weekend: もり.

k馬.mnemo: Up top, the head with its mane in the wind; below, four legs at full gallop: the **horse** element runs solo across the page and means **horse**.
k馬.mnemo_lectura: The **horse** gallops in, foaming at the mouth, and a kid gasps, “**Ooh, ma**!”: うま. In 馬鹿 it's ば, like a sheep's “**baa**.”

k鹿.mnemo: Under a **shed** sleep two **twins** with antlers; see their little hooves poking out at the bottom? They're baby **deer**.
k鹿.mnemo_lectura: Call a horse a **deer** and a crow mocks you: “**Caw**, you fool!”: か, as in 馬鹿 (fool).

k直.mnemo: **Ten** carpenters squint one **eye** and lay the square on the board: nobody goes home until it's perfectly **straight**.
k直.mnemo_lectura: Fix that crooked shelf **now**, and make it **straight**: なお(す).

k描.mnemo: Your **hand** grabs a stick and traces the **grass**, blade by blade, across the **field**: the whole field is your canvas to **sketch**.
k描.mnemo_lectura: You **sketch** a little **ca**r in the margin of your notebook: か(く).

k愛.mnemo: A **claw** lifts the **blanket** and finds a **heart** shivering with cold; it loads it onto the **sled** and takes it home. That's **love**.
k愛.mnemo_lectura: “**I** **love** you,” growls the bear with the big claw: あい.

k匂.mnemo: You open a **wrapping** and find a **spoon** with week-old stew on it: the **smell** knocks you flat.
k匂.mnemo_lectura: You sniff your **knee**: “**Oh**, what a **smell**!”: におい.

k案.mnemo: Under a **roof**, a **woman** leaning on a **tree** sketches blueprints on its bark: she's got a **plan**.
k案.mnemo_lectura: **Ann** always shows up with a **plan**: あん, as in 案内 and 提案.
k案.nota: Without the tree it's 安 (cheap, calm).

k門.mnemo: Two huge wooden doors, one on each side, flung wide open: the **gate** element in person. It means **gate**.
k門.mnemo_lectura: A **mon**k sweeps the path by the **gate**: もん.
k門.nota: 問 (question) has a mouth inside; 間 (interval), a sun; 聞 (hear), an ear.

k許.mnemo: You aim a **rifle** at him and, at **ten** sharp, you say the magic **words**: “I **forgive** you.”
k許.mnemo_lectura: They **forgive** you and even invite you to sleep in their **yur**t: ゆる (許す).

palabras.furigana: 運転免許[うんてんめんきょ]

k具.mnemo: An **eye** resting on **one** and **eight** legs: the watchmaker's desk magnifier, his favorite **utensil**.
k具.mnemo_lectura: Every **utensil** in the drawer is covered in **goo**: ぐ, as in 道具.
k具.nota: 真 (truth) has 十 above the eye; 具 doesn't.

k裏.mnemo: You turn the **kimono** inside out and, sewn on the inside, there's a whole **farm**, cows and all: the best part was on the **flip side**.
k裏.mnemo_lectura: The **flip side** of the solar system: **Ura**nus spins lying on its side: うら.

k表.mnemo: A **crown** embroidered on the chest of a **kimono**: on the outside you show who you are, it's how you **express** yourself.
k表.mnemo_lectura: To **express** his joy, the cowboy shouts: “**Hi-yo**, Silver!”: ひょう (表情).

palabras.furigana: 食料品[しょくりょうひん]

k久.mnemo: A **fishhook** hangs from a **slide**, waiting for a bite… and nothing. A **long time** goes by.
k久.mnemo_lectura: “**Long time** no see!” **He saw** you at last: ひさ, as in 久しぶり.

k完.mnemo: You put a **roof** over the **fountain** and nothing is missing: the project is **complete**.
k完.mnemo_lectura: Genghis **Khan** rests: his empire is **complete**: かん (完全, 完璧).

k閉.mnemo: The house **genie** plants himself in the middle of the **gate** with arms crossed and lets no one through: his job is to keep it **shut**.
k閉.mnemo_lectura: You **shut** the door right on your **toe**: と(じる).
k閉.nota: 開 (open, あける) has a torii (开) inside the gate; 閉 has a genie (才).

k石.mnemo: Under a cliff (厂), the mouth (口) of a cave is blocked by a **stone**: you push it, it's heavy, it scrapes. Yes, it's a real **stone**.
k石.mnemo_lectura: “**Easy**!” brags the kid, lifting a huge **stone**: いし.

k突.mnemo: A **giant** bursts out of a **hole** and goes through the wall headfirst: his favorite sport is to **ram**.
k突.mnemo_lectura: Out of nowhere, a herd of **tots** **ram**s into you at daycare: とつ(ぜん).

k酒.mnemo: You pour **water** into a bottle of **sake** to water it down and… nothing, it still packs a punch: it's pure **alcohol**.
k酒.mnemo_lectura: For goodness' **sake**, no more **alcohol**! Just say it the Japanese way: さけ.
k酒.nota: 配 (distribute) has the same sake next to a snake (己).

k価.mnemo: A **person** asks the **cowboy** how much he wants for his horse; he spits and names a figure: that's the **price**.
k価.mnemo_lectura: The **price**? A whole **car**: か, as in 価値 and 評価.
k価.nota: 要 (need) has the same cowboy over a woman.

k数.mnemo: A **woman** counts grains of **rice**, and each time she slips up she cracks the **whip** at herself: she's obsessed with the exact **number**.
k数.mnemo_lectura: Every **number** in the school band is played on a **kazoo**: かず.

k脱.mnemo: Under the full **moon**, the **flirt** starts a striptease on the beach: shirt, shoes, socks… He loves to **take off** his clothes.
k脱.mnemo_lectura: You **take off** everything and end up **nude**: ぬ(ぐ).
k脱.nota: 税 (tax) has grain; 説 (explain), words; 鋭 (sharp), gold.

k島.mnemo: A **bird** lands on the peak of a **mountain** poking out of the sea: it's resting on an **island**.
k島.mnemo_lectura: The **island** sands **shim**mer in the sun: しま.
k島.nota: 鳥 (bird) has four dots where 島 has a mountain.

k届.mnemo: A **corpse** rings your doorbell holding a **root** in gift wrap: “Sign here.” It's the zombie delivery guy, and he lives to **deliver**.
k届.mnemo_lectura: Today's **to-do** list: **deliver** forty packages: とど(く).

k詳.mnemo: A **sheep** describes in **words** every curl of its wool, one by one, for three hours: its report is extremely **detailed**.
k詳.mnemo_lectura: The **qua**rterback memorizes a **detailed** playbook: くわ(しい).

k回.mnemo: A little **mouth** stuck inside a big **fence**, going in circles, unable to find the exit: another **round**.
k回.mnemo_lectura: You paddle one more **round** in your **kay**ak: かい (今回, 回復).

k限.mnemo: At the edge of **town**, a sign with a **brake** painted on it: you can't go any farther. Its job is to **limit** the way.
k限.mnemo_lectura: Dad hides the **car key**: one ride a day is your **limit**: かぎ(る).

k晴.mnemo: A blazing **sun** in a **blue** sky without a single cloud: the weather has finally decided to **clear up**.
k晴.mnemo_lectura: The skies **clear up**: **ba**rbecue time!: ば, as in 素晴らしい; on its own, は(れる).
k晴.nota: 清 (clean) has water; 精 (essence), rice; 晴, sun.

k含.mnemo: Right now (今) you stuff the lollipop, the gum and even the stick into your **mouth**: it all fits inside. You know how to **include** everything.
k含.mnemo_lectura: The party pack **include**s **foo**d, **coo**kies and more: ふく(む), ふく(める).
k含.nota: 今 (now) is its top part; 念 (thought) has a heart below.

k壊.mnemo: You scoop **soil** with a **net**, **ten** times in a row, onto your sister's best **kimono**: you've managed to **destroy** it.
k壊.mnemo_lectura: A **cow wa**nders into a china shop and starts to **destroy** everything: こわ(す), こわ(れる).
k壊.nota: 懐 (nostalgia, 懐かしい) has a heart (忄) instead of soil.

k種.mnemo: A stalk of **grain** so loaded it weighs as much as a **barbell**: each grain will become a new plant. It's a **seed**.
k種.mnemo_lectura: “**Shoo**, birds! Don't eat my **seed**s!”: しゅ, as in 種類.
k種.nota: 動 (move) and 働 (work) have the same barbell.

k類.mnemo: A **giant** sorts grains of **rice** by size and notes them on a **page**: each pile gets its own **category**.
k類.mnemo_lectura: **Louie** sorts his collection by **category**: るい, as in 種類.

k鳴.mnemo: A **bird** opens its **mouth** wide at six in the morning: tweet, tweet, a living alarm clock set to **ring**.
k鳴.mnemo_lectura: Your phone starts to **ring**… “**Nah**, it's spam”: な(る). In 悲鳴 it's めい.
k鳴.nota: 島 (island) has a mountain under the bird.

k菓.mnemo: Up in a **tree** in the **field** grows a **grass** that bears sugar fruit: you pick it all to make **sweets**.
k菓.mnemo_lectura: **Ca**ramel **sweets**: か, as in お菓子.
k菓.nota: 果 (fruit, 結果) is the same without the grass.

k主.mnemo: A **drop** of holy oil falls on the **king**'s head: now he's the **lord** of the castle.
k主.mnemo_lectura: “**Oh**, **mo**re wine, my **lord**?” the servant asks: おも.
k主.nota: 玉 (jewel) has the drop at the bottom; 主 has it on top.

palabras.furigana: 民主主義[みんしゅしゅぎ]

k珍.mnemo: The **king** receives a **person** with only **three hairs** on his head, combed in single file: he's never seen anything so **rare**.
k珍.mnemo_lectura: In **May**, the **zoo** gets a **ra**… a truly **rare** panda: めずら(しい).

k細.mnemo: You pull a **thread** that runs across the whole **field**: you can barely see it. It couldn't be more **slender**.
k細.mnemo_lectura: A garden **hose** so **slender** it looks like a noodle: ほそ(い).

k齢.mnemo: You count the teeth (a **bus stop**, grains of **rice** in a **bowl**) of a **person** with a birth **stamp**: that's how you figure out their **age**.
k齢.mnemo_lectura: **Ray** won't tell anyone his real **age**: れい, as in 年齢.
k齢.nota: 歯 (tooth, は) is its left side; 令 (command), the right.

k触.mnemo: A **bug** with a **horn** on its head prods everything in its path: it just can't resist the urge to **touch**.
k触.mnemo_lectura: Keep **touch**ing that old rope and it'll **fray**, **roo**kie: ふれる.

k流.mnemo: **Water** pushes up the **lid** in a **nook** of the basement and pours out as a **river**. Nothing stops it: all it knows is how to **flow**.
k流.mnemo_lectura: A **naga**, half woman and half snake, rides the river's **flow** downstream: なが(れる).

k距.mnemo: A giant **foot** kicks a **box** and sends it flying miles away. Now it's your job to measure the **distance**.
k距.mnemo_lectura: Your crush lives in To**kyo** and you live on a farm: pure **distance**: きょ.

k激.mnemo: The **water** boils **white**, the **compass** spins like crazy and a **whip** lashes the waves: this storm is as **intense** as they come.
k激.mnemo_lectura: An old **hag**, **eh**? She stirs her cauldron with **intense** fury: はげ(しい).

k告.mnemo: A **cow** pops up over a giant **mouth** and starts mooing through a megaphone: she has something important to **announce**.
k告.mnemo_lectura: Breaking news! We're proud to **announce** free **cocoa** for everyone: こく.
k告.nota: 酷 (cruel) has sake next to 告.

k不.mnemo: A **slide**, a **stick** and a **drop** try to sneak under the bar of **one**, but the bouncer crosses his arms: “Tonight you're **not** getting in.”
k不.nota: With a mouth underneath it becomes 否 (deny).

k礼.mnemo: At the **altar**, a **duckling** bends its neck all the way to the floor: a duck with great **courtesy**.
k礼.mnemo_lectura: Out of **courtesy**, you bow deeply to your neighbor **Ray**: れい (失礼, お礼).

k識.mnemo: Mix **words**, **sound** and a whack of the **halberd** on the head: that's how, the hard way, in goes **knowledge**.
k識.mnemo_lectura: **She** holds the **key** to all **knowledge**: しき.
k識.nota: 織 (weave) has thread (糸); 職 (job) has an ear (耳).

k喉.mnemo: A **person** swallows an **arrow** through the **mouth** in a circus act: they feel it slide down their whole **throat**.
k喉.mnemo_lectura: Your **throat** is so sore you can only **nod**: のど.
k喉.nota: 候 (weather, 天候) is almost the same without the mouth.

k布.mnemo: A hand (ナ) spreads a giant **scarf** across the counter: it's not a scarf, it's a whole roll of **cloth**.
k布.nota: 希 (longing) has the same part under an X.

k太.mnemo: A **giant** with a **drop** of fat between his legs: all that eating has made him **thick**.
k太.mnemo_lectura: You come back from **Thai**land **thick** from all that pad thai: たい, as in 太陽.
k太.nota: 犬 (dog) has the dot at the top right; 太, at the bottom.

k陽.mnemo: In the **town**, the **sun** rises over **one** waving **flag**: everyone steps out into the **sunlight**.
k陽.mnemo_lectura: Stretched out in the **sunlight**, you do some **yo**ga: よう, as in 太陽.
k陽.nota: 場 (place) and 湯 (hot water) have the same right side.

k勢.mnemo: A **dirt clod** hurled together with a **ball**, all the **muscle** of your arm behind it: it smashes three windows at once. What **momentum**.
k勢.mnemo_lectura: “**Eek**, **oh**! No brakes!” The sled keeps gaining **momentum**: いきおい.
k勢.nota: 熱 (heat) has fire where 勢 has muscle.

k満.mnemo: The **water** rises over the **grass**, covers the **goal** and reaches the top of the **mountain**: the valley is **full** to the brim.
k満.mnemo_lectura: After the tenth **man**go, you're **full**: まん.

k包.mnemo: You tuck a **snake** inside gift **wrapping** and tie a bow: nobody will ever guess what you had to **wrap**.
k包.mnemo_lectura: “**Toot**-**toot**!” The toy train is **wrap**ped in a giant bow: つつ(む).

k暮.mnemo: Every evening the **sun** hides behind the **thicket**, and you're still there, getting by, day after day: that's your **livelihood**.
k暮.mnemo_lectura: Even the **Kra**ken needs a **livelihood**: it sinks ships for a living: くら(す).
k暮.nota: 住む is where you reside; 暮らす is how you get by from day to day.

k涙.mnemo: A **giant** gets stuck behind a **door** and **water** runs down his face: it's a **teardrop** the size of a bucket.
k涙.mnemo_lectura: “**Nah**, **me**? **Da**d, I'm not crying!” A **teardrop** rolls down: なみだ.

k胸.mnemo: **Moon** flesh folded into a **wrapping** that hides a **trap** for secrets: you keep them in your **chest**.
k胸.mnemo_lectura: You keep your **money** close to your **chest**: むね (胸).

k逆.mnemo: In the middle of the **road** grows a **sprout** with **antennae**… but upside down, roots in the air: here everything goes **backward**.
k逆.mnemo_lectura: “**Gyah**! **Coo**l!” yells a kid as a car zooms **backward** past him: ぎゃく.

k到.mnemo: You cross the **finish line** and someone cuts the ribbon with a **knife**: at last, your **arrival**!
k到.mnemo_lectura: Your car broke down, so a **tow** truck handles your **arrival**: とう, as in 到着.
k到.nota: 倒 (fall over, たおれる) is 到 with a person in front.

k助.mnemo: You climb a **ladder** on pure **muscle** to get the cat off the roof: you're there to **help**.
k助.mnemo_lectura: You **help** the graduate fix her **tas**sel: たす (助ける).

k魔.mnemo: A **ghost** hides in a field of **hemp** and, when night falls, it grows horns: it's a **demon**.
k魔.mnemo_lectura: Even the scariest **demon** is afraid of his **Ma**: ま (魔法, 悪魔).

k投.mnemo: Your **hand** grabs a **lance** and hurls it spinning like a **boomerang**: now that's a **throw**.
k投.mnemo_lectura: You **throw** a **na**cho and the dog catches it midair: な(げる).
k投.nota: 役 (role) has a walker instead of a hand; 設 (set up), words.

k背.mnemo: A **plank** and a **spoon** sit on the **moon**, leaning against each other: they've got each other's **back** while they watch the Earth.
k背.mnemo_lectura: Someone scratches your **back** and all you can **say** is “ahh”: せ.

k倒.mnemo: A **person** crosses the **finish line**, but a **knife** slices his laces and he collapses: nothing like a trip to **knock down** the champ.
k倒.mnemo_lectura: A whole **tow**er gets **knock**ed **down**, crash: たお(れる).

k員.mnemo: A **mouth** on top of a **shell**: it's the gold badge every **member** of the club wears to get in.
k員.mnemo_lectura: Only **member**s are **in**, inside the club: いん.

k振.mnemo: Your **hand** grabs the **rooster** by its legs and swings it overhead: the loudest, featheriest goodbye **wave** ever.
k振.mnemo_lectura: Someone shouts your name. “**Who**?” You turn around and **wave**: ふ(る).

k踊.mnemo: A **foot**, a **kangaroo** and a **toolbox** hop around the floor all night: they never stop, they just **dance**.
k踊.nota: 通 (pass through) and 痛 (pain) have the same right side.

k複.mnemo: You try to put on a **kimono** while playing with a **yo-yo**: layers, cords, knots… the string gets tangled. It's all very **complex**.
k複.mnemo_lectura: A **complex** cuckoo clock: the bird pops out, goes “**Foo**… **coo**!” and ducks back in. ふく, as in 複雑.
k複.nota: 腹 (belly) has a moon; 複 has a kimono.

k携.mnemo: Your **hand** grabs a **turkey** that bounces like a **coil** and stuffs it in your pocket: it goes everywhere with you now. It's yours to **tote**.
k携.mnemo_lectura: You **tote** your phone even in a **kay**ak: けい, as in 携帯.

palabras.furigana: 携帯電話[けいたいでんわ]

k帯.mnemo: On a **blanket** you fold a **scarf**, sew **twenty** buckles onto it and tie it around your waist: a **sash**.
k帯.mnemo_lectura: For **tai** chi class, you tie on your **sash**: たい, as in 携帯.

palabras.furigana: 携帯電話[けいたいでんわ]

k希.mnemo: You cross your fingers into a **five** (an X) over your lucky **scarf** and wave it in the wind: there goes all your **longing**.
k希.mnemo_lectura: Your deepest **longing**: the **key** to a house by the sea: き, as in 希望.

k望.mnemo: From his **coffin**, a **king** peeks at the **moon** through a crack and sighs: his last **hope** is to see it up close again.
k望.mnemo_lectura: You tie your last **hope** with a red **bow**: ぼう.

k択.mnemo: Your **hand** picks up a **ruler** and measures every option, one by one, before deciding: it's so hard to **opt**.
k択.mnemo_lectura: Shirt in or out? You **opt** to **tuck** it in: たく, as in 選択.
k択.nota: 沢 (abundance) has water; 駅 (station), a horse, next to the same ruler.

k記.mnemo: A **snake** coils up beside your **words** and copies them onto the wall with its tail: that snake lives to **write down** everything.
k記.mnemo_lectura: Who said that? Grab the **key**board and **write** it **down**: き.

k憶.mnemo: A **sound** gets stuck in one **heart**, and below it another **heart** beats it back: that song is now a **memory**.
k憶.mnemo_lectura: Your first **memory** is carved deep into an old **oak** tree: おく.
k憶.nota: 億 (hundred million) is nearly identical, but has a person (亻) instead of a heart (忄).

k録.mnemo: With gold (金) ink, a **snout** writes down every drop of **water** that falls from the tap: it keeps a thorough **log**.
k録.mnemo_lectura: You cut a **rock** album and it goes down in the **log**: ろく, as in 記録.
k録.nota: 緑 (green, みどり) has thread instead of gold.

k抑.mnemo: A **hand** presses a **stamp** down on the pressure cooker's valve: not a puff escapes. Time to **restrain**.
k抑.mnemo_lectura: In **Osa**ka you **restrain** yourself from eating all the takoyaki: おさ(える).
k抑.nota: 仰 (look up) and 迎 (welcome) share the right side.

k繰.mnemo: You tie a **thread** to the **packages** hanging from a **tree** and start winding. Round and round, all afternoon, you **reel**.
k繰.mnemo_lectura: Your roommate cooks **curry**, then **curry** again: repeat forever: くり(かえす).

k争.mnemo: A **fishhook** and a **snout** pull on the same **hook** in a tug-of-war: neither lets go. What a **dispute**.
k争.mnemo_lectura: Two tailors get into a **dispute** over who gets to **sew** the flag: そう, as in 戦争.
k争.nota: 浄 (clean) adds water; 静 (quiet) adds blue.

k謝.mnemo: With soft **words**, you bend your whole **body** until your forehead is an **inch** from the floor: that's how you **apologize** in Japan.
k謝.nota: 感謝 means “gratitude”: the same kanji works for thanking and for apologizing.

k格.mnemo: A **tree** pulls a **sled** carrying a **mouth** that sings opera: in this forest, that's the highest **status**.
k格.mnemo_lectura: The duchess of high **status** lets out a **cack**le: かく.

k駄.mnemo: A **horse** so **giant** and fat it won't budge even for a **drop** of gasoline: for racing, it's completely **useless**.
k駄.mnemo_lectura: Your **Da**d tries to fix the Wi-Fi again: **useless**: だ.

k想.mnemo: An **eye** looks at a **tree** and the **heart** starts dreaming: little hanging houses, swings, a castle in the treetop… it begins to **imagine**.
k想.mnemo_lectura: Close your eyes and **imagine** you can **soa**r: そう.

k像.mnemo: A **person** sculpts a **pig** with a **fishhook** in its **mouth**, and the mayor plants it in the square: at last the town has its **statue**.
k像.mnemo_lectura: **Zo**e stands so still in the square that tourists think she's a **statue**: ぞう.

k寄.mnemo: A **giant** sees a **roof** with a **gold star** sign (the bar has great reviews): he just can't help but **drop by**.
k寄.mnemo_lectura: “**Yo**, I'll **drop by** later!” your friend always says: よ(る).
k寄.nota: 奇 (strange) and 椅 (chair) have the same part; 寄 adds a roof.

k士.mnemo: The **scholar** is a cross planted firmly on a short base: in old Japan, scholars carried swords too. That was the **samurai**.
k士.mnemo_lectura: The **samurai** slides his sword into its **shea**th: し, as in 兵士 and 同士.
k士.nota: 土 (soil) has the longer line at the bottom; 士, at the top.

k油.mnemo: You squeeze a **root** and, instead of **water**, out comes a golden liquid that floats on top: it's **oil**.
k油.mnemo_lectura: **You** let your guard down and slip on the **oil**: ゆ, as in 油断.
k油.nota: 由 (reason) is its right side; 抽 (extract) has a hand.

k仲.mnemo: One **person** teaches another to throw darts at the **bullseye**: hours of laughs and bets. That's how a good **friendship** begins.
k仲.mnemo_lectura: You have a **knack**, **a** real gift, for **friendship**: なか.
k仲.nota: 中 (inside) is also read なか; 仲 has a person: it's the bond between people.

k訪.mnemo: You follow your **compass** to your friend's house, ring the bell and pour out a stream of **words** at the door: you've come to **visit**.
k訪.mnemo_lectura: You **visit** grandma and she shrieks, “**Oh, toes**! Shoes off!”: おとず(れる).
k訪.nota: 防 (defend) and 放 (release) have the same compass (方).

k適.mnemo: Beside the **road** you lay your house's **foundation** using an old **tombstone**… and it fits perfectly! The most **suitable** material.
k適.mnemo_lectura: Ask a **tech**ie which cable is **suitable**: てき, as in 適当.
k適.nota: 敵 (enemy) has the same foundation, but with a whip (攵) instead of the road.

k濡.mnemo: The **rain** catches you, a bucket of **water** lands on you and even your **beard** drips: there's no way not to **get wet**.
k濡.mnemo_lectura: You **get wet** again and swear: “**New** rule: umbrella every day!”: ぬ(れる).
k濡.nota: 需 (demand, 需要) is its right side on its own.

k接.mnemo: A **hand** helps a **woman** step down from the **podium**: the moment their fingers brush, sparks fly from the **contact**.
k接.mnemo_lectura: The electrician **set**s the two wires in direct **contact**, and zap: せつ.

k我.mnemo: The **warrior** stands in front of the mirror, admiring himself for hours: nobody on earth has a bigger **ego**.
k我.mnemo_lectura: The vain warrior with the huge **ego** thinks everyone goes **ga**-ga over him: が.

k慢.mnemo: A **heart** lounges in the **sun** on a **net** hammock and throws the **boomerang** without looking. It won't even get up to catch it. Pure **arrogance**.
k慢.mnemo_lectura: Gritting your teeth, you swallow your **arrogance**: “Hang in there, **man**”: まん.
k慢.nota: 我慢 (endure) is “ego + arrogance,” swallowed whole.

k丁.mnemo: A **nail** driven in so carefully it sits straight and flush with the wood: that's **meticulous** work.
k丁.mnemo_lectura: **Tay**lor Swift signs autographs with **meticulous** care: てい, as in 丁寧.
k丁.nota: 町 (neighborhood, まち) has a field in front; 打 (hit), a hand.

k寧.mnemo: Under the **roof**, you set your **heart** on a **plate** and pin it with a **nail** to serve it to your guests with all your **gentleness**.
k寧.mnemo_lectura: Your horse gives a soft, polite “**Neigh**”: pure **gentleness**. ねい, as in 丁寧.

k応.mnemo: Under the **shed** beats a huge **heart**. The moment you knock, it goes “boom”: it never takes long to **react**.
k応.mnemo_lectura: You knock and it **react**s at once: “**Oh**! Who's there?”: おう.

k付.mnemo: A **person** measures one **inch** from the edge where the clip goes: the one thing they always forget is to **attach**.
k付.mnemo_lectura: You **attach** a **tsu**nami warning to the email: つ (付ける, 気付く).
k付.nota: 付く (stick) and 着く (arrive) sound the same: つく.

k片.mnemo: You cut a log down the middle and keep one **slice**: just one of the two halves. You're left with **one side**.
k片.mnemo_lectura: “**Cut a**n apple in two and keep **one side**”: かた, as in 片手.

k減.mnemo: A **halberd** pokes the **water** tank and everything gushes out of the hole's **mouth**: the level keeps going down. Watch it **decrease**.
k減.mnemo_lectura: Your salary starts to **decrease** and your boss just chuckles: “**Heh**, heh”: へ(る).
k減.nota: 感 (feel) has the same part with a heart below; 減 has water on the left.

k扱.mnemo: A **hand** with a **long arm** reaches anything on the shelf: whatever it is, it knows how to **handle** it.
k扱.mnemo_lectura: “**Ah**, a **tsu**nami?” No problem: you **handle** the **ca**r like a stunt pro: あつか(う).
k扱.nota: 吸 (inhale) has the same long arm with a mouth.

k隠.mnemo: In the **town**, a **claw** grabs a **snout** and tucks it next to your **heart**: it's your secret, and you're going to **hide** it.
k隠.mnemo_lectura: You **hide** the ring at the bottom of a **cock**tail: かく (隠す).

k袋.mnemo: A **person** throws a **dart** at an old **kimono** and, making the most of the tear, sews it into a **bag**.
k袋.mnemo_lectura: Your **foo**d **bag**? A **crow** flew off with it: ふくろ.
k袋.nota: 貸 (lend) has a shell under the same part; 袋 has a kimono.

k位.mnemo: A **person** steps onto the **podium**: first, second or third, each one takes their **position**.

k抜.mnemo: Your **friend**'s **hand** grabs the **boomerang** stuck in the trunk and, with one yank, manages to **extract** it.
k抜.mnemo_lectura: With chopsticks, you **extract** a single **noo**dle from the bowl: ぬ(く).

k身.mnemo: The **body** poses in front of the mirror, sticks its belly out, sucks it in, flexes: it's proud of its **physique**.
k身.mnemo_lectura: You flex your whole **physique**, right down to the **shin**s: しん.
k身.nota: 体 is the body as an object; 身 is the body as “oneself” (自身, 中身).

k素.mnemo: A **crown** woven from one plain cotton **thread**: no gold, no jewels. This queen only wears what's **genuine**.

k敵.mnemo: You smash the **foundation** of his house with a **whip**: clearly, he's your **enemy**.
k敵.mnemo_lectura: Your worst **enemy**: the **techie** who hacked your Wi-Fi: てき (敵, 素敵).

k訳.mnemo: You measure your **words** with a **ruler** so they fit perfectly: that's how you build a good **excuse**.
k訳.mnemo_lectura: Your **excuse** this time is totally **wacky**: わけ (言い訳).
k訳.nota: Same ruler (尺) as 沢 (abundance), but with words (訁) instead of water.

palabras.furigana: 申[もう]し 訳[わけ]ない

k伸.mnemo: **Lightning** strikes a **person** on the head and the jolt makes their whole body grow six feet taller. What a way to **extend**.
k伸.mnemo_lectura: You **extend** your arms so far that your mom yells, “**No**, you'll snap!”: の(びる), の(ばす).
k伸.nota: 神 (god) has the same lightning next to an altar.

k祈.mnemo: Kneeling before the **altar**, you set your **axe** aside and press your hands together: time to **pray**.
k祈.mnemo_lectura: In court, you **pray** to be found **inno**cent: いの(る).

k避.mnemo: The **executioner** comes down the **road**, axe on his shoulder. You cross the street: some meetings are best to **avoid**.
k避.mnemo_lectura: You **avoid** the raw fish and order **sake** instead: さけ(る).
k避.nota: 壁 (wall) has the same 辟, sitting on soil (土).

palabras.furigana: 留学生[りゅうがくせい]

k輩.mnemo: Behind the **prison bars** of a police **car**, everyone rides handcuffed, sharing a sandwich: each one is your **comrade**.
k輩.mnemo_lectura: Your **comrade** from school (先輩) treats you to apple **pie**: ぱい.

k廊.mnemo: Under a very long **shed**, a **drop** slides onto the **brake** of the **town** cart: the cart rolls endlessly down the **corridor**.
k廊.mnemo_lectura: Lockers stand in a long **row** down the school **corridor**: ろう.

k肩.mnemo: You carry a **door** on your back and the **moon** peeks over it: all the weight lands on your **shoulder**.
k肩.mnemo_lectura: You balance a terra-**cotta** pot on your **shoulder**: かた.

k協.mnemo: **Ten** neighbors and three **muscles** push the broken-down car together: it only moves if everyone knows how to **cooperate**.
k協.mnemo_lectura: In **Kyo**to, neighbors **cooperate** to sweep the temple steps: きょう.

k再.mnemo: A ball of **soil** slips into the **goal** under the crossbar of **one**: the referee missed it, so they play it **again**.
k再.mnemo_lectura: Encore! The magician does it **again**: “**Hoo**… **ta-ta**… **bee**!” and a bee pops out of the hat: ふたたび.

k迷.mnemo: You drop grains of **rice** along the **road** to find your way back, but the birds eat them: now it's super easy to **get lost**.
k迷.mnemo_lectura: “**Ma**! **Yo**, where are you?” You **get lost** at the mall: まよ(う).

k床.mnemo: Under the **shed**, you fell a **tree** and saw it into planks. Now you can walk barefoot on a real wooden **floor**.

k移.mnemo: You carry **grain** on your back and walk **evening** after evening to a new field: time to **relocate** the harvest.
k移.mnemo_lectura: You **relocate** out **Ea**st with your grain on your back: い.

k戦.mnemo: **Small** sparks over a **field** with **ten** crosses and a **halberd** stuck in the middle: this is **war**.
k戦.mnemo_lectura: **Sen**d in the troops, it's **war**: せん (作戦, 戦争). To fight: たたか(う).

palabras.furigana: 世界大戦[せかいたいせん]

k断.mnemo: Someone offers you a sack of **rice** as a bribe; you pull out your **axe** and split it in two: it's clear, you're going to **refuse**.
k断.mnemo_lectura: “No, thanks.” **Dan** will **refuse** any bribe: だん.

k平.mnemo: You hang the sheet on the **clothesline** with **eight** clothespins and pull it tight: not a wrinkle, everything is **flat**.
k平.mnemo_lectura: A **flat** field of **hay**, calm and peaceful: へい.

k和.mnemo: A stalk of **grain** for every **mouth**: nobody goes hungry, nobody argues. That's **harmony**.
k和.mnemo_lectura: Calm **wa**ter, perfect **harmony**: わ, as in 平和.
k和.nota: 私 (I) has a nook instead of a mouth; 知 (know), an arrow.

k王.mnemo: Three floors of throne pierced by a scepter: that's where the **king** sits, and he insists you call him just that: **king**.
k王.mnemo_lectura: Kneel and swear an **oa**th to the **king**: おう.
k王.nota: With a drop it's 玉 (jewel); 主 (master) has the drop on top.

k拾.mnemo: On the sidewalk lies a **mouth** with a gold **one** inside, and a **person** is about to step on it: your **hand** dives for it. **Pick up**!
k拾.mnemo_lectura: A real **hero** stops to **pick up** trash: ひろ(う).
k拾.nota: 捨 (throw away, すてる) is its opposite and looks alike: it has 舎 instead of 合.

k標.mnemo: You plant a **tree** at the crossroads, the **cowboy** sets an **altar** on top, and everyone knows which way to go: it's a **signpost**.
k標.mnemo_lectura: “**Hee**-**yo**, I made it!” you whoop at the last **signpost**: ひょう, as in 目標.
k標.nota: 漂 (drift) has the same part with water.

k腰.mnemo: Under the **moon**, a **cowboy** dances with a **woman**, one hand on her **lower back**.
k腰.mnemo_lectura: A heating pad makes your **lower back** feel **cozy**: こし.

k穴.mnemo: A little roof and, beneath it, two legs spread wide: the entrance to a burrow. The **hole** element stands alone and means **hole**.
k穴.mnemo_lectura: An **ana**conda peeks out of a **hole**: あな.
k穴.nota: 空 (sky, empty) and 究 (research) have the hole on top.

k印.mnemo: A crooked arm presses a **stamp** onto the paper and leaves a red square: your **mark**.
k印.mnemo_lectura: You leave your **mark** on every **in**voice: いん, as in 印象.

k象.mnemo: A **fishhook** snags the **mouth** of a **pig** with a trunk: it's an elephant, and its outline sticks in your mind like an **image**.
k象.mnemo_lectura: An elephant on a TV **show**: what an **image**! しょう, as in 印象 and 対象.

k黙.mnemo: On the **farm** a **fire** burns, and the **dog** that never stopped barking sits and stares at the flames, hypnotized: at last, **silence**.
k黙.mnemo_lectura: The librarian glares over her glasses: “No **drama**.” You go **silent**: だま(る).
k黙.nota: It's 黒 (black) with a dog beside it; don't mix it up with plain 黒.

k慮.mnemo: A **tiger** prowls your **field** and your **heart** races: before taking a step, you think twice. That's **consideration**.
k慮.mnemo_lectura: Out of **consideration**, you let your friend take the last ticket to **Rio**: りょ, as in 遠慮.

k踏.mnemo: Your **foot** lands in a puddle of **water** glittering in the **sun** and… splash! Soaked. Lesson learned: watch what you **step on**.
k踏.mnemo_lectura: “**Phoo**ey!” You **step on** gum again: ふ(む).
k踏.nota: 路 (path) has a foot with a courier.

k景.mnemo: The **sun** peeks over the **lid** of the roof; below, the **mouth** of a **small** kid goes “oh”: what **scenery** at sunrise.
k景.mnemo_lectura: From **Cape** Cod, the **scenery** takes your breath away: けい.

k噂.mnemo: A **mouth** with radio **antennae**, a cup of **sake** in hand, an **inch** from your ear: it just dropped a **rumor**.
k噂.mnemo_lectura: “**Ooh**, **wha**t? **Sa**lly said that?” That's how a **rumor** spreads: うわさ.

k苦.mnemo: **Grass** grows over a forgotten **tombstone**: nobody visits, and the dead man below is left alone to **suffer**.
k苦.mnemo_lectura: The whole **crew** **suffer**s through the storm at sea: くる(しい).

k労.mnemo: A **small** kid drags a **blanket** full of rocks, pulling with every **muscle** he has: a whole day of **toil**.
k労.mnemo_lectura: A whole day of **toil**: you **row** the boat until sunset: ろう, as in 苦労.
k労.nota: 学 (learn) has the same head, but with a child (子) instead of muscle.

k捕.mnemo: A **hand** sneaks into the **greenhouse** at night and grabs the rabbit that's been gobbling the lettuce: finally, a **catch**.
k捕.mnemo_lectura: **Two ca**rs chase the thief until they **catch** him: つか(まえる).
k捕.nota: 補 (supplement) has a kimono; 捕 has a hand.

k戸.mnemo: A single wooden panel hanging from its frame: not the double gate (門), but the **door** element. On its own, it means **door**.
k戸.mnemo_lectura: You open the **door** and find a **to**ad: と, as in 戸惑う.
k戸.nota: 門 (gate) has two doors; 戸, one.

k怪.mnemo: Your neighbor, **heart** racing, digs at night with a **hoe** and buries a **boomerang**… What's he hiding? Very **suspicious**.
k怪.mnemo_lectura: You narrow one **eye**: “**Ya** look **suspicious**”: あや(しい). In 怪我 it's け.
k怪.nota: 径 (path) and 軽 (light, かるい) have the same hoe.

palabras.furigana: 観光客[かんこうきゃく]

k秘.mnemo: You keep a golden stalk of **grain** under **padlock** in the basement: nobody must know it exists. It's your **secret**.

k密.mnemo: Under the **roof** of a cabin high on a **mountain**, everything is shut with a **padlock**: not even air gets in. It's **airtight**.
k密.mnemo_lectura: You zip the secret inside a baseball **mitt**, **airtight**: みつ.

k復.mnemo: A **walker** throws his **yo-yo**, and it always returns to his hand. Same with your body after the flu: rest will **restore** it.
k復.mnemo_lectura: Chicken soup, “**foo**d **coo**ked with love,” will **restore** you: ふく.

k恋.mnemo: Two lovers ride a **swing** and their **heart** skips a beat every time they touch: pure **romance**.
k恋.mnemo_lectura: A **coy** smile across the room: the start of a **romance**: こい, as in 恋 and 恋人.
k恋.nota: 変 (change, かわる) has the same swing with a sled (夂) below.

k固.mnemo: A **tombstone** locked inside a concrete **fence**: not even a crane can move it. Totally **solid**.
k固.mnemo_lectura: A **cata**maran freezes **solid** in the ice: かた(まる).
k固.nota: 個 (individual, 個人) adds a person; 回 (round) has another fence inside.

k瞬.mnemo: An **eye**, a **claw**, a **blanket**, and two spinning **dancers**: it all happens in a blink, in an **instant**.
k瞬.mnemo_lectura: In an **instant**, the whole class starts to **shun** the tattletale: しゅん (瞬間, 一瞬).

k式.mnemo: A **dart** (a **halberd** missing a stroke) sticks into the temple's main **I-beam**: the rite begins. Everyone rise, it's the **ceremony**.
k式.mnemo_lectura: At the **ceremony**, **she** hands over the **key** to the city: しき.
k式.nota: 武 (martial) has a bus stop (止) instead of the I-beam; 試 (try) adds words.

k視.mnemo: A **watcher** climbs onto the **altar** to see the wedding better: from up there, he has perfect **vision**.
k視.mnemo_lectura: “**See**? I can see everything,” brags the one with perfect **vision**: し.

k疑.mnemo: A **kangaroo** holding a **spoon** in one **hoof** and an **arrow** in the other swears he's a chef. You don't buy it; all you can do is **doubt**.
k疑.mnemo_lectura: “In **Utah**, **ga**rden gnomes can talk.” You **doubt** it: うたが(う). In 疑問 it's ぎ.

k汗.mnemo: You hang your T-shirt on the **clothesline** and it drips **water**… even though you never washed it: it's **sweat**.
k汗.mnemo_lectura: After the game, your best **asset** is a towel for all that **sweat**: あせ.
k汗.nota: 汚 (dirty, きたない) has a light bulb (丂) instead of the clothesline.

k収.mnemo: With **four** drawers and a **boomerang** that flies back and forth picking everything up, you put each thing in its place: you love to **stow**.
k収.mnemo_lectura: “**Oh**, **sa**lmon!” The bear **stow**s it away for winter: おさ(まる).
k収.nota: 叫 (shout) has the same 丩 with a mouth.

k央.mnemo: A **giant** sticks his head into a **goal** and stays right in the middle, not left, not right: in the **center**.
k央.mnemo_lectura: Right in the **center** of the table sits the bill you **owe**: おう, as in 中央.
k央.nota: 英 (English, excellent) puts grass on top; 映 (reflect) adds a sun.

k悩.mnemo: Your **heart** sees something **small** poking out of a **trap**: a mouse? a monster? You lie awake all night. Impossible not to **worry**.
k悩.mnemo_lectura: “**Nah**, **ya** think too much,” says your friend. You **worry** anyway: なや(む).

k緊.mnemo: A **minister** holds a **boomerang** tied with a **thread** that's about to snap: if it slips, it hits him right in the face. Talk about **tension**.
k緊.mnemo_lectura: **Tension** at the family dinner: all your **kin** in one room: きん.

k誘.mnemo: With sweet **words**, you offer a stalk of **grain** tied to a **coil** that stretches right into their hand: there's no better way to **invite**.

k揺.mnemo: A **hand** with a **claw** grabs a **tin can** of soda and shakes it mercilessly: the table, the house and the whole block start to **sway**.
k揺.mnemo_lectura: The rope bridge starts to **sway** and you yell, “**You**! Stop jumping!”: ゆ(れる). In 動揺 it's よう.

k差.mnemo: A **king** with **antennae** and an **I-beam** on his shoulder compares himself with other kings: identical except for one detail. That's the **difference**.
k差.mnemo_lectura: Put two photos side by side and yell “**Saw** it!” when you spot the **difference**: さ, as in 差 and 差し出す.
k差.nota: 着 (put on clothes) has the same head, but with an eye (目) below.

k抱.mnemo: Your **hand** tucks a **snake** into a **wrapping** of blanket and squeezes it to your chest: nobody else would dare give it a **hug**.
k抱.mnemo_lectura: “**Da**rling, come here,” and you get a big **hug**: だ(く).

k辺.mnemo: Along the **road**, a giant **knife** patrols, making its rounds: it guards the whole **vicinity**.
k辺.mnemo_lectura: Your dog sniffs every corner of the **vicinity**: “**Atta** boy!”: あた(り).
k辺.nota: 込 (cram) has a teepee (入) instead of a knife.

k越.mnemo: A **runner** uses the shaft of his **halberd** as a pole and vaults the highest wall: he manages to **cross over**.
k越.mnemo_lectura: You **cross over** the wall, **co**at flapping in the wind: こ(える).
k越.nota: 起 (wake up, おきる) has the same runner with a snake (己).

k叫.mnemo: A huge **mouth** counts to **four** at the top of its lungs in the middle of the library: it can't talk, it can only **shout**.
k叫.mnemo_lectura: You **shout** so much that your throat begs for a warm **sake**: さけ(ぶ).

k柔.mnemo: A **kangaroo** throws its **harpoon** at a **tree** and the tip bends like a noodle: the tree is made of gummy candy, **soft**.
k柔.mnemo_lectura: The pillow is so **soft** you **yaw**n on the spot: やわ(らかい).

k雰.mnemo: The **rain** gets sliced into **eight** by a **knife** and turns into mist: the room has a mysterious **atmosphere**.
k雰.mnemo_lectura: What an **atmosphere**: the party is pure **fun**: ふん.

k囲.mnemo: A **well** in the middle of a **fence**: the fence closes it off on all four sides so nobody falls in. Its only job is to **surround**.
k囲.mnemo_lectura: “**Eee**!” squeals the pig, **surround**ed in its pen: い.
k囲.nota: Inside 囗, everything is shut in: 困 (trouble) holds a tree; 因 (cause), a giant.

k惑.mnemo: A **halberd** floats, pointing at a **mouth**, at **one** and at your **heart**: who's holding it? Nobody. Enough to **bewilder** anyone.
k惑.mnemo_lectura: A **mad** **dough**nut rolls into your kitchen: you're **bewildered**: まど(う), as in 戸惑う. In 迷惑 it's わく.
k惑.nota: 感 (feel) also has a heart below, but with a different part on top (咸).

k整.mnemo: You tie a **bundle** of twigs, **whip** them straight as **one** and plant them by the **bus stop**: everything in its place. You love to **tidy**.
k整.mnemo_lectura: “**Toto**, **no**!” you yell at the dog: you just finished the **tidy**ing. ととの(える).

k得.mnemo: A **walker** heads out into the **sun** and, with **one** finger, measures every **inch** of the path: whatever he finds, he's going to **gain**.
k得.mnemo_lectura: To **gain** the prize, you shout: “**Eh**! That's mine!”: え (得る). In 納得, とく.
k得.nota: Same walker (彳) as 待 (wait) and 後 (after).

k勇.mnemo: A **kangaroo** grabs a **toolbox** and, flexing its **muscle**, stands up to the lion: that's **courage**.
k勇.mnemo_lectura: It takes **courage** to post your first video on **You**Tube: ゆう, as in 勇気.
k勇.nota: 男 (man) also has muscle, but under a field.

k保.mnemo: A **person** hugs a **tree** with a **mouth** on its trunk so no one cuts it down: a tree worth fighting to **preserve**.
k保.mnemo_lectura: Leftover cake? You **preserve** it for **tomo**rrow: たも(つ).

k存.mnemo: A **child** **genie** spends all night on formulas, trying to prove he can really **exist**.
k存.mnemo_lectura: To **exist**, every star needs a **son**g of its own: そん (存在).
k存.nota: Don't confuse it with 在 (presence), its partner in 存在: 在 has soil (土) instead of a child.

palabras.furigana: 駐車場[ちゅうしゃじょう]

k余.mnemo: After dinner, the **leftovers** pile up under the pantry's little roof: there's always a **surplus**.
k余.mnemo_lectura: The **surplus**? “**Yo**, that's mine!”: よ (余裕, 余計). To be left over: あま(る).

k裕.mnemo: Your **kimono** is so baggy that a whole **valley** fits inside: fabric to spare, all the **leeway** you want.
k裕.mnemo_lectura: “Relax, take your time,” says the host. “**You** have plenty of **leeway**”: ゆう.

k未.mnemo: A **tree** with a short little branch of **one** at the top: the fruit is still green. Is it ripe? **Not yet**.
k未.mnemo_lectura: “What about **me**?” Your future is **not yet** written: み.
k未.nota: 末 (end) has a long top line; 未, a short one.

k耐.mnemo: They pluck your **beard** hair by hair, an **inch** at a time, and you grit your teeth: all you can do is **endure**.
k耐.mnemo_lectura: Your boss's **tie** is hideous, but you **endure** it all day: たえ(る).

k追.mnemo: **Sacks** tumble down the **road** and you run after them, out of breath. You spend the whole afternoon on the **chase**.
k追.mnemo_lectura: You **chase** the ice cream truck, yelling “**Oh**! **Oo**h! Wait!”: お(う).

k効.mnemo: A **lid**, **eight** legs crossed like a **five**, and a free **muscle**: the new syrup gets you up in a minute. What an **effect**.
k効.mnemo_lectura: One sip, and the sleepy **koala** wakes right up. Now that's an **effect**: こう.

k眺.mnemo: Your **eye** follows a **black cat** strolling across the rooftops at sunset. You could spend hours like this, just letting yourself **gaze**.
k眺.mnemo_lectura: “Stop **nag**ging,” you sigh, and **gaze** out at the sea: なが(める).

k香.mnemo: Stalks of **grain** baking under the noon **sun**: you close your eyes and breathe in their warm **fragrance**.
k香.mnemo_lectura: The rich **fragrance** of hot ca**cao**: かお(り).

k納.mnemo: A **person** walks into the **goal** pulling a golden **thread**: with it, he's going to **pay off** his debt to the bank.
k納.mnemo_lectura: **Not** a cent left to **pay off**: you finally relax: なっ(とく).

k浮.mnemo: A **claw** grabs a **child** by the T-shirt and sets him on his back in the **water**: arms spread, calm, he learns to **float**.
k浮.mnemo_lectura: “**Ooh**, **ka**-boom!” A rubber duck pops up and starts to **float**: うか(ぶ).

k騒.mnemo: A **horse** with a **bug** buzzing in its mane kicks wildly, while a **boomerang** whizzes around it: what a **ruckus**.
k騒.mnemo_lectura: “I **saw a** mouse!” Cue the **ruckus**: さわ(ぐ).

k恐.mnemo: An **I-beam** crashes onto the **table**, a **drop** of sweat rolls down your brow and your **heart** stops: that's **terror**.
k恐.mnemo_lectura: “**Oh**, **so** dark in here…” Pure **terror**: おそ(ろしい).

k骨.mnemo: A **skull** over a **moon** shining in the night: the skeleton in person. The **bone** element means **bone**.
k骨.mnemo_lectura: A caveman **hone**s a **bone** into a knife: ほね.

k支.mnemo: A **branch** is a **ten** on top of a **boomerang**: stick it in the ground and it becomes a crutch. Perfect for **support**.
k支.mnemo_lectura: Your **sassy** grandma always shows up to **support** you: ささ(える).
k支.nota: 技 (technique) and 枝 (branch, えだ) have 支 on the right.

k冗.mnemo: You throw a **blanket** over a **table** nobody ever uses: everything in this storage room is **superfluous**.
k冗.mnemo_lectura: Average **Joe** adds a joke to every sentence, totally **superfluous**: じょう(だん).

k傷.mnemo: A **person** with a **rifle** marches under the **sun**, over **one**, waving a white **flag**... and still gets shot: he comes home with a **wound**.
k傷.mnemo_lectura: Mom plants a **kiss** on your **wound**, and it feels better: きず.

k句.mnemo: A **mouth** tucked inside a **wrapping** keeps whispering the same line, like a haiku: a **verse**.
k句.mnemo_lectura: Your favorite **verse** rhymes with **coo**-**coo**: く, as in 文句.
k句.nota: 旬 (in season) has a sun instead of a mouth.

k偶.mnemo: A **person** finds a **footprint** in a **field** identical to their own… and it's their long-lost twin's! What a **coincidence**.
k偶.mnemo_lectura: By pure **coincidence**, you and your ex step in the same **goo**: ぐう, as in 偶然.
k偶.nota: 遇 (encounter) and 隅 (corner, すみ) have the same 禺 part.

k輝.mnemo: You pull the **blanket** off a freshly waxed **car** and the light (光) bounces off the paint. It blinds you: that paint won't stop its **shine**.
k輝.mnemo_lectura: Out of the **ca**r steps Lady **Ga**ga: “**Ya**ss!” She **shine**s under the flashes: かがや(く).

k握.mnemo: A **corpse**'s **hand** bursts from the ground right at the **finish line** and grabs your ankle: it never lets go of anything it can **grip**.
k握.mnemo_lectura: You **grip** a **nigi**ri tight, just like a sushi chef: にぎ(る).
k握.nota: 掴む is grabbing on the fly; 握る is closing your fist and squeezing.

k覆.mnemo: A **cowboy** sees a **walker** playing with a **yo-yo** in the rain and shields him with his hat brim: full **cover**.
k覆.mnemo_lectura: “**Aww**!” You **cover** the shivering puppy with a blanket: おお(う).
k覆.nota: 復 (restore) and 複 (complex) have the same yo-yo without the cowboy.

k奮.mnemo: A **giant** **turkey** finds a **field** of corn and goes wild: it jumps, flaps, gobbles… pure **thrill**.
k奮.mnemo_lectura: Pure **thrill**: the roller coaster is so much **fun** you snort like a bull: ふん, as in 興奮.
k奮.nota: 奪 (snatch, うばう) has inch (寸) where this one has field.

k膝.mnemo: Under the **moon**, a **person** climbs a **tree**, slips on the **water** running down the trunk and… wham! Lands on one **knee**.
k膝.mnemo_lectura: “**He's a** mess!” After dancing all night, his **knee** is done: ひざ.
k膝.nota: 漆 (lacquer, うるし) has water instead of the moon.

k慌.mnemo: Your **heart** jumps: through the **grass** of the **river**, a **coffin** floats downstream… and it's open! You start to **panic**.
k慌.mnemo_lectura: “**Aw**, **wa**it, where's my phone?!” Instant **panic**: あわ(てる).

k才.mnemo: The **genie** looks like a **hand** (扌) missing a piece: he doesn't need it, he solves everything with his head. Pure **talent**.
k才.mnemo_lectura: You have a real **talent** for **sci**ence: さい, as in 才能.
k才.nota: It looks like the katakana オ (o) and like 扌 (hand).

k致.mnemo: You cross the **finish line** under the crack of the **whip**, drenched, and bow: “An honor to **perform** my duty.”
k致.mnemo_lectura: “I'll **eat a**nything,” you say humbly, ready to **perform** any duty: いた(す).

k救.mnemo: Someone is drowning in the **water**: you tie **one** knot, gather a **drop** of courage and throw your **whip** for them to grab. You just pulled off a **rescue**.
k救.mnemo_lectura: You **rescue** the kitten with one **scoo**p of your hands: すく(う).

k悔.mnemo: Your **mother** aims a water **rifle** at you and your **heart** sinks: you shouldn't have eaten her cake. Now it's time to **regret**.
k悔.mnemo_lectura: You show off in a **kay**ak, flip over, and now you **regret** it: かい, as in 後悔. In 悔しい it's くや.
k悔.nota: 海 (sea) and 梅 (plum) share the 毎 part; here the heart (忄) is in charge.

k氷.mnemo: One **drop** too many falls into the **water**… and suddenly the whole thing freezes: it's **ice**.
k氷.mnemo_lectura: Your penguin **Cor**ey skates on the **ice**: こおり.
k氷.nota: 水 (water) is the same without the drop; 永 (eternal) has it on top, not on the left.

k防.mnemo: The **town** points its **compass** north, where the enemy comes from, and builds a wall: better safe than sorry. Time to **prevent**.
k防.mnemo_lectura: To **prevent** a fire, you change the **fuse**: ふせ(ぐ).
k防.nota: 訪 (visit) and 放 (release) have the same compass.

k臓.mnemo: By the light of the **moon**, a mad **minister** hides his jar collection in the **grass**, guarded by a **halberd**: in each jar floats an **organ**.
k臓.mnemo_lectura: A **zo**mbie wanders the halls, hungry for a fresh **organ**: ぞう, as in 心臓.
k臓.nota: 蔵 (storehouse, くら) is its right side alone.

palabras.furigana: 運転免許[うんてんめんきょ]

k燃.mnemo: A **dog** gazes at the **moon** beside the bonfire; a spark from the **fire** jumps onto its tail and… whoosh! Everything starts to **burn**.
k燃.mnemo_lectura: Even your **mo**tor home **burn**s in the bonfire: も(える).
k燃.nota: 然 (natural, 自然) is its right side on its own.

k剣.mnemo: A whole **assembly** votes on which weapon to wield and picks the longest **knife** ever seen: a **sword**.
k剣.mnemo_lectura: In **ken**do you fight with a bamboo **sword**: けん, as in 真剣.
k剣.nota: Same assembly (㑒) as 険 (danger), 検 (inspect) and 験 (test): the knife gives it away.

k志.mnemo: A **scholar** with his **heart** on fire swears he'll reach the summit: he has **determination** to spare.
k志.mnemo_lectura: A **shee**p climbing Everest? Pure **determination**: し, as in 意志.
k志.nota: 忘 (forget) has a coffin (亡) over the heart; 誌 (magazine) adds words.

k訓.mnemo: The sergeant lets out a **river** of **words** without taking a breath: left, right, hit the ground… His job is to **instruct**.
k訓.mnemo_lectura: Your **kun**g fu master **instruct**s you by yelling: くん, as in 訓練.

k刺.mnemo: A thorny **tree** inside a soccer **goal**, and the goalie blocks shots with a **knife**: every ball gets punctured. He loves to **stab**.
k刺.mnemo_lectura: **She** gets **stab**bed by a cactus spine: ouch! し, as in 刺激.
k刺.nota: 策 (plan) has the same thorn under bamboo.

k依.mnemo: A **person** can't get dressed alone and clings to a **kimono** like a toddler to mom: it's the one thing they **depend** on.
k依.mnemo_lectura: Your little brother **depends** on you for **ea**sy answers: い, as in 依頼.

k城.mnemo: You pile up **soil**, sprinkle it with magic, and it becomes (成) walls, a moat and towers: your very own **castle**.
k城.mnemo_lectura: Every morning **she rows** across the moat to her **castle**: しろ.

k沈.mnemo: A **drifter** lies down to sleep in the **water**, hugging a rubber **duckling**… that doesn't float. Glub, glub: he starts to **sink**.
k沈.mnemo_lectura: “**Chin** up!” you shout as the ship begins to **sink**: ちん, as in 沈黙. In 沈む, しず.
k沈.nota: 枕 (pillow, まくら) has a tree with the same drifter.

k吐.mnemo: You eat a handful of **soil** on a dare and your **mouth** says enough: time to **vomit**.
k吐.mnemo_lectura: Off the roller coaster, you pant “**Ha**, ha…” and then you **vomit**: は(く).
k吐.nota: 叶 (come true, かなう) has ten; 吐 has soil.

k純.mnemo: A newborn **duckling** tugs on a snow-white **thread**, just **one**. No dye, no blend: one hundred percent **pure**.
k純.mnemo_lectura: A **June** wedding in a **pure** white dress: じゅん, as in 単純.
k純.nota: 鈍 (dull) has gold instead of thread.

k巻.mnemo: A **snake** catches a **beetle** and wraps around it, turn after turn. Nobody knows how to **roll up** like that.
k巻.mnemo_lectura: You **roll up** in a blanket like a sushi roll and yell, “**Ma**, I'm inside!”: ま(く).
k巻.nota: 券 (ticket) has a knife (刀) at the bottom instead of a snake.

k証.mnemo: Your **words** carry a line (**one**) over a **bus stop** sign: they're correct (正), no two ways about it. There's your **evidence**.
k証.mnemo_lectura: You bring the **evidence** to court and turn the trial into a **show**: しょう, as in 証拠 and 証明.

k破.mnemo: You throw a **stone** at a drum of tight **skin** and… rrrip! You just managed to **rip** it.
k破.mnemo_lectura: You **rip** the clown's pants and everyone bursts out laughing: “**Ha**!”: は, as in 破壊.
k破.nota: 波 (wave) has water next to the same skin (皮).

k求.mnemo: A castaway wearing **one** as a visor waits for rain**water**… and a single **drop** falls. He raises his hand: time to **request** more.
k求.nota: With a whip beside it, it's 救 (rescue). And don't confuse it with 水 (water).

palabras.furigana: 民主主義[みんしゅしゅぎ]

k悟.mnemo: Your **heart** counts to **five**, your **mouth** chants “om”... and suddenly it all makes sense: you've reached **enlightenment**.
k悟.mnemo_lectura: “**Go**!” shouts the master, and the monk dives into **enlightenment**: ご.

k混.mnemo: You toss **water**, a ray of **sun** and two **twins** into the same blender and hit the button: now nobody can tell them apart. Time to **mix**.
k混.mnemo_lectura: Two flavors in one ice cream **cone**: you know how to **mix**: こん, as in 混乱.

k乱.mnemo: A **duckling** sticks its **tongue** out at everyone and runs through the house knocking over vases: what **disorder**.
k乱.mnemo_lectura: The toddler **ran** through the house and left total **disorder**: らん, as in 混乱.

k貴.mnemo: A golden **bullseye** resting on **one** like a tray, next to a **shell** full of pearls: that's how the most **noble** lord at court shows off.
k貴.mnemo_lectura: The sign on the palace gate: “**Kee**p out. **Noble**s only”: き.

k微.mnemo: A tiny **walker** climbs a **mountain** carrying a **pi** and a **whip**: from below you can barely see him. Something very **subtle**.
k微.mnemo_lectura: A **subtle** change: a **bee** just landed on your lip. び, as in 微妙.
k微.nota: 徴 (trait, 特徴) has a king (王) instead of pi.

k妙.mnemo: A **woman** adds just a **pinch** of salt to her coffee and smiles: she likes it that way. Her taste is very **peculiar**.
k妙.mnemo_lectura: Your cat's **peculiar** habit: saying “**Meow**” to the fridge: みょう.

k援.mnemo: A **hand** lowers a rope into the pit, a **claw** grabs it and your **friend** pulls: **one**, two, three, up! Here comes **aid**.
k援.mnemo_lectura: Fans shout “**Energy**!” to send **aid** to their team: えん, as in 応援.
k援.nota: 暖 (warm) and 緩 (loose) have the same right side.

k制.mnemo: A **cow** with a **scarf** around its neck and a **knife** in its hoof keeps order in the barn: here, **control** rules.
k制.mnemo_lectura: “**Say** the six rules of **control**!” barks the principal: せい, as in 制服.

k謎.mnemo: **Words** spelled out in grains of **rice** all along a **road**: nobody knows who put them there. It's a **mystery**.
k謎.mnemo_lectura: The **Naz**ca Lines in the desert: a **mystery** nobody has solved. なぞ.
k謎.nota: 迷 (get lost, まよう) is its right side.

k殴.mnemo: You stuff a **five** into a **box** and knock it out with jabs of a **lance**: bam, bam, bam. And to finish, a **punch**.
k殴.mnemo_lectura: The boxing coach **nag**s all day: “More **punch**!”: なぐ(る).
k殴.nota: 欧 (Europe) has a yawn (欠) instead of a lance.

k偉.mnemo: A **person** buckles on a champion's **belt** and the whole **gang** cheers: someone truly **eminent**.
k偉.mnemo_lectura: So **eminent** they named an **era** after him: えら(い).
k偉.nota: 違 (different, ちがう) has a road; 偉 has a person.

k幼.mnemo: A baby the size of a ball of **yarn** flexes a **muscle** to lift his rattle: so strong, and still an **infant**.
k幼.mnemo_lectura: The choir sings “**Hosanna**” to the **infant** in the manger: おさな(い).
k幼.nota: 幻 (illusion, まぼろし) has another stroke instead of muscle.

k預.mnemo: You leave your **alarm clock** and a **page** of instructions at the front desk: “Keep it until tomorrow.” You just made a **deposit**.
k預.mnemo_lectura: “**Ah**, **zoo**!” You **deposit** your pet lion there for the weekend: あず(ける).
k預.nota: 予 (in advance, 予定) is its left side.

k放.mnemo: A **compass** sits locked in a drawer. One crack of the **whip** on the lock and the needle spins free. At last you decide to **release** it.
k放.mnemo_lectura: You **release** the garden **hose** and it thrashes around like a snake: ほう.

k焦.mnemo: A **turkey** sits on top of the **fire** and starts hopping: it has to leave NOW, but has no idea where to. Totally **flustered**.
k焦.mnemo_lectura: “**Ah**, **say**, hurry up!” you snap, all **flustered**: あせ(る). Funny: sweat is also あせ (汗).
k焦.nota: 集 (gather) has a tree under the turkey; 焦, fire.

k頬.mnemo: A **giant** with **antennae** reads a hilarious **page** and laughs so hard that red spreads across each **cheek**.
k頬.mnemo_lectura: Grandma pinches your **cheek**: “**Whoa**, **oh**, stop!”: ほお.

k永.mnemo: A **drop** above **water** that flows and flows and never runs out: an **eternal** stream.
k永.mnemo_lectura: Straight **A**'s, forever and ever: an **eternal** report card. えい, as in 永遠.
k永.nota: 氷 (ice) has the drop on the left; 水 (water), none.

palabras.furigana: 積極的[せっきょくてき]

k穏.mnemo: A stalk of **grain** sways in the breeze while a **claw** strokes a sleeping **snout** resting on a slowly beating **heart**: everything is **calm**.
k穏.mnemo_lectura: It's **odd** how **calm** the sea is today: おだ(やか).
k穏.nota: 隠 (hide, かくす) has the same right side with a town (阝).

k底.mnemo: Under the **shed**, you keep the **family crest** in a trunk and, beneath it all, a **drop** of gold: it's at the **bottom**.
k底.mnemo_lectura: “**So co**ld!” you gasp at the **bottom** of the pool: そこ.
k底.nota: 低 (low) has a person; 抵 (resist), a hand.

k評.mnemo: Your **words** about the movie are flat (平): no hype either way. A fair **review**.
k評.mnemo_lectura: “**Hee**, **yo**u'll love it!” says the **review**: ひょう, as in 評価.
k評.nota: 平 (flat, peace) is its right side; 呼 (call) has a mouth.

k判.mnemo: A judge with **antennae** hears both sides, grabs the **knife** and slices the cake into **ten** equal pieces: that's how you learn to **judge**.
k判.mnemo_lectura: **Han** Solo is here to **judge** you: はん.

k狙.mnemo: A **dog** climbs to the top of a **ladder**, narrows its eyes and locks onto the neighbor's sausage: it's getting ready to **aim** and leap.
k狙.mnemo_lectura: You **aim** your water gun at the **ne**ighbor's **ra**ccoon: ねら(う).

palabras.furigana: 積極的[せっきょくてき]

k君.mnemo: The **chief** opens his **mouth** and points down at you: “Yes, you, the new guy.” That's what he calls you, no fuss: **you**.

k誤.mnemo: You get a **gift** with loving **words** on the card… meant for someone else: the delivery guy mixed it up. What an **error**.
k誤.mnemo_lectura: An own **goal**: what an **error**! ご, as in 誤解.
k誤.nota: 娯 (amusement) has a woman next to the gift.

k秀.mnemo: A stalk of **grain** grows on top of a **coil** and springs way above all the others: truly **outstanding**.
k秀.mnemo_lectura: You **shoo**t from midfield and score: an **outstanding** play. しゅう, as in 優秀.
k秀.nota: 季 (season) has a child under the grain; 透 (transparent) adds a road.

k舌.mnemo: Out of a mouth (口) pokes a stick with a crossbar: a **tongue** stretched as far as it goes. Element and kanji are the same thing: **tongue**.
k舌.mnemo_lectura: **She** sticks out her **tongue** at you and sings, “**Ta**-da!”: した.
k舌.nota: 古 (old) has a straight cross on top; 舌 has a slanted stroke on top.

k勘.mnemo: Your secret **muscle** isn't in your arm: it's the one that smells **candy** hidden three blocks away. It's called **intuition**.
k勘.mnemo_lectura: Trust your **intuition**: deep down, you know you **can**: かん, as in 勘違い.

k担.mnemo: Every morning your **hand** lifts the **sun** onto **one** of your shoulders: nobody else wants to, so someone has to **take charge**.
k担.mnemo_lectura: At the beach you **take charge** of your **tan**: sunscreen every hour. たん, as in 担当.
k担.nota: 但 (however) has a person; 担 has a hand.

k染.mnemo: You dip the leaves of a **tree** **nine** times in colored **water**: they come out red, green, lilac… You love to **dye**.
k染.mnemo_lectura: You **dye** your **so**fa bright red: そ(まる), そ(める).

k陰.mnemo: In the **town**, right now (今), a **cloud** covers the sun and everything falls into **shade**.
k陰.mnemo_lectura: The parrot's **cage** hangs in the **shade**: かげ, as in お陰.
k陰.nota: 陽 (sunlight) is its partner: 陰 is yin and 陽 is yang.

k了.mnemo: A **hook** bows its head like someone nodding: “Copy that, over and out.” Time to **conclude**.
k了.mnemo_lectura: Your trip is about to **conclude** with a night at a **ryo**kan inn: りょう, as in 了解 and 終了.
k了.nota: 子 (child) also has a horizontal line.

k鋭.mnemo: The **flirt** makes himself a gold (金) comb to impress, but it's so fine it cuts hair: it's **sharp**.
k鋭.mnemo_lectura: **Sue** and **Lou** slice **dough** in one go with a very **sharp** knife: するど(い).
k鋭.nota: The 兑 family: 説 (explain), 税 (tax) and 脱 (take off).

k宣.mnemo: You climb onto the **roof**, look out at the **horizon** and shout your news to the whole kingdom. That's how you **proclaim**.
k宣.mnemo_lectura: The emperor stands before the **Sen**ate to **proclaim** a new law: せん, as in 宣言.
k宣.nota: 宜 (suitable) has a ladder under the roof.

k込.mnemo: Down the **road**, half the town shows up at one tiny **teepee**: shoving, elbowing… just how many people can you **cram**?
k込.mnemo_lectura: You **cram** the whole family into one giant **co**at: こ, as in 飛び込む or 巻き込む.

palabras.furigana: 民主主義[みんしゅしゅぎ]

k程.mnemo: The **king** opens his **mouth** and measures how much **grain** fits inside: it all depends on the **degree** of his hunger.
k程.mnemo_lectura: Your **ta**ble tilts to a scary **degree**: てい.

k毒.mnemo: The evil queen puts on her **crown** and, disguised as a loving **mother**, offers you an apple: it's laced with **poison**.
k毒.mnemo_lectura: The **doc** tests the apple and frowns: **poison**: どく.
k毒.nota: 母 (mother) and 毎 (every) have the same bottom part.

k仮.mnemo: A **person** looks in the **mirror** and sees someone who isn't them: a disguise, a self you can take off, just **temporary**.
k仮.mnemo_lectura: You live out of a **carry**-on: everything is **temporary**. かり, as in 仮に.
k仮.nota: 板 (board) has a tree; 坂 (slope), soil; 仮, a person.

k良.mnemo: A **brake** with a **drop** of oil on top stops smoothly, without a squeak: a brake like that is **good**.
k良.mnemo_lectura: Who's the **good** kid in class? “**Yo**, that's me!”: よ, as in 仲良く.
k良.nota: With a little roof on top it forms 食 (eat); without the drop it's just the brake (艮).

k懐.mnemo: Your **heart** skips when you find grandma's **kimono** in the attic, with **ten** holes and a **net** of moth bites: a wave of **nostalgia** hits you.
k懐.mnemo_lectura: With **nostalgia** you remember grandma's **nut** cookies: なつ(かしい).
k懐.nota: 壊 (destroy) has soil instead of a heart.

k改.mnemo: The **snake** behaves terribly until it sees the **whip**: it sheds its skin on the spot and promises to **reform**.
k改.mnemo_lectura: “**Arr**, **ta**-ta!” says the old pirate, who swears to **reform**: あらた(めて).

k迫.mnemo: Down the **road** comes a **white** truck at full speed, honking nonstop, getting nearer and nearer: it won't stop trying to **close in**.
k迫.mnemo_lectura: A **semi** truck starts to **close in** on you, horn blaring: せま(る).
k迫.nota: 追 (chase) has sacks (𠂤) instead of white.

k衝.mnemo: A **walker** strolls down the sidewalk carrying a huge **barbell**, doesn't see the lamppost and… bang! What a **collision**.
k衝.mnemo_lectura: Such a hard **collision** that you're left in **sho**ck: しょう, as in 衝撃.
k衝.nota: 衛 (defense) and 街 (street) also sit inside the walker (行).

k沢.mnemo: You measure the swamp **water** with a **ruler** and can't reach the bottom: there's water in **abundance**.
k沢.mnemo_lectura: Snacks in **abundance**: you **tuck** them into every pocket: たく (沢山).
k沢.nota: Don't confuse it with 訳 (excuse): same ruler (尺), but with words (訁).

k扉.mnemo: A **door** with **prison bars** that the wind flaps open and shut, bang, bang: it's the saloon's **swinging door**.
k扉.mnemo_lectura: **Toby**'s **ra**ccoon kicks open the saloon's **swinging door**: とびら.
k扉.nota: 戸 is a door in general; 扉 is the panel that swings open and shut.

k示.mnemo: You set the relic on the **altar**, light two candles and throw open the doors: the whole town has come for the **show**.
k示.mnemo_lectura: You **show** her the ancient relic. **She**'s like, “**Meh**”: しめ(す).

k型.mnemo: On a **torii** you carve a shape with a **knife** and pack it with wet **soil**: out pops a perfect brick from the **mold**.
k型.mnemo_lectura: In karate, every **kata** follows the same **mold**: かた.
k型.nota: 形 (shape, かたち) has three hairs (彡) instead of the knife and soil.

k暴.mnemo: Under a blazing **sun**, **twenty** guys throw buckets of **water** at each other, then chairs, then punches: it all turns **violent**.
k暴.mnemo_lectura: He turns **violent** and hurls his **ABBA** records at the DJ: あば(れる).
k暴.nota: 爆 (explode) is 暴 with fire in front.

k器.mnemo: A **dog** surrounded by four open **mouths** begging for food: each mouth is a bowl, and each bowl is a **vessel**.
k器.mnemo_lectura: The **ki**d knocks over the **vessel** and blames the dog: き.

k鬼.mnemo: The usual **ghost**, but with a club, a loincloth and red skin: in Japan it doesn't spook you, it clubs you. It's an **ogre**.
k鬼.mnemo_lectura: The **ogre** can't stop eating **oni**on rings: おに.
k鬼.nota: 魂 (soul) and 魔 (demon) carry the same 鬼.

k井.mnemo: **Two** boards crossed with two more: the stone rim seen from above. The **well** element stands alone and means **well**.
k井.mnemo_lectura: **Joe** paints the ceiling, 天井, up on a ladder: じょう.
k井.nota: 丼 (rice bowl, どんぶり) is the well with a dot inside.

k璧.mnemo: The **king**'s **executioner** polishes the crown jewel with his ax until there's not a single scratch: **flawless**.
k璧.mnemo_lectura: A **Peki**ngese fresh from the groomer: **flawless**: ぺき, as in 完璧.
k璧.nota: 壁 (wall, かべ) has soil (土) below instead of the jewel (玉): people mix them up all the time.

k軍.mnemo: A **car** hidden under a camouflage **blanket**: underneath waits a tank, and behind it marches the whole **army**.
k軍.mnemo_lectura: The **army** marches at dawn, a **gun** on every shoulder: ぐん.
k軍.nota: 運 (carry, luck) is 軍 with the road (辶).

k申.mnemo: A bolt of **lightning** rips down the field and rumbles: the sky has something important to **declare**.
k申.mnemo_lectura: Bowing low, you **declare**: “I'm the one who **mow**s your lawn”: もう (申す, 申し訳ない).
k申.nota: Don't confuse it with 由 (reason) or 田 (field): in 申 the stick pokes out top and bottom.

palabras.furigana: 申[もう]し 訳[わけ]ない

k唇.mnemo: A **rooster** lands on your **mouth** and gives it a peck: now you've got a swollen **lip**.
k唇.mnemo_lectura: Your mouth (くち) gets stung by a **bee** and your **lip** is **ru**ined: くちびる.

k条.mnemo: Your **sled** slams into a **tree** and the insurance won't pay: “Not in the contract.” Read the fine print of every **clause**.
k条.mnemo_lectura: **Joe** signs without reading a single **clause**: じょう, as in 条件.

k捜.mnemo: Your **hand** holds a bolt of **lightning** like a flashlight and throws a **boomerang** that comes back full of clues: now you can **track down** anyone.
k捜.mnemo_lectura: The **saga** of the detective who can **track down** anything: さが(す).
k捜.nota: 探 (search) is also read さがす: 捜 is for something lost or someone missing; 探, for something you want.

k査.mnemo: You climb a **tree** with a **ladder** to check limb by limb for termites: it's an **inspection**.
k査.mnemo_lectura: The health **inspection** starts with the **sa**uce: さ, as in 調査.

k崩.mnemo: Two **moons** crash into the peak of a **mountain**: rocks everywhere. The mountain starts to **collapse**.
k崩.mnemo_lectura: Pigeons **coo** at the **zoo** as the old cage starts to **collapse**: くず(れる).

k敷.mnemo: In the **greenhouse**, you take out the **compass** to line up the rug and, with a crack of the **whip**, the rug begins to **spread**.
k敷.mnemo_lectura: **She** tosses you the **key** to the mansion: now **spread** the rug: しき.

k魂.mnemo: A **ghost** slips away, floating up toward a **cloud**: it's what's left of you when you go, your **soul**.
k魂.mnemo_lectura: “**Tom, a shee**p just floated past!” It's a sheep's **soul**, off to the clouds: たましい.
k魂.nota: 塊 (lump, かたまり) has soil instead of a cloud.

k替.mnemo: Two identical **husbands** take turns sitting on the **sun** to warm up: when one gets scorched, it's time to **replace** him.
k替.mnemo_lectura: “**Gah**, wrong shirt!” You **replace** it: が, as in 着替える; on its own, か(える).
k替.nota: 賛 (approve, 賛成) has a shell instead of the sun.

k炎.mnemo: A **fire** on top of another fire: the bonfire shoots up and a **flame** rises taller than the house.
k炎.mnemo_lectura: Santa's beard: “**Ho**… **no**… **oh**!” It's in **flame**s: ほのお.
k炎.nota: 談 (chat) has 炎 next to the words.

palabras.furigana: 奨学金[しょうがくきん]

k更.mnemo: The **owl** hoots all night long. You shut the window; it hoots louder. And **furthermore**, it brought friends.
k更.mnemo_lectura: **Sarah** shows up late and, **furthermore**, she brought her drum kit: さら.

k闘.mnemo: Behind the **gate**, two fighters fling **beans** at each other from an **inch** away: the bell rings, and **combat** begins.
k闘.mnemo_lectura: After the **combat**, the loser's car needs a **tow**: とう.

k精.mnemo: You polish a grain of **rice** until it glows **blue**: what's left is its **essence**.
k精.mnemo_lectura: What's the **essence** of your idea? **Say** it in one word: せい, as in 精神.
k精.nota: 晴 (clear up) has a sun; 清 (clean), water; 精, rice.

k展.mnemo: A **corpse** gets up, pulls **twenty** **kimonos** out of a trunk and spreads them across the floor: its own museum. It loves to **unfold**.
k展.mnemo_lectura: You **unfold** the map: it's **ten** feet long: てん, as in 展開.
k展.nota: 殿 (palace, lord) has the same part with a lance (殳).

palabras.furigana: 自己紹介[じこしょうかい]

k漏.mnemo: A **corpse** lies under a cracked ceiling: the **rain** gets in, **water** drips on its forehead… everything starts to **leak**.
k漏.mnemo_lectura: Water **leak**s in and everything smells of **mo**ld: も(れる), も(らす).

k拠.mnemo: A **hand** grabs a **sled** and plants it on top of a **table**: at last you've got something to lean on, a solid **basis**.
k拠.mnemo_lectura: The detective's whole case rests on one **basis**: a secret **co**de: こ, as in 証拠.

gramatica.nota: は marks the topic: “as for me…”. です closes the sentence politely.
gramatica.titulo: は: the topic of the sentence

ve1ea452d8d.matiz: The neutral, polite way to say “I”. Boys and men among friends often use 僕 or 俺 instead. Japanese leaves out **I** whenever it's obvious, so you'll hear it far less than in English.

gramatica.nota: X は Y です: the most basic Japanese sentence, “X is Y”.

gramatica.titulo: は: the topic of the sentence

vefcae8abee.matiz: There are no articles, so 猫 can be “a cat”, “the cat” or “cats”. Fun compounds: 猫舌 (cat tongue) is someone who can't handle hot food; 猫背 (cat back) means slouching.

gramatica.titulo: は: the topic of the sentence

v1fefdbdb80.matiz: Stands alone, like “this one”. To put “this” in front of a noun you need この instead: この本 (this book).
v1fefdbdb80.mnemo: The こそあど family: **こ** is **c**lose to me. これ = **this** thing right here in my hand.

gramatica.nota: か at the end turns the sentence into a question, so no question mark is needed. Before です, 何 is read なん.

gramatica.titulo: は: the topic of the sentence

vb90a6bee8b.matiz: Read なん before です, before counters and before sounds starting with t, d or n (何ですか); なに almost everywhere else (何を, 何が).

v56e2d622ac.frase: こんにちは、私はニャンです。
v56e2d622ac.frase_furigana: こんにちは、 私[わたし]はニャンです。
v56e2d622ac.tono: コンニチハ

gramatica.titulo: は: the topic of the sentence

v56e2d622ac.matiz: A daytime greeting. In the morning you say おはよう, and in the evening こんばんは. Unlike “hello”, it's not used with your own family.

v5cbd42dbf1.frase_furigana: ニャンは人[ひと]ですか。
